title: UniMark: Unified Adaptive Multi-bit Watermarking for Autoregressive Image Generators
summary: Invisible watermarking for autoregressive (AR) image generation has recently gained attention as a means of protecting image ownership and tracing AI-generated content. However, existing approaches suffer from three key limitations: (1) they embed only zero-bit watermarks for binary verification, lacking the ability to convey multi-bit messages; (2) they rely on static codebook partitioning strategies that are vulnerable to security attacks once the partition is exposed; and (3) they are designed for specific AR architectures, failing to generalize across diverse AR paradigms. We propose \method{}, a training-free, unified watermarking framework for autoregressive image generators that addresses all three limitations. \method{} introduces three core components: \textbf{Adaptive Semantic Grouping (ASG)}, which dynamically partitions codebook entries based on semantic similarity and a secret key, ensuring both image quality preservation and security; \textbf{Block-wise Multi-bit Encoding (BME)}, which divides the token sequence into blocks and encodes different bits across blocks with error-correcting codes for reliable message transmission; and \textbf{a Unified Token-Replacement Interface (UTRI)} that abstracts the watermark embedding process to support both next-token prediction (e.g., LlamaGen) and next-scale prediction (e.g., VAR) paradigms. We provide theoretical analysis on detection error rates and embedding capacity. Extensive experiments on three AR models demonstrate that \method{} achieves state-of-the-art performance in image quality (FID), watermark detection accuracy, and multi-bit message extraction, while maintaining robustness against cropping, JPEG compression, Gaussian noise, blur, color jitter, and random erasing attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为\method{}的训练免费统一水印框架，用于自回归图像生成器，解决了现有方法的三个关键限制：支持多比特消息嵌入、动态安全分区和跨架构通用性。
AI.motivation: 当前自回归图像生成水印方法存在三个主要问题：1) 只能嵌入零比特水印进行二进制验证，无法传递多比特消息；2) 依赖静态码本分区策略，一旦分区暴露就易受安全攻击；3) 针对特定AR架构设计，无法泛化到不同的AR范式。
AI.method: 提出了\method{}框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 自适应语义分组(ASG)：基于语义相似性和密钥动态分区码本条目，确保图像质量和安全性；2) 块级多比特编码(BME)：将令牌序列分块，在不同块中编码不同比特，使用纠错码实现可靠消息传输；3) 统一令牌替换接口(UTRI)：抽象水印嵌入过程，支持下一令牌预测和下一尺度预测两种范式。
AI.result: 在三个AR模型上的广泛实验表明，\method{}在图像质量(FID)、水印检测准确性和多比特消息提取方面达到了最先进的性能，同时对裁剪、JPEG压缩、高斯噪声、模糊、颜色抖动和随机擦除攻击保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: \method{}是一个训练免费的统一水印框架，成功解决了自回归图像生成水印的三个关键限制，实现了多比特消息嵌入、动态安全分区和跨架构通用性，为保护图像所有权和追踪AI生成内容提供了有效解决方案。

title: A Workflow to Efficiently Generate Dense Tissue Ground Truth Masks for Digital Breast Tomosynthesis
summary: Digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) is now the standard of care for breast cancer screening in the USA. Accurate segmentation of fibroglandular tissue in DBT images is essential for personalized risk estimation, but algorithm development is limited by scarce human-delineated training data. In this study we introduce a time- and labor-saving framework to generate a human-annotated binary segmentation mask for dense tissue in DBT. Our framework enables a user to outline a rough region of interest (ROI) enclosing dense tissue on the central reconstructed slice of a DBT volume and select a segmentation threshold to generate the dense tissue mask. The algorithm then projects the ROI to the remaining slices and iteratively adjusts slice-specific thresholds to maintain consistent dense tissue delineation across the DBT volume. By requiring annotation only on the central slice, the framework substantially reduces annotation time and labor. We used 44 DBT volumes from the DBTex dataset for evaluation. Inter-reader agreement was assessed by computing patient-wise Dice similarity coefficients between segmentation masks produced by two radiologists, yielding a median of 0.84. Accuracy of the proposed method was evaluated by having a radiologist manually segment the 20th and 80th percentile slices from each volume (CC and MLO views; 176 slices total) and calculate Dice scores between the manual and proposed segmentations, yielding a median of 0.83.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于数字乳腺断层合成（DBT）图像中致密组织分割的半自动标注框架，通过在中心切片标注并自动投影到其他切片，显著减少了人工标注时间和工作量。
AI.motivation: DBT已成为美国乳腺癌筛查的标准方法，准确的致密组织分割对个性化风险评估至关重要。然而，算法开发受到人工标注训练数据稀缺的限制，需要更高效的标注方法。
AI.method: 开发了一个半自动标注框架：用户只需在DBT体积的中心重建切片上勾勒大致感兴趣区域（ROI）并选择分割阈值，算法自动将ROI投影到剩余切片，并通过迭代调整切片特定阈值来保持整个体积中致密组织分割的一致性。
AI.result: 使用DBTex数据集的44个DBT体积进行评估。两名放射科医生之间的分割一致性中位Dice系数为0.84；算法分割与放射科医生手动分割（176个切片）的中位Dice系数为0.83，显示出良好的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过仅需在中心切片进行标注，显著减少了DBT图像中致密组织分割的标注时间和工作量，同时保持了与人工分割相当的一致性，为算法开发提供了高效的训练数据生成方法。

title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces
summary: Should we trust Large Language Models (LLMs) with high accuracy? LLMs achieve high accuracy on reasoning benchmarks, but correctness alone does not reveal the quality of the reasoning used to produce it. This highlights a fundamental limitation of outcome-based evaluation: models may arrive at correct answers through flawed reasoning, and models with substantially different reasoning capabilities can nevertheless exhibit similar benchmark accuracy, for example due to memorization or over-optimization. In this paper, we ask: given existing benchmarks, can we move beyond outcome-based evaluation to assess the quality of reasoning itself? We seek metrics that (1) differentiate models with similar accuracy and (2) are robust to variations in input prompts and generation configurations. To this end, we propose a reasoning score that evaluates reasoning traces along dimensions such as faithfulness, coherence, utility, and factuality. A remaining question is how to aggregate this score across multiple sampled traces. Naively averaging them is undesirable, particularly in long-horizon settings, where the number of possible trajectories grows rapidly, and low-confidence correct traces are more likely to be coincidental. To address this, we introduce the Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS), which computes reasoning quality using only the top-K% most confident traces. Evaluating with FRS, models that are indistinguishable under standard accuracy exhibit significant differences in reasoning quality. Moreover, models with higher FRS on one benchmark tend to perform better on other reasoning benchmarks, in both accuracy and reasoning quality. Together, these findings suggest that FRS complements accuracy by capturing a model's transferable reasoning capabilities. We open source our evaluation codebase: https://github.com/Manas2006/benchmark_reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出过滤推理评分(FRS)，通过评估推理轨迹的质量而非仅看结果准确性，来区分具有相似准确率但推理能力不同的LLM模型。
AI.motivation: 当前基于结果的评估方法存在根本性限制：LLM可能通过有缺陷的推理得出正确答案，而具有不同推理能力的模型可能在基准测试中表现出相似的准确率（例如由于记忆或过度优化）。需要超越结果评估来评估推理本身的质量。
AI.method: 提出推理评分，从忠实性、连贯性、实用性和事实性等维度评估推理轨迹。为了解决多轨迹聚合问题，引入过滤推理评分(FRS)，仅使用置信度最高的前K%轨迹计算推理质量。
AI.result: 使用FRS评估时，在标准准确率下无法区分的模型在推理质量上表现出显著差异。此外，在一个基准测试上FRS较高的模型在其他推理基准测试中也倾向于表现更好（包括准确率和推理质量）。
AI.conclusion: FRS通过捕捉模型的可迁移推理能力来补充准确率评估，为评估LLM的推理质量提供了更全面的方法。

title: The Non-Optimality of Scientific Knowledge: Path Dependence, Lock-In, and The Local Minimum Trap
summary: Science is widely regarded as humanity's most reliable method for uncovering truths about the natural world. Yet the \emph{trajectory} of scientific discovery is rarely examined as an optimization problem in its own right. This paper argues that the body of scientific knowledge, at any given historical moment, represents a \emph{local optimum} rather than a global one--that the frameworks, formalisms, and paradigms through which we understand nature are substantially shaped by historical contingency, cognitive path dependence, and institutional lock-in. Drawing an analogy to gradient descent in machine learning, we propose that science follows the steepest local gradient of tractability, empirical accessibility, and institutional reward, and in doing so may bypass fundamentally superior descriptions of nature. We develop this thesis through detailed case studies spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, neuroscience, and statistical methodology. We identify three interlocking mechanisms of lock-in--cognitive, formal, and institutional--and argue that recognizing these mechanisms is a prerequisite for designing meta-scientific strategies capable of escaping local optima. We conclude by proposing concrete interventions and discussing the epistemological implications of our thesis for the philosophy of science.

AI.tldr: 科学发现轨迹被建模为优化问题，认为当前科学知识是局部最优而非全局最优，受历史偶然性、认知路径依赖和制度锁定影响
AI.motivation: 科学被认为是揭示自然真理的最可靠方法，但科学发现的轨迹很少被作为一个优化问题来研究。本文旨在探讨科学知识体系如何受历史偶然性、认知路径依赖和制度锁定的影响，形成局部最优而非全局最优
AI.method: 将科学发现类比为机器学习中的梯度下降过程，提出科学沿着可处理性、经验可及性和制度回报的最陡局部梯度发展。通过数学、物理、化学、生物学、神经科学和统计方法学的详细案例研究，识别认知、形式和制度三种锁定机制
AI.result: 科学知识体系在任何历史时刻都代表局部最优而非全局最优，科学框架、形式体系和范式受历史偶然性、认知路径依赖和制度锁定影响。识别了三种相互关联的锁定机制：认知锁定、形式锁定和制度锁定
AI.conclusion: 认识这些锁定机制是设计能够逃离局部最优的元科学策略的前提。提出了具体干预措施，并讨论了该论点对科学哲学的认识论意义

title: EigenCoin: sassanid coins classification based on Bhattacharyya distance
summary: Solving pattern recognition problems using imbalanced databases is a hot topic, which entices researchers to bring it into focus. Therefore, we consider this problem in the application of Sassanid coins classification. Our focus is not only on proposing EigenCoin manifold with Bhattacharyya distance for the classification task, but also on testing the influence of the holistic and feature-based approaches. EigenCoin consists of three main steps namely manifold construction, mapping test data, and classification. Conducted experiments show EigenCoin outperformed other observed algorithms and achieved the accuracy from 9.45% up to 21.75%, while it has the capability of handling the over-fitting problem.

AI.tldr: 提出EigenCoin方法用于解决萨珊王朝硬币分类中的不平衡数据问题，该方法结合流形构造和Bhattacharyya距离，在分类准确率上比现有算法提升9.45%-21.75%
AI.motivation: 解决不平衡数据库中的模式识别问题，特别是在萨珊王朝硬币分类这一具体应用场景中。研究者关注如何有效处理数据不平衡问题，并比较整体方法和特征方法的性能差异。
AI.method: 提出EigenCoin方法，包含三个主要步骤：1) 流形构造；2) 测试数据映射；3) 分类。该方法结合了Bhattacharyya距离，并测试了整体方法和特征方法的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EigenCoin方法优于其他观察算法，准确率提升了9.45%到21.75%，同时具备处理过拟合问题的能力。
AI.conclusion: EigenCoin方法在解决不平衡数据库中的模式识别问题方面表现优异，特别是在萨珊王朝硬币分类任务中，不仅提高了分类准确率，还能有效处理过拟合问题。

title: Self-Distillation Zero: Self-Revision Turns Binary Rewards into Dense Supervision
summary: Current post-training methods in verifiable settings fall into two categories. Reinforcement learning (RLVR) relies on binary rewards, which are broadly applicable and powerful, but provide only sparse supervision during training. Distillation provides dense token-level supervision, typically obtained from an external teacher or using high-quality demonstrations. Collecting such supervision can be costly or unavailable. We propose Self-Distillation Zero (SD-Zero), a method that is substantially more training sample-efficient than RL and does not require an external teacher or high-quality demonstrations. SD-Zero trains a single model to play two roles: a Generator, which produces an initial response, and a Reviser, which conditions on that response and its binary reward to produce an improved response. We then perform on-policy self-distillation to distill the reviser into the generator, using the reviser's token distributions conditioned on the generator's response and its reward as supervision. In effect, SD-Zero trains the model to transform binary rewards into dense token-level self-supervision. On math and code reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, SD-Zero improves performance by at least 10% over the base models and outperforms strong baselines, including Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT), GRPO, and Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), under the same question set and training sample budget. Extensive ablation studies show two novel characteristics of our proposed algorithm: (a) token-level self-localization, where the reviser can identify the key tokens that need to be revised in the generator's response based on reward, and (b) iterative self-evolution, where the improving ability to revise answers can be distilled back into generation performance with regular teacher synchronization.

AI.tldr: 提出SD-Zero方法，通过单一模型同时扮演生成器和修订者角色，将稀疏的二元奖励转化为密集的令牌级自监督，在数学和代码推理任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前可验证设置中的后训练方法存在局限性：基于强化学习的方法依赖稀疏的二元奖励监督，而蒸馏方法需要昂贵的外部教师或高质量演示数据。需要一种既训练样本高效又不需要外部监督的方法。
AI.method: SD-Zero训练单一模型扮演两个角色：生成器（产生初始响应）和修订者（基于初始响应及其二元奖励生成改进响应）。然后通过策略内自蒸馏，将修订者的令牌分布作为监督信号蒸馏回生成器，从而将二元奖励转化为密集的令牌级自监督。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Olmo-3-7B-Instruct模型上，SD-Zero相比基础模型性能提升至少10%，并在相同问题集和训练样本预算下优于RFT、GRPO和SDFT等强基线方法。消融研究揭示了令牌级自定位和迭代自演化两个新颖特性。
AI.conclusion: SD-Zero提供了一种有效的后训练方法，能够在不需要外部教师或高质量演示的情况下，将稀疏的二元奖励转化为密集的令牌级监督，显著提升模型在数学和代码推理任务上的性能。

title: Self-Monitoring Benefits from Structural Integration: Lessons from Metacognition in Continuous-Time Multi-Timescale Agents
summary: Self-monitoring capabilities -- metacognition, self-prediction, and subjective duration -- are often proposed as useful additions to reinforcement learning agents. But do they actually help? We investigate this question in a continuous-time multi-timescale agent operating in predator-prey survival environments of varying complexity, including a 2D partially observable variant. We first show that three self-monitoring modules, implemented as auxiliary-loss add-ons to a multi-timescale cortical hierarchy, provide no statistically significant benefit across 20 random seeds, 1D and 2D predator-prey environments with standard and non-stationary variants, and training horizons up to 50,000 steps. Diagnosing the failure, we find the modules collapse to near-constant outputs (confidence std < 0.006, attention allocation std < 0.011) and the subjective duration mechanism shifts the discount factor by less than 0.03%. Policy sensitivity analysis confirms the agent's decisions are unaffected by module outputs in this design. We then show that structurally integrating the module outputs -- using confidence to gate exploration, surprise to trigger workspace broadcasts, and self-model predictions as policy input -- produces a medium-large improvement over the add-on approach (Cohen's d = 0.62, p = 0.06, paired) in a non-stationary environment. Component-wise ablations reveal that the TSM-to-policy pathway contributes most of this gain. However, structural integration does not significantly outperform a baseline with no self-monitoring (d = 0.15, p = 0.67), and a parameter-matched control without modules performs comparably, so the benefit may lie in recovering from the trend-level harm of ignored modules rather than in self-monitoring content. The architectural implication is that self-monitoring should sit on the decision pathway, not beside it.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在强化学习智能体中，仅作为辅助损失添加的元认知、自我预测和主观时长等自我监控模块并不能带来显著性能提升，需要将这些模块的输出结构性地整合到决策路径中才能发挥潜在作用。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是验证元认知、自我预测和主观时长等自我监控能力是否真的能帮助强化学习智能体，特别是在连续时间多时间尺度的捕食者-猎物生存环境中。
AI.method: 研究采用两种方法：1）将三个自我监控模块作为辅助损失添加到多时间尺度皮层层次结构中；2）结构性地整合模块输出，包括使用置信度门控探索、意外触发工作空间广播、自我模型预测作为策略输入。在1D和2D捕食者-猎物环境中进行实验，包括标准和非平稳变体，训练步数达50,000步。
AI.result: 辅助损失方法在20个随机种子下没有提供统计显著收益，模块输出几乎恒定，主观时长机制对折扣因子的影响小于0.03%。结构性整合方法比辅助损失方法有中等改善（Cohen's d = 0.62），但并未显著优于无自我监控的基线（d = 0.15）。参数匹配的无模块控制组表现相当，表明收益可能来自恢复被忽略模块的趋势性损害，而非自我监控内容本身。
AI.conclusion: 自我监控模块应该放置在决策路径上，而不是旁边。仅作为辅助损失添加的自我监控模块无法提供显著性能提升，需要结构性地整合到智能体的决策过程中才能发挥潜在作用。

title: LLMs Struggle with Abstract Meaning Comprehension More Than Expected
summary: Understanding abstract meanings is crucial for advanced language comprehension. Despite extensive research, abstract words remain challenging due to their non-concrete, high-level semantics. SemEval-2021 Task 4 (ReCAM) evaluates models' ability to interpret abstract concepts by presenting passages with questions and five abstract options in a cloze-style format. Key findings include: (1) Most large language models (LLMs), including GPT-4o, struggle with abstract meaning comprehension under zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot settings, while fine-tuned models like BERT and RoBERTa perform better. (2) A proposed bidirectional attention classifier, inspired by human cognitive strategies, enhances fine-tuned models by dynamically attending to passages and options. This approach improves accuracy by 4.06 percent on Task 1 and 3.41 percent on Task 2, demonstrating its potential for abstract meaning comprehension.

AI.tldr: SemEval-2021 Task 4 (ReCAM)评估模型对抽象概念的理解能力，发现大语言模型在零样本/少样本设置下表现不佳，而微调模型表现更好。提出的双向注意力分类器通过动态关注篇章和选项，显著提升了抽象意义理解性能。
AI.motivation: 抽象意义理解是高级语言理解的关键，但抽象词汇由于其非具体、高层次的语义特性，对现有模型构成挑战。SemEval-2021 Task 4 (ReCAM)旨在评估模型解释抽象概念的能力。
AI.method: 研究采用填空式格式，提供篇章、问题和五个抽象选项。提出双向注意力分类器，受人类认知策略启发，动态关注篇章和选项，增强微调模型（如BERT、RoBERTa）的抽象意义理解能力。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）大多数大语言模型（包括GPT-4o）在零样本、单样本和少样本设置下对抽象意义理解困难；2）微调模型（BERT、RoBERTa）表现更好；3）提出的双向注意力分类器在Task 1上提升准确率4.06%，在Task 2上提升3.41%。
AI.conclusion: 双向注意力分类器能有效提升模型对抽象意义的理解能力，为抽象概念理解任务提供了有前景的解决方案，表明受人类认知启发的注意力机制在增强语言模型抽象理解方面具有潜力。

title: GoodPoint: Learning Constructive Scientific Paper Feedback from Author Responses
summary: While LLMs hold significant potential to transform scientific research, we advocate for their use to augment and empower researchers rather than to automate research without human oversight. To this end, we study constructive feedback generation, the task of producing targeted, actionable feedback that helps authors improve both their research and its presentation. In this work, we operationalize the effectiveness of feedback along two author-centric axes-validity and author action. We first curate GoodPoint-ICLR, a dataset of 19K ICLR papers with reviewer feedback annotated along both dimensions using author responses. Building on this, we introduce GoodPoint, a training recipe that leverages success signals from author responses through fine-tuning on valid and actionable feedback, together with preference optimization on both real and synthetic preference pairs. Our evaluation on a benchmark of 1.2K ICLR papers shows that a GoodPoint-trained Qwen3-8B improves the predicted success rate by 83.7% over the base model and sets a new state-of-the-art among LLMs of similar size in feedback matching on a golden human feedback set, even surpassing Gemini-3-flash in precision. We further validate these findings through an expert human study, demonstrating that GoodPoint consistently delivers higher practical value as perceived by authors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GoodPoint训练方法，通过作者回应信号优化LLM生成有效且可操作的反馈，在ICLR论文数据集上验证了其优越性
AI.motivation: 虽然LLMs在科学研究中有巨大潜力，但应该用于增强研究者能力而非完全自动化研究。当前需要生成具有建设性、针对性和可操作性的反馈来帮助作者改进研究和展示
AI.method: 1) 创建GoodPoint-ICLR数据集（19K ICLR论文，包含作者回应的有效性标注）；2) 提出GoodPoint训练方法：通过微调生成有效可操作反馈，结合真实和合成偏好对进行偏好优化
AI.result: 在1.2K ICLR论文基准测试中，GoodPoint训练的Qwen3-8B相比基础模型将预测成功率提升83.7%，在相似规模LLMs中达到最先进水平，在精确度上甚至超过Gemini-3-flash
AI.conclusion: GoodPoint方法能有效提升LLM生成反馈的质量和实用性，专家人类研究证实了其更高的实际价值，为LLM在科学研究中的增强应用提供了有效途径

title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) increasingly rely on retrieval to answer knowledge-intensive multimodal questions. Existing benchmarks overlook conflicts between visual and textual evidence and the importance of generating deflections (e.g., Sorry, I cannot answer...) when retrieved knowledge is incomplete. These benchmarks also suffer from rapid obsolescence, as growing LVLM training sets allow models to answer many questions without retrieval. We address these gaps with three contributions. First, we propose a dynamic data curation pipeline that preserves benchmark difficulty over time by filtering for genuinely retrieval-dependent samples. Second, we introduce VLM-DeflectionBench, a benchmark of 2,775 samples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval settings, designed to probe model behaviour under conflicting or insufficient evidence. Third, we define a fine-grained evaluation protocol with four scenarios that disentangle parametric memorization from retrieval robustness. Experiments across 20 state-of-the-art LVLMs indicate that models usually fail to deflect in the presence of noisy or misleading evidence. Our results highlight the need to evaluate not only what models know, but how they behave when they do not, and serve as a reusable and extensible benchmark for reliable KB-VQA evaluation. All resources will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了VLM-DeflectionBench基准测试，用于评估大型视觉语言模型在知识密集型多模态问答中的检索依赖性和偏转能力，解决了现有基准在视觉-文本证据冲突、偏转生成和快速过时等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试存在三个主要问题：1) 忽视视觉和文本证据之间的冲突；2) 不重视在检索知识不完整时生成偏转回答（如"抱歉，我无法回答..."）；3) 随着LVLM训练集不断扩大，模型无需检索就能回答许多问题，导致基准快速过时。
AI.method: 提出三个贡献：1) 动态数据筛选流程，通过过滤真正依赖检索的样本来保持基准难度；2) VLM-DeflectionBench基准，包含2,775个样本，涵盖多种多模态检索场景；3) 细粒度评估协议，包含四种场景，区分参数记忆与检索鲁棒性。
AI.result: 对20个最先进的LVLM进行实验，结果显示模型在面对噪声或误导性证据时通常无法正确偏转。结果强调了不仅需要评估模型知道什么，还需要评估它们在不知道时的行为。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个可重用、可扩展的基准测试，用于可靠的知识库视觉问答评估，突出了评估模型在不确定情况下行为的重要性。所有资源将在发表后公开。

title: Narrative-Driven Paper-to-Slide Generation via ArcDeck
summary: We introduce ArcDeck, a multi-agent framework that formulates paper-to-slide generation as a structured narrative reconstruction task. Unlike existing methods that directly summarize raw text into slides, ArcDeck explicitly models the source paper's logical flow. It first parses the input to construct a discourse tree and establish a global commitment document, ensuring the high-level intent is preserved. These structural priors then guide an iterative multi-agent refinement process, where specialized agents iteratively critique and revise the presentation outline before rendering the final visual layouts and designs. To evaluate our approach, we also introduce ArcBench, a newly curated benchmark of academic paper-slide pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that explicit discourse modeling, combined with role-specific agent coordination, significantly improves the narrative flow and logical coherence of the generated presentations.

AI.tldr: ArcDeck是一个多智能体框架，将论文转幻灯片任务建模为结构化叙事重建，通过话语树和全局承诺文档保留原文逻辑，再通过多智能体迭代优化生成演示文稿。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接将原始文本总结为幻灯片，缺乏对源论文逻辑流程的显式建模，导致生成的演示文稿叙事流和逻辑连贯性不足。
AI.method: 1. 解析输入构建话语树并建立全局承诺文档，保留高层次意图；2. 使用结构化先验指导迭代式多智能体精炼过程，专业智能体在渲染最终视觉布局前迭代批评和修订演示大纲。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，显式的话语建模结合角色特定的智能体协调，显著提高了生成演示文稿的叙事流和逻辑连贯性。作者还引入了ArcBench基准进行评估。
AI.conclusion: ArcDeck通过结构化叙事重建方法，在论文转幻灯片任务中实现了更好的逻辑连贯性和叙事质量，多智能体框架和显式话语建模是关键创新。

title: Ultra-low-light computer vision using trained photon correlations
summary: Illumination using correlated photon sources has been established as an approach to allowing high-fidelity images to be reconstructed from noisy camera frames by taking advantage of the knowledge that signal photons are spatially correlated whereas detector clicks due to noise are uncorrelated. However, in computer-vision tasks, the goal is often not ultimately to reconstruct an image, but to make inferences about a scene -- such as what object is present. Here we show how correlated-photon illumination can be used to gain an advantage in a hybrid optical-electronic computer-vision pipeline for object recognition. We demonstrate correlation-aware training (CAT): end-to-end optimization of a trainable correlated-photon illumination source and a Transformer backend in a way that the Transformer can learn to benefit from the correlations, using a small number (<= 100) of shots. We show a classification accuracy enhancement of up to 15 percentage points over conventional, uncorrelated-illumination-based computer vision in ultra-low-light and noisy imaging conditions, as well as an improvement over using untrained correlated-photon illumination. Our work illustrates how specializing to a computer-vision task -- object recognition -- and training the pattern of photon correlations in conjunction with a digital backend allows us to push the limits of accuracy in highly photon-budget-constrained scenarios beyond existing methods focused on image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种用于低光条件下物体识别的相关光子照明方法，通过端到端优化可训练相关光子光源和Transformer后端，在光子预算极低的情况下显著提升分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统相关光子照明主要用于图像重建，但在计算机视觉任务中，最终目标通常是场景推断而非图像重建。研究旨在探索如何利用相关光子照明在混合光电计算机视觉管道中获得优势，特别是在超低光和噪声条件下。
AI.method: 提出了相关感知训练（CAT）方法：端到端优化可训练相关光子照明源和Transformer后端，使Transformer能够从光子相关性中获益。该方法使用少量（≤100）拍摄次数，专门针对物体识别任务进行优化。
AI.result: 在超低光和噪声成像条件下，相比传统非相关照明计算机视觉方法，分类准确率提升高达15个百分点；相比未经训练的相关光子照明方法也有改进。该方法在光子预算极低的情况下超越了现有专注于图像重建的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过专门针对计算机视觉任务（物体识别）并联合训练光子相关模式和数字后端，可以在光子预算极低的情况下突破现有图像重建方法的限制，显著提升识别准确率。

title: Think Through Uncertainty: Improving Long-Form Generation Factuality via Reasoning Calibration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often hallucinate in long-form generation. Existing approaches mainly improve factuality through post-hoc revision or reinforcement learning (RL) with correctness-based rewards, but they do not teach the model to estimate which parts of its generation are reliable. As a result, models may still state incorrect claims confidently in their responses. Recent advances in reasoning have significantly improved LLM performance, and have been leveraged to estimate confidence by incorporating calibration into RL objectives. However, existing approaches remain limited to a single scalar confidence for the entire response, which is insufficient for long-form generation where uncertainty varies across individual claims. To mitigate this problem, we propose CURE, a framework that improves long-form factuality by teaching LLMs to reason about uncertainty at the claim level. We first introduce a Claim-Aware Reasoning Protocol, which structures outputs into atomic claims paired with explicit confidence estimates. We then develop a multi-stage training pipeline that aligns model confidence with claims' correctness and then optimizes on factuality. The resulting calibrated confidence further enables selective prediction, allowing the model to abstain from uncertain claims at inference time. Experiments on four long-form factuality benchmarks show that CURE consistently improves factual accuracy over competitive supervised and RL baselines, while maintaining factual recall. In particular, it improves claim-level accuracy by up to 39.9% on Biography generation. These gains are accompanied by improved calibration, as reflected by a 16.0% increase in AUROC on FactBench.

AI.tldr: CURE框架通过教LLM在声明级别进行不确定性推理来改善长文本生成的事实性，使用声明感知推理协议和多阶段训练管道，显著提升事实准确性和校准能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要通过后处理修正或基于正确性的强化学习来改善事实性，但未教会模型评估其生成内容的可靠性，导致模型仍可能自信地陈述错误声明。现有置信度评估仅限于整个响应的单一标量，不适用于长文本生成中不同声明的不确定性变化。
AI.method: 提出CURE框架：1) 引入声明感知推理协议，将输出结构化为原子声明与显式置信度估计的配对；2) 开发多阶段训练管道，首先对齐模型置信度与声明正确性，然后优化事实性；3) 利用校准后的置信度实现选择性预测，在推理时避免不确定声明。
AI.result: 在四个长文本事实性基准测试中，CURE始终优于竞争性的监督和强化学习基线，同时保持事实召回率。在传记生成任务中，声明级别准确率提升高达39.9%，在FactBench上AUROC提升16.0%，表明校准能力显著改善。
AI.conclusion: CURE框架通过声明级别的置信度校准和不确定性推理，有效解决了长文本生成中的幻觉问题，显著提升了事实准确性和模型校准能力，为LLM的长文本生成提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents perform strongly on short- and mid-horizon tasks, but often break down on long-horizon tasks that require extended, interdependent action sequences. Despite rapid progress in agentic systems, these long-horizon failures remain poorly characterized, hindering principled diagnosis and comparison across domains. To address this gap, we introduce HORIZON, an initial cross-domain diagnostic benchmark for systematically constructing tasks and analyzing long-horizon failure behaviors in LLM-based agents. Using HORIZON, we evaluate state-of-the-art (SOTA) agents from multiple model families (GPT-5 variants and Claude models), collecting 3100+ trajectories across four representative agentic domains to study horizon-dependent degradation patterns. We further propose a trajectory-grounded LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline for scalable and reproducible failure attribution, and validate it with human annotation on trajectories, achieving strong agreement (inter-annotator κ=0.61; human-judge κ=0.84). Our findings offer an initial methodological step toward systematic, cross-domain analysis of long-horizon agent failures and offer practical guidance for building more reliable long-horizon agents. We release our project website at \href{https://xwang2775.github.io/horizon-leaderboard/}{HORIZON Leaderboard} and welcome contributions from the community.

AI.tldr: HORIZON是一个用于诊断和分析LLM智能体在长视野任务中失败行为的跨领域基准测试框架，通过评估多个SOTA模型在四个代表性领域的3100+轨迹，揭示了视野依赖的退化模式，并提出了可扩展的轨迹基础LLM-as-a-Judge失败归因方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM智能体在短期和中期任务上表现良好，但在需要扩展、相互依赖动作序列的长视野任务中经常失败。这些长视野失败行为缺乏系统性的表征，阻碍了跨领域的诊断和比较，因此需要建立系统化的分析框架。
AI.method: 1. 引入HORIZON跨领域诊断基准，用于系统构建任务和分析LLM智能体的长视野失败行为；2. 评估多个模型家族（GPT-5变体和Claude模型）的SOTA智能体，收集四个代表性领域的3100+轨迹；3. 提出轨迹基础的LLM-as-a-Judge管道，用于可扩展和可重复的失败归因，并通过人工标注验证其有效性。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了LLM智能体在长视野任务中的视野依赖退化模式；2. LLM-as-a-Judge管道与人工标注达成强一致性（标注者间κ=0.61；人工-判断者κ=0.84）；3. 建立了系统化的长视野失败分析框架，为构建更可靠的长视野智能体提供实践指导。
AI.conclusion: HORIZON为系统化、跨领域分析长视野智能体失败提供了初步方法论步骤，并为构建更可靠的长视野智能体提供了实践指导。研究团队发布了项目网站并欢迎社区贡献。

title: Empirical Evaluation of PDF Parsing and Chunking for Financial Question Answering with RAG
summary: PDF files are primarily intended for human reading rather than automated processing. In addition, the heterogeneous content of PDFs, such as text, tables, and images, poses significant challenges for parsing and information extraction. To address these difficulties, both practitioners and researchers are increasingly developing new methods, including the promising Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to automated PDF processing. However, there is no comprehensive study investigating how different components and design choices affect the performance of a RAG system for understanding PDFs. In this paper, we propose such a study (1) by focusing on Question Answering, a specific language understanding task, and (2) by leveraging two benchmarks from the financial domain, including TableQuest, our newly generated, publicly available benchmark. We systematically examine multiple PDF parsers and chunking strategies (with varied overlap), along with their potential synergies in preserving document structure and ensuring answer correctness. Overall, our results offer practical guidelines for building robust RAG pipelines for PDF understanding.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了RAG系统在PDF文档理解中的不同组件和设计选择对性能的影响，特别关注金融领域的问答任务。
AI.motivation: PDF文件主要为人类阅读设计而非自动化处理，其异构内容（文本、表格、图像）给解析和信息提取带来重大挑战。虽然RAG系统在自动化PDF处理方面显示出前景，但缺乏关于不同组件和设计选择如何影响PDF理解性能的全面研究。
AI.method: 通过专注于问答这一特定语言理解任务，并利用金融领域的两个基准（包括新生成的公开基准TableQuest），系统性地研究了多种PDF解析器和分块策略（具有不同重叠度），以及它们在保留文档结构和确保答案正确性方面的潜在协同作用。
AI.result: 研究结果为构建稳健的PDF理解RAG管道提供了实用指南，系统评估了不同组件组合对性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了RAG系统在PDF理解方面缺乏系统性评估的空白，为从业者提供了构建有效PDF处理系统的实用指导原则。

title: When to Forget: A Memory Governance Primitive
summary: Agent memory systems accumulate experience but currently lack a principled operational metric for memory quality governance -- deciding which memories to trust, suppress, or deprecate as the agent's task distribution shifts. Write-time importance scores are static; dynamic management systems use LLM judgment or structural heuristics rather than outcome feedback. This paper proposes Memory Worth (MW): a two-counter per-memory signal that tracks how often a memory co-occurs with successful versus failed outcomes, providing a lightweight, theoretically grounded foundation for staleness detection, retrieval suppression, and deprecation decisions. We prove that MW converges almost surely to the conditional success probability p+(m) = Pr[y_t = +1 | m in M_t] -- the probability of task success given that memory m is retrieved -- under a stationary retrieval regime with a minimum exploration condition. Importantly, p+(m) is an associational quantity, not a causal one: it measures outcome co-occurrence rather than causal contribution. We argue this is still a useful operational signal for memory governance, and we validate it empirically in a controlled synthetic environment where ground-truth utility is known: after 10,000 episodes, the Spearman rank-correlation between Memory Worth and true utilities reaches rho = 0.89 +/- 0.02 across 20 independent seeds, compared to rho = 0.00 for systems that never update their assessments. A retrieval-realistic micro-experiment with real text and neural embedding retrieval (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) further shows stale memories crossing the low-value threshold (MW = 0.17) while specialist memories remain high-value (MW = 0.77) across 3,000 episodes. The estimator requires only two scalar counters per memory unit and can be added to architectures that already log retrievals and episode outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Memory Worth（MW）作为智能体记忆质量的评估指标，通过追踪记忆与成功/失败结果的共现频率，为记忆管理提供理论基础。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体记忆系统缺乏对记忆质量进行原则性管理的操作指标，无法随着任务分布变化而决定哪些记忆值得信任、抑制或废弃。现有的写入时重要性评分是静态的，动态管理系统则依赖LLM判断或结构启发式而非结果反馈。
AI.method: 提出Memory Worth（MW）指标：为每个记忆维护两个计数器，分别追踪该记忆与成功结果和失败结果的共现频率。该指标在平稳检索机制和最小探索条件下，几乎必然收敛于条件成功概率p+(m) = Pr[y_t = +1 | m in M_t]。
AI.result: 在受控合成环境中，经过10,000次实验，Memory Worth与真实效用的Spearman秩相关系数达到ρ=0.89±0.02，而从不更新评估的系统相关系数为0.00。在真实文本和神经嵌入检索的微实验中，陈旧记忆的MW值降至0.17，而专业记忆的MW值保持在0.77。
AI.conclusion: Memory Worth提供了一个轻量级、理论基础的记忆质量评估框架，能够有效检测陈旧记忆、指导检索抑制和废弃决策，且每个记忆单元仅需两个标量计数器，易于集成到现有架构中。

title: TIPSv2: Advancing Vision-Language Pretraining with Enhanced Patch-Text Alignment
summary: Recent progress in vision-language pretraining has enabled significant improvements to many downstream computer vision applications, such as classification, retrieval, segmentation and depth prediction. However, a fundamental capability that these models still struggle with is aligning dense patch representations with text embeddings of corresponding concepts. In this work, we investigate this critical issue and propose novel techniques to enhance this capability in foundational vision-language models. First, we reveal that a patch-level distillation procedure significantly boosts dense patch-text alignment -- surprisingly, the patch-text alignment of the distilled student model strongly surpasses that of the teacher model. This observation inspires us to consider modifications to pretraining recipes, leading us to propose iBOT++, an upgrade to the commonly-used iBOT masked image objective, where unmasked tokens also contribute directly to the loss. This dramatically enhances patch-text alignment of pretrained models. Additionally, to improve vision-language pretraining efficiency and effectiveness, we modify the exponential moving average setup in the learning recipe, and introduce a caption sampling strategy to benefit from synthetic captions at different granularities. Combining these components, we develop TIPSv2, a new family of image-text encoder models suitable for a wide range of downstream applications. Through comprehensive experiments on 9 tasks and 20 datasets, we demonstrate strong performance, generally on par with or better than recent vision encoder models. Code and models are released via our project page at https://gdm-tipsv2.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: TIPSv2通过改进视觉语言预训练中的密集补丁-文本对齐能力，提出iBOT++目标函数、EMA优化和字幕采样策略，在多个下游任务上达到或超越现有视觉编码器模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言预训练模型在密集补丁表示与文本嵌入对齐方面仍存在困难，这限制了模型在下游任务中的表现。本文旨在解决这一关键问题，提升基础视觉语言模型的对齐能力。
AI.method: 1. 发现补丁级蒸馏能显著提升密集补丁-文本对齐，学生模型甚至超越教师模型；2. 提出iBOT++，改进iBOT掩码图像目标，让未掩码标记也直接贡献损失；3. 修改指数移动平均设置优化训练效率；4. 引入字幕采样策略，利用不同粒度的合成字幕。
AI.result: 在9个任务和20个数据集上的综合实验表明，TIPSv2模型家族表现强劲，通常与最近的视觉编码器模型相当或更好，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过改进密集补丁-文本对齐能力，TIPSv2为广泛的下游应用提供了新的图像-文本编码器模型，代码和模型已开源。

title: Identity as Attractor: Geometric Evidence for Persistent Agent Architecture in LLM Activation Space
summary: Large language models map semantically related prompts to similar internal representations -- a phenomenon interpretable as attractor-like dynamics. We ask whether the identity document of a persistent cognitive agent (its cognitive_core) exhibits analogous attractor-like behavior. We present a controlled experiment on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, comparing hidden states of an original cognitive_core (Condition A), seven paraphrases (Condition B), and seven structurally matched controls (Condition C). Mean-pooled states at layers 8, 16, and 24 show that paraphrases converge to a tighter cluster than controls (Cohen's d > 1.88, p < 10^{-27}, Bonferroni-corrected). Replication on Gemma 2 9B confirms cross-architecture generalizability. Ablations suggest the effect is primarily semantic rather than structural, and that structural completeness appears necessary to reach the attractor region. An exploratory experiment shows that reading a scientific description of the agent shifts internal state toward the attractor -- closer than a sham preprint -- distinguishing knowing about an identity from operating as that identity. These results provide representational evidence that agent identity documents induce attractor-like geometry in LLM activation space.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验证明，大语言模型中的认知代理身份文档会在激活空间中形成类似吸引子的几何结构，语义相关的表述会收敛到比结构匹配控制组更紧密的簇中。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索大语言模型中持久认知代理的身份文档（cognitive_core）是否表现出类似吸引子的行为，即语义相关的提示是否会被映射到相似的内部表示，类似于大语言模型中观察到的吸引子动力学现象。
AI.method: 在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型上进行控制实验，比较原始认知核心（条件A）、七个语义改写（条件B）和七个结构匹配控制组（条件C）的隐藏状态。在第8、16、24层进行平均池化，使用Cohen's d效应量和p值统计显著性检验。在Gemma 2 9B模型上复制实验验证跨架构普适性，并进行消融实验分析语义和结构因素的影响。
AI.result: 语义改写的隐藏状态比结构匹配控制组收敛到更紧密的簇（Cohen's d > 1.88，p < 10^{-27}，Bonferroni校正）。在Gemma 2 9B上成功复制，证明跨架构普适性。消融实验表明效应主要是语义驱动而非结构驱动，但结构完整性似乎是到达吸引子区域的必要条件。探索性实验显示，阅读科学描述会使内部状态向吸引子移动，比虚假预印本更接近，区分了"了解身份"和"作为身份操作"。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了表征证据，表明代理身份文档会在LLM激活空间中诱导类似吸引子的几何结构，语义相关的表述会收敛到相似的内部表示区域，这有助于理解大语言模型中认知代理身份的形成和表征机制。

title: Curvelet-Based Frequency-Aware Feature Enhancement for Deepfake Detection
summary: The proliferation of sophisticated generative models has significantly advanced the realism of synthetic facial content, known as deepfakes, raising serious concerns about digital trust. Although modern deep learning-based detectors perform well, many rely on spatial-domain features that degrade under compression. This limitation has prompted a shift toward integrating frequency-domain representations with deep learning to improve robustness. Prior research has explored frequency transforms such as Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and Wavelet Transform, among others. However, to the best of our knowledge, the Curvelet Transform, despite its superior directional and multiscale properties, remains entirely unexplored in the context of deepfake detection. In this work, we introduce a novel Curvelet-based detection approach that enhances feature quality through wedge-level attention and scale-aware spatial masking, both trained to selectively emphasize discriminative frequency components. The refined frequency cues are reconstructed and passed to a modified pretrained Xception network for classification. Evaluated on two compression qualities in the challenging FaceForensics++ dataset, our method achieves 98.48% accuracy and 99.96% AUC on FF++ low compression, while maintaining strong performance under high compression, demonstrating the efficacy and interpretability of Curvelet-informed forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于曲波变换的深度伪造检测新方法，通过楔形注意力和尺度感知空间掩码增强特征质量，在FaceForensics++数据集上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 随着生成模型的快速发展，深度伪造内容的真实性显著提高，对数字信任构成严重威胁。现有的深度学习检测器虽然性能良好，但大多依赖空间域特征，在压缩条件下性能会下降。虽然已有研究探索了DCT、FFT和小波变换等频域表示，但具有优越方向性和多尺度特性的曲波变换在深度伪造检测领域尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的基于曲波变换的检测方法：1）使用曲波变换获取频域表示；2）通过楔形级注意力和尺度感知空间掩码来增强特征质量，这些组件经过训练以选择性地强调判别性频率分量；3）将精炼的频率线索重构后传递给改进的预训练Xception网络进行分类。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++数据集上评估，在低压缩质量下达到98.48%的准确率和99.96%的AUC，在高压缩条件下仍保持强劲性能，证明了曲波变换在伪造检测中的有效性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 曲波变换在深度伪造检测中具有显著潜力，其方向性和多尺度特性能够提供更丰富的频域特征，结合注意力和掩码机制可以显著提升检测性能，特别是在压缩条件下的鲁棒性。

title: LoSA: Locality Aware Sparse Attention for Block-Wise Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) generate multiple tokens in any order, offering a promising alternative to the autoregressive decoding pipeline. However, they still remain bottlenecked by memory-bound attention in long-context scenarios. Naive sparse attention fails on DLMs due to a KV Inflation problem, where different queries select different prefix positions, making the union of accessed KV pages large. To address this, we observe that between consecutive denoising steps, only a small fraction of active tokens exhibit significant hidden-state changes, while the majority of stable tokens remain nearly constant. Based on this insight, we propose LOSA (Locality-aware Sparse Attention), which reuses cached prefix-attention results for stable tokens and applies sparse attention only to active tokens. This substantially shrinks the number of KV indices that must be loaded, yielding both higher speedup and higher accuracy. Across multiple block-wise DLMs and benchmarks, LOSA preserves near-dense accuracy while significantly improving efficiency, achieving up to +9 points in average accuracy at aggressive sparsity levels while maintaining 1.54x lower attention density. It also achieves up to 4.14x attention speedup on RTX A6000 GPUs, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: LOSA是一种针对块式扩散语言模型的局部感知稀疏注意力机制，通过重用稳定token的缓存前缀注意力结果，仅对活跃token应用稀疏注意力，显著提升长上下文场景下的效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 块式扩散语言模型在长上下文场景中仍受限于内存绑定的注意力机制，传统稀疏注意力方法因KV膨胀问题而失效，需要新的解决方案来提升效率。
AI.method: 提出LOSA方法，基于连续去噪步骤中只有少量活跃token隐藏状态发生显著变化的观察，重用稳定token的缓存前缀注意力结果，仅对活跃token应用稀疏注意力，减少需要加载的KV索引数量。
AI.result: 在多个块式扩散语言模型和基准测试中，LOSA在保持接近密集注意力准确性的同时显著提升效率，在激进稀疏级别下平均准确率提升高达9个点，注意力密度降低1.54倍，在RTX A6000 GPU上实现高达4.14倍的注意力加速。
AI.conclusion: LOSA通过利用扩散语言模型中token状态的局部性特征，有效解决了KV膨胀问题，为块式扩散语言模型在长上下文场景中的高效推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs
summary: Visual token pruning is a widely used strategy for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but existing work mainly evaluates it with task accuracy. In this paper, we study how visual token pruning affects model calibration, that is, whether predicted confidence matches actual correctness. Using LLaVA-1.5-7B on POPE and ScienceQA-IMG, we evaluate Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and AURC under several pruning strategies, including SCOPE with different saliency weights, saliency-only pruning, FastV, and random pruning, across multiple token budgets. Our results show that pruning does not simply trade reliability for efficiency. On POPE, a pure-coverage setting in SCOPE achieves substantially lower ECE than the full unpruned model while maintaining similar accuracy. An internal alpha-sweep further shows a consistent trend: reducing the saliency weight improves calibration at all tested token budgets, while accuracy changes only slightly. In contrast, saliency-based pruning leads to worse calibration, and real FastV causes severe performance degradation in our setting. On ScienceQA-IMG, pruning also reduces ECE, with accuracy remaining stable or slightly improving. We additionally study the gap power exponent in coverage-based selection and find that its default setting is not always optimal. Overall, our results suggest that visual token pruning should be evaluated not only by accuracy, but also by confidence quality, especially for multimodal systems that need reliable decisions.

AI.tldr: 视觉token剪枝不仅影响多模态大语言模型的效率，还会显著影响模型校准质量，在某些情况下甚至能改善校准误差
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注视觉token剪枝对任务准确率的影响，但缺乏对其如何影响模型校准（预测置信度与实际正确性的匹配程度）的系统研究
AI.method: 使用LLaVA-1.5-7B模型，在POPE和ScienceQA-IMG数据集上评估多种剪枝策略（包括SCOPE的不同显著性权重、纯显著性剪枝、FastV和随机剪枝）对预期校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数和AURC的影响
AI.result: 在POPE数据集上，SCOPE的纯覆盖策略显著降低了ECE，同时保持相似准确率；降低显著性权重在所有测试的token预算下都能改善校准，而准确率变化很小；显著性剪枝导致校准变差，FastV在实验设置中导致严重性能下降。在ScienceQA-IMG上，剪枝也降低了ECE，准确率保持稳定或略有提升
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝不应仅通过准确率评估，还应考虑置信度质量，特别是对于需要可靠决策的多模态系统；覆盖度选择中的gap power exponent默认设置并非总是最优

title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems
summary: Robust explanations are increasingly required for user trust in enterprise NLP, yet pre-deployment validation is difficult in the common case of black-box deployment (API-only access) where representation-based explainers are infeasible and existing studies provide limited guidance on whether explanations remain stable under real user noise, especially when organizations migrate from encoder classifiers to decoder LLMs. To close this gap, we propose a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion, and operationalize explanation robustness with top-token flip rate under realistic perturbations (swap, deletion, shuffling, and back-translation) at multiple severity levels. Using this protocol, we conduct a systematic cross-architecture comparison across three benchmark datasets and six models spanning encoder and decoder families (BERT, RoBERTa, Qwen 7B/14B, Llama 8B/70B; 64,800 cases). We find that decoder LLMs produce substantially more stable explanations than encoder baselines (73% lower flip rates on average), and that stability improves with model scale (44% gain from 7B to 70B). Finally, we relate robustness improvements to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的黑盒鲁棒性评估框架，用于评估token级解释在真实用户噪声下的稳定性，通过跨架构比较发现解码器LLM比编码器基线产生更稳定的解释，且稳定性随模型规模提升。
AI.motivation: 在企业NLP应用中，用户对可解释性的需求日益增长，但在黑盒部署（仅API访问）场景下，预部署验证困难，现有研究缺乏对真实用户噪声下解释稳定性的指导，特别是在从编码器分类器迁移到解码器LLM时。
AI.method: 提出基于留一遮挡的统一黑盒鲁棒性评估框架，通过现实扰动（替换、删除、重排和回译）在多个严重级别下，使用top-token翻转率来操作化解释鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集和六个模型（BERT、RoBERTa、Qwen 7B/14B、Llama 8B/70B；64,800个案例）上的系统跨架构比较显示：解码器LLM比编码器基线产生显著更稳定的解释（平均翻转率降低73%），且稳定性随模型规模提升（从7B到70B提升44%）。
AI.conclusion: 将鲁棒性改进与推理成本关联，产生实用的成本-鲁棒性权衡曲线，支持在合规敏感应用部署前进行模型和解释选择。

title: WiseOWL: A Methodology for Evaluating Ontological Descriptiveness and Semantic Correctness for Ontology Reuse and Ontology Recommendations
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to a conference
summary: The Semantic Web standardizes concept meaning for humans and machines, enabling machine-operable content and consistent interpretation that improves advanced analytics. Reusing ontologies speeds development and enforces consistency, yet selecting the optimal choice is challenging because authors lack systematic selection criteria and often rely on intuition that is difficult to justify, limiting reuse. To solve this, WiseOWL is proposed, a methodology with scoring and guidance to select ontologies for reuse. It scores four metrics: (i) Well-Described, measuring documentation coverage; (ii) Well-Defined, using state-of-the-art embeddings to assess label-definition alignment; (iii) Connection, capturing structural interconnectedness; and (iv) Hierarchical Breadth, reflecting hierarchical balance. WiseOWL outputs normalized 0-10 scores with actionable feedback. Implemented as a Streamlit app, it ingests OWL format, converts to RDF Turtle, and provides interactive visualizations. Evaluation across six ontologies, including the Plant Ontology (PO), Gene Ontology (GO), Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO), Food Ontology (FoodON), Dublin Core (DC), and GoodRelations, demonstrates promising effectiveness.

AI.tldr: WiseOWL是一种帮助选择语义网本体进行重用的方法论，通过四个指标评分并提供指导，以解决本体选择缺乏系统标准的问题。
AI.motivation: 语义网标准化概念含义，使机器可操作内容，但重用本体时缺乏系统选择标准，作者往往依赖难以证明的直觉，限制了本体重用。
AI.method: 提出WiseOWL方法论，包含四个评分指标：良好描述（文档覆盖度）、良好定义（使用最先进嵌入评估标签-定义对齐）、连接性（结构互连性）和层次广度（层次平衡性）。实现为Streamlit应用，输入OWL格式，转换为RDF Turtle，提供交互可视化。
AI.result: 在六个本体（植物本体PO、基因本体GO、语义科学集成本体SIO、食物本体FoodON、都柏林核心DC和GoodRelations）上评估，显示出有前景的有效性。
AI.conclusion: WiseOWL通过系统评分和指导，帮助用户选择最适合重用的本体，解决了本体选择缺乏标准的问题，促进了语义网本体的有效重用。

title: Privacy-Preserving Structureless Visual Localization via Image Obfuscation
summary: Visual localization is the task of estimating the camera pose of an image relative to a scene representation. In practice, visual localization systems are often cloud-based. Naturally, this raises privacy concerns in terms of revealing private details through the images sent to the server or through the representations stored on the server. Privacy-preserving localization aims to avoid such leakage of private details. However, the resulting localization approaches are significantly more complex, slower, and less accurate than their non-privacy-preserving counterparts. In this paper, we consider structureless localization methods in the context of privacy preservation. Structureless methods represent the scene through a set of reference images with known camera poses and intrinsics. In contrast to existing methods proposing representations that are as privacy-preserving as possible, we study a simple image obfuscation approach based on common image operations, e.g., replacing RGB images with (semantic) segmentations. We show that existing structureless pipelines do not need any special adjustments, as modern feature matchers can match obfuscated images out of the box. The results are easy-to-implement pipelines that can ensure both the privacy of the query images and the scene representations. Detailed experiments on multiple datasets show that the resulting methods achieve state-of-the-art pose accuracy for privacy-preserving approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉定位中的隐私保护问题，提出使用图像模糊化技术（如语义分割）替代原始RGB图像，无需修改现有无结构定位流程即可实现隐私保护，在保持高定位精度的同时保护查询图像和场景表示的隐私。
AI.motivation: 云端视觉定位系统存在隐私泄露风险，现有隐私保护方法复杂、速度慢且精度低。本文旨在探索简单有效的隐私保护方案，特别是针对无结构定位方法。
AI.method: 采用图像模糊化技术，如将RGB图像替换为语义分割图等常见图像操作。无需修改现有无结构定位流程，现代特征匹配器可直接处理模糊化图像。构建了易于实现的隐私保护定位流程。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的详细实验表明，该方法在隐私保护定位方法中达到了最先进的姿态估计精度，同时保护了查询图像和场景表示的隐私。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的图像模糊化技术，可以在不牺牲定位精度的前提下实现有效的隐私保护，为隐私保护视觉定位提供了实用且易于部署的解决方案。

title: Narrative over Numbers: The Identifiable Victim Effect and its Amplification Under Alignment and Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: The Identifiable Victim Effect (IVE) $-$ the tendency to allocate greater resources to a specific, narratively described victim than to a statistically characterized group facing equivalent hardship $-$ is one of the most robust findings in moral psychology and behavioural economics. As large language models (LLMs) assume consequential roles in humanitarian triage, automated grant evaluation, and content moderation, a critical question arises: do these systems inherit the affective irrationalities present in human moral reasoning? We present the first systematic, large-scale empirical investigation of the IVE in LLMs, comprising N=51,955 validated API trials across 16 frontier models spanning nine organizational lineages (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, DeepSeek, xAI, Alibaba, IBM, and Moonshot). Using a suite of ten experiments $-$ porting and extending canonical paradigms from Small et al. (2007) and Kogut and Ritov (2005) $-$ we find that the IVE is prevalent but strongly modulated by alignment training. Instruction-tuned models exhibit extreme IVE (Cohen's d up to 1.56), while reasoning-specialized models invert the effect (down to d=-0.85). The pooled effect (d=0.223, p=2e-6) is approximately twice the single-victim human meta-analytic baseline (d$\approx$0.10) reported by Lee and Feeley (2016) $-$ and likely exceeds the overall human pooled effect by a larger margin, given that the group-victim human effect is near zero. Standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting $-$ contrary to its role as a deliberative corrective $-$ nearly triples the IVE effect size (from d=0.15 to d=0.41), while only utilitarian CoT reliably eliminates it. We further document psychophysical numbing, perfect quantity neglect, and marginal in-group/out-group cultural bias, with implications for AI deployment in humanitarian and ethical decision-making contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型存在明显的可识别受害者效应，其强度受对齐训练影响：指令微调模型表现出极端IVE，而推理专用模型则反转该效应，总体效应约为人类的两倍。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在人道主义分流、自动资助评估和内容审核中扮演重要角色，需要探究这些系统是否继承了人类道德推理中的情感非理性，特别是可识别受害者效应这一道德心理学和行为经济学中最稳健的发现。
AI.method: 对16个前沿模型进行大规模实证研究（N=51,955个验证API试验），涵盖9个组织谱系。使用10个实验，移植并扩展Small等人（2007）和Kogut与Ritov（2005）的经典范式，测量不同模型中的IVE表现。
AI.result: IVE在LLMs中普遍存在但受对齐训练强烈调节：指令微调模型表现出极端IVE（Cohen's d高达1.56），推理专用模型则反转该效应（低至d=-0.85）。总体效应（d=0.223）约为人类单受害者元分析基线（d≈0.10）的两倍。标准思维链提示反而使IVE效应增加近三倍，只有功利主义思维链能可靠消除该效应。
AI.conclusion: LLMs确实继承了人类的可识别受害者效应，且在某些情况下比人类更强烈。这对AI在人道主义和伦理决策环境中的部署具有重要意义，需要开发缓解策略以确保公平的资源分配。

title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems
comment: 41 pages, 1 table. Preprint v3.642. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19501651
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation remains the dominant pattern for giving LLMs persistent memory, but a visible cluster of personal wiki-style memory architectures emerged in April 2026 -- design proposals from Karpathy, MemPalace, and LLM Wiki v2 that compile knowledge into an interlinked artifact for long-term use by a single user. They sit alongside production memory systems that the major labs have shipped for over a year, and an active academic lineage including MemGPT, Generative Agents, Mem0, Zep, A-Mem, MemMachine, SleepGate, and Second Me. Within a 2026 landscape of emerging governance frameworks for agent context and memory -- including Context Cartography and MemOS -- this paper proposes a companion-specific governance profile: a set of normative obligations, a time-structured procedural rule, and testable conformance invariants for the specific failure mode of entrenchment under user-coupled drift in single-user knowledge wikis built on the LLM wiki pattern.
  The design principle is that personal LLM memory is a companion system: its job is to mirror the user on operational dimensions (working vocabulary, load-bearing structure, continuity of context) and compensate on epistemic failure modes (entrenchment, suppression of contradicting evidence, Kuhnian ossification). Five operations implement this split -- TRIAGE, DECAY, CONTEXTUALIZE, CONSOLIDATE, AUDIT -- supported by memory gravity and minority-hypothesis retention. The sharpest prediction: accumulated contradictory evidence should have a structural path to updating a centrality-protected dominant interpretation through multi-cycle buffer pressure accumulation, a failure mode no existing benchmark captures. The safety story at the single-agent level is partial, and the paper is explicit about what it does and does not solve.

AI.tldr: 论文提出针对个人LLM知识wiki系统的治理框架，解决用户耦合漂移导致的固化问题，通过五个操作实现伴侣式记忆系统设计。
AI.motivation: 当前检索增强生成是LLM持久记忆的主要模式，但2026年出现了个人wiki式记忆架构集群。这些单用户知识wiki系统面临用户耦合漂移导致的固化风险，需要专门的治理框架来确保记忆系统既能反映用户操作维度，又能补偿认知失败模式。
AI.method: 提出伴侣式治理框架，包含规范性义务、时间结构化程序规则和可测试的一致性不变式。通过五个核心操作实现：TRIAGE（分类）、DECAY（衰减）、CONTEXTUALIZE（情境化）、CONSOLIDATE（巩固）、AUDIT（审计），辅以记忆重力和少数假设保留机制。
AI.result: 框架的核心预测是：积累的矛盾证据应通过多周期缓冲区压力积累，具有结构性路径来更新受中心性保护的主导解释。这一失败模式是现有基准测试未能捕捉的。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了针对单用户LLM知识wiki系统的伴侣式治理框架，部分解决了单智能体层面的安全问题，并明确说明了框架能解决和不能解决的问题范围。

title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA
summary: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 3,634 H&E-stained whole-slide images across five cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, liver, and lung cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. OpenTME is available for non-commercial academic research on Hugging Face. We will continue to expand OpenTME over time and anticipate it will serve as a resource for biomarker discovery, spatial biology research, and the development of computational methods for TME analysis.

AI.tldr: OpenTME是一个基于AI的开放数据集，包含5种癌症类型的3634张H&E染色全切片图像的肿瘤微环境定量分析结果，提供超过4500个细胞级定量指标。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤微环境在癌症进展和治疗反应中起关键作用，但目前从常规H&E染色病理切片进行大规模、一致且定量的TME表征仍然缺乏。
AI.method: 使用基于Atlas病理基础模型构建的AI应用Atlas H&E-TME，对TCGA中的3634张H&E染色全切片图像进行处理，包括组织质量控制、组织分割、细胞检测分类和空间邻域分析。
AI.result: 创建了OpenTME开放数据集，涵盖膀胱癌、乳腺癌、结直肠癌、肝癌和肺癌五种癌症类型，每张切片提供超过4500个细胞级分辨率的定量指标。
AI.conclusion: OpenTME可作为生物标志物发现、空间生物学研究和TME分析计算方法开发的资源，未来将继续扩展该数据集。

title: Temporal Flattening in LLM-Generated Text: Comparing Human and LLM Writing Trajectories
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures. To appear in Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in daily applications, from content generation to code writing, where each interaction treats the model as stateless, generating responses independently without memory. Yet human writing is inherently longitudinal: authors' styles and cognitive states evolve across months and years. This raises a central question: can LLMs reproduce such temporal structure across extended time periods? We construct and publicly release a longitudinal dataset of 412 human authors and 6,086 documents spanning 2012--2024 across three domains (academic abstracts, blogs, news) and compare them to trajectories generated by three representative LLMs under standard and history-conditioned generation settings. Using drift and variance-based metrics over semantic, lexical, and cognitive-emotional representations, we find temporal flattening in LLM-generated text. LLMs produce greater lexical diversity but exhibit substantially reduced semantic and cognitive-emotional drift relative to humans. These differences are highly predictive: temporal variability patterns alone achieve 94% accuracy and 98% ROC-AUC in distinguishing human from LLM trajectories. Our results demonstrate that temporal flattening persists regardless of whether LLMs generate independently or with access to incremental history, revealing a fundamental property of current deployment paradigms. This gap has direct implications for applications requiring authentic temporal structure, such as synthetic training data and longitudinal text modeling.

AI.tldr: LLMs生成的文本在时间维度上存在"时间扁平化"现象，相比人类作者，LLM文本在语义和认知情感上的时间变化显著减少，尽管词汇多样性更高。
AI.motivation: 人类写作具有纵向特性，作者风格和认知状态会随时间演变，而当前LLMs通常被视为无状态的独立响应生成器。研究旨在探究LLMs能否在长时间跨度上再现人类写作的时间结构。
AI.method: 构建并公开了包含412名人类作者、6,086份文档（2012-2024年）的纵向数据集，涵盖学术摘要、博客、新闻三个领域。比较了三种代表性LLMs在标准和历史条件生成设置下生成的轨迹，使用基于漂移和方差的指标分析语义、词汇和认知情感表示。
AI.result: 发现LLM生成文本存在时间扁平化：虽然LLMs产生更大的词汇多样性，但在语义和认知情感漂移方面显著低于人类。仅基于时间变异模式就能以94%准确率和98% ROC-AUC区分人类和LLM轨迹。这种差异在独立生成和历史条件生成设置下都持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs部署范式存在时间扁平化的根本特性，这对需要真实时间结构的应用（如合成训练数据和纵向文本建模）有直接影响，表明LLMs在再现人类写作的时间演变方面存在局限性。

title: INST-Align: Implicit Neural Alignment for Spatial Transcriptomics via Canonical Expression Fields
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to MICCAI 2026
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures mRNA expression while preserving spatial organization, but multi-slice analysis faces two coupled difficulties: large non-rigid deformations across slices and inter-slice batch effects when alignment and integration are treated independently. We present INST-Align, an unsupervised pairwise framework that couples a coordinate-based deformation network with a shared Canonical Expression Field, an implicit neural representation mapping spatial coordinates to expression embeddings, for joint alignment and reconstruction. A two-phase training strategy first establishes a stable canonical embedding space and then jointly optimizes deformation and spatial-feature matching, enabling mutually constrained alignment and representation learning. Cross-slice parameter sharing of the canonical field regularizes ambiguous correspondences and absorbs batch variation. Across nine datasets, INST-Align achieves state-of-the-art mean OT Accuracy (0.702), NN Accuracy (0.719), and Chamfer distance, with Chamfer reductions of up to 94.9\% on large-deformation sections relative to the strongest baseline. The framework also yields biologically meaningful spatial embeddings and coherent 3D tissue reconstruction. The code will be released after review phase.

AI.tldr: INST-Align是一个无监督的成对框架，通过耦合基于坐标的变形网络和共享的规范表达场，实现空间转录组学多切片数据的联合对齐与重建，解决了大变形和批次效应的耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学（ST）在保持空间组织的同时测量mRNA表达，但多切片分析面临两个耦合的困难：切片间的大非刚性变形，以及当对齐和整合被独立处理时出现的切片间批次效应。
AI.method: 提出INST-Align框架，包含：1）基于坐标的变形网络；2）共享的规范表达场（隐式神经表示，将空间坐标映射到表达嵌入）；3）两阶段训练策略：先建立稳定的规范嵌入空间，然后联合优化变形和空间特征匹配。
AI.result: 在九个数据集上，INST-Align实现了最先进的平均OT准确率（0.702）、NN准确率（0.719）和Chamfer距离，在大变形切片上Chamfer距离相比最强基线减少了94.9%。该框架还产生了生物学上有意义的空间嵌入和连贯的3D组织重建。
AI.conclusion: INST-Align通过耦合变形网络和共享规范表达场，实现了空间转录组学多切片数据的联合对齐与重建，有效解决了大变形和批次效应的耦合问题，为3D组织重建提供了有力工具。

title: When Self-Reference Fails to Close: Matrix-Level Dynamics in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate how self-referential inputs alter the internal matrix dynamics of large language models. Measuring 106 scalar metrics across up to 7 analysis passes on four models from three architecture families -- Qwen3-VL-8B, Llama-3.2-11B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Gemma-2-9B -- over 300 prompts in a 14-level hierarchy at three temperatures ($T \in \{0.0, 0.3, 0.7\}$), we find that self-reference alone is not destabilizing: grounded self-referential statements and meta-cognitive prompts are markedly more stable than paradoxical self-reference on key collapse-related metrics, and on several such metrics can be as stable as factual controls. Instability concentrates in prompts inducing non-closing truth recursion (NCTR) -- truth-value computations with no finite-depth resolution. NCTR prompts produce anomalously elevated attention effective rank -- indicating attention reorganization with global dispersion rather than simple concentration collapse -- and key metrics reach Cohen's $d = 3.14$ (attention effective rank) to $3.52$ (variance kurtosis) vs. stable self-reference in the 70B model; 281/397 metric-model combinations differentiate NCTR from stable self-reference after FDR correction ($q < 0.05$), 198 with $|d| > 0.8$. Per-layer SVD confirms disruption at every sampled layer ($d > +1.0$ in all three models analyzed), ruling out aggregation artifacts. A classifier achieves AUC $0.81$-$0.90$; 30 minimal pairs yield 42/387 significant combinations; 43/106 metrics replicate across all four models. We connect these observations to three classical matrix-semigroup problems and propose, as a conjecture, that NCTR forces finite-depth transformers toward dynamical regimes where these problems concentrate. NCTR prompts also produce elevated contradictory output ($+34$-$56$ percentage points vs. controls), suggesting practical relevance for understanding self-referential failure modes.

AI.tldr: 研究自指输入如何改变大语言模型的内部矩阵动态，发现基础自指和元认知提示比矛盾自指更稳定，不闭合真值递归(NCTR)提示会导致异常的内部动态变化
AI.motivation: 探究自指输入对大型语言模型内部矩阵动态的影响，特别是理解自指如何导致模型内部表示的不稳定性
AI.method: 对4个不同架构的模型(Qwen3-VL-8B, Llama-3.2-11B, Llama-3.3-70B, Gemma-2-9B)进行大规模分析，测量106个标量指标，在300个提示的14级层次结构中，在三个温度下进行最多7次分析传递
AI.result: 发现自指本身并不总是破坏稳定：基础自指和元认知提示比矛盾自指更稳定；不闭合真值递归(NCTR)提示导致异常高的注意力有效秩和方差峰度；281/397的指标-模型组合能区分NCTR与稳定自指；分类器AUC达到0.81-0.90；NCTR提示产生更高的矛盾输出(+34-56%)
AI.conclusion: NCTR提示迫使有限深度transformer进入特定的动态机制，这些机制与经典矩阵半群问题相关，对理解自指失败模式具有实际意义

title: Human-Inspired Context-Selective Multimodal Memory for Social Robots
comment: Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: Memory is fundamental to social interaction, enabling humans to recall meaningful past experiences and adapt their behavior accordingly based on the context. However, most current social robots and embodied agents rely on non-selective, text-based memory, limiting their ability to support personalized, context-aware interactions. Drawing inspiration from cognitive neuroscience, we propose a context-selective, multimodal memory architecture for social robots that captures and retrieves both textual and visual episodic traces, prioritizing moments characterized by high emotional salience or scene novelty. By associating these memories with individual users, our system enables socially personalized recall and more natural, grounded dialogue. We evaluate the selective storage mechanism using a curated dataset of social scenarios, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.506, surpassing human consistency ($ρ=0.415$) and outperforming existing image memorability models. In multimodal retrieval experiments, our fusion approach improves Recall@1 by up to 13\% over unimodal text or image retrieval. Runtime evaluations confirm that the system maintains real-time performance. Qualitative analyses further demonstrate that the proposed framework produces richer and more socially relevant responses than baseline models. This work advances memory design for social robots by bridging human-inspired selectivity and multimodal retrieval to enhance long-term, personalized human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向社交机器人的上下文选择性多模态记忆架构，通过结合文本和视觉信息来捕捉情感显著和场景新颖的时刻，实现个性化记忆检索，提升人机交互的自然性和个性化。
AI.motivation: 当前社交机器人和具身代理主要依赖非选择性的文本记忆，限制了它们支持个性化、上下文感知交互的能力。需要一种更接近人类记忆机制的多模态记忆系统来改善长期人机交互。
AI.method: 提出上下文选择性多模态记忆架构，捕捉文本和视觉的片段性痕迹，优先存储情感显著或场景新颖的时刻。将记忆与个体用户关联，实现个性化回忆。采用融合方法进行多模态检索。
AI.result: 选择性存储机制在社交场景数据集上获得Spearman相关系数0.506，超过人类一致性(ρ=0.415)和现有图像记忆性模型。多模态检索实验中，融合方法比单模态文本或图像检索的Recall@1提升高达13%。系统保持实时性能，定性分析显示能产生更丰富、社交相关性更强的响应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结合人类启发的选择性和多模态检索，推进了社交机器人的记忆设计，能够增强长期、个性化的人机交互，使机器人记忆更接近人类记忆机制。

title: PR-MaGIC: Prompt Refinement Via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow For In-Context Segmentation
summary: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have significantly advanced broad use of image segmentation. However, SAM and its variants necessitate substantial manual effort for prompt generation and additional training for specific applications. Recent approaches address these limitations by integrating SAM into in-context (one/few shot) segmentation, enabling auto-prompting through semantic alignment between query and support images. Despite these efforts, they still generate sub-optimal prompts that degrade segmentation quality due to visual inconsistencies between support and query images. To tackle this limitation, we introduce PR-MaGIC (Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation), a training-free test-time framework that refines prompts via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder. PR-MaGIC seamlessly integrates into in-context segmentation frameworks, being theoretically grounded yet practically stabilized through a simple top-1 selection strategy that ensures robust performance across samples. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PR-MaGIC consistently improves segmentation quality across various benchmarks, effectively mitigating inadequate prompts without requiring additional training or architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: PR-MaGIC是一个无需训练、测试时使用的提示优化框架，通过SAM掩码解码器的梯度流来改进提示，提升上下文分割的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉基础模型（如SAM）需要大量人工提示生成和额外训练，而现有的上下文分割方法由于支持图像和查询图像之间的视觉不一致性，仍会产生次优提示，降低分割质量。
AI.method: 提出PR-MaGIC框架，通过SAM掩码解码器的梯度流来优化提示，采用简单的top-1选择策略确保鲁棒性，无需额外训练或架构修改。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，PR-MaGIC一致提高了分割质量，有效缓解了不充分提示的问题。
AI.conclusion: PR-MaGIC是一个理论上有依据、实践上稳定的训练免费框架，能够无缝集成到上下文分割框架中，显著提升分割性能。

title: AgenticAI-DialogGen: Topic-Guided Conversation Generation for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Short- and Long-Term Memories of LLMs
summary: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved their ability to process extended conversational contexts, yet fine-tuning and evaluating short- and long-term memories remain difficult due to the absence of datasets that encode both short- and long-term conversational history. Existing conversational datasets lack memory grounding, overlook topic continuity, or rely on costly human annotation. To address these gaps, we introduce AgenticAI-DialogGen, a modular agent-based framework that generates persona-grounded and topic-guided conversations without human supervision. The framework uses LLM agents to extract knowledge graphs, identify topics, build speaker personas, and simulate topic-guided conversations from unstructured conversations. A QA module generates memory-grounded Question Answer (QA) pairs drawn from short- and long-term conversational histories. We also generated a new dataset entitled, TopicGuidedChat (TGC), where long-term memory is encoded as speaker-specific knowledge graphs and short-term memory as newly generated topic-guided conversations. Evaluations depict that AgenticAI-DialogGen yields higher conversational quality and LLMs fine-tuned on TGC dataset achieve improved performance on memory-grounded QA tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AgenticAI-DialogGen框架，用于自动生成基于人物角色和主题引导的对话数据集，解决了现有对话数据集缺乏记忆基础和主题连续性的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在处理扩展对话上下文方面有所进步，但微调和评估短期与长期记忆仍然困难，因为缺乏同时编码短期和长期对话历史的数据集。现有对话数据集缺乏记忆基础、忽视主题连续性，或依赖昂贵的人工标注。
AI.method: 提出了AgenticAI-DialogGen模块化代理框架，使用LLM代理从非结构化对话中提取知识图谱、识别主题、构建说话者角色，并模拟主题引导的对话。QA模块生成基于短期和长期对话历史的记忆基础问答对。
AI.result: 生成了新的TopicGuidedChat数据集，其中长期记忆编码为说话者特定的知识图谱，短期记忆编码为新生成的主题引导对话。评估显示AgenticAI-DialogGen产生更高的对话质量，在TGC数据集上微调的LLM在记忆基础QA任务上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: AgenticAI-DialogGen框架能够无需人工监督生成高质量的人物角色基础和主题引导对话，为LLM的短期和长期记忆微调与评估提供了有效的数据集解决方案。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/arunshar/spatial-atlas
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了计算基础推理(CGR)设计范式，通过确定性计算解决空间感知研究代理中的可回答子问题，避免语言模型产生幻觉推理，并在两个基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决空间感知研究代理中语言模型在空间推理时可能产生幻觉的问题，需要一种能够确保空间推理准确性的设计范式，特别是在处理多模态空间问答和端到端机器学习工程等复杂任务时。
AI.method: 1. 提出计算基础推理(CGR)设计范式，要求所有可回答子问题先通过确定性计算解决；2. 实现Spatial Atlas系统作为A2A服务器；3. 使用结构化空间场景图引擎从视觉描述中提取实体和关系；4. 采用熵引导的动作选择最大化信息增益；5. 构建三层前沿模型堆栈；6. 实现自修复ML管道，包含策略感知代码生成、分数驱动的迭代优化循环和基于提示的泄漏审计注册表。
AI.result: 在FieldWorkArena（工厂、仓库和零售环境的多模态空间问答基准）和MLE-Bench（75个Kaggle机器学习竞赛的端到端ML工程套件）两个基准测试中，CGR方法实现了有竞争力的准确性，同时通过结构化中间表示和确定性空间计算保持了可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 计算基础推理(CGR)范式通过将确定性计算置于语言模型生成之前，有效避免了空间推理中的幻觉问题，在保持可解释性的同时实现了竞争性的性能，为空间感知研究代理提供了一种可靠的设计方法。

title: HTDC: Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, but still suffer from hallucinations caused by unstable visual grounding and over-reliance on language priors. Existing training-free decoding methods typically apply calibration at every decoding step, introducing unnecessary computation and potentially disrupting stable predictions. We address this problem by identifying layer-wise hesitation, a simple signal of grounding instability reflected by fluctuations in token preference across intermediate layers. Based on this observation, we propose Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration (HTDC), a training-free decoding framework that preserves standard full-branch inference and activates calibration only at hesitation-prone steps. When triggered, HTDC contrasts the full branch with two lightweight probes, a visual-nullification probe and a semantic-nullification probe, to suppress hallucination-prone candidates while avoiding unnecessary intervention on stable steps. Experiments on representative hallucination benchmarks show that HTDC consistently reduces hallucinations while maintaining strong task accuracy, achieving a favorable trade-off between effectiveness and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: HTDC是一种无需训练的推理框架，通过检测中间层的"犹豫"信号，仅在需要时触发校准，减少幻觉同时保持任务准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型存在幻觉问题，现有方法在每个解码步骤都进行校准，导致不必要的计算并可能干扰稳定预测。
AI.method: 提出基于层间犹豫信号的HTDC框架：1) 识别中间层的token偏好波动作为犹豫信号；2) 仅在犹豫步骤触发校准；3) 使用视觉消除和语义消除两个轻量探针对比完整分支，抑制幻觉候选。
AI.result: 在代表性幻觉基准测试中，HTDC能持续减少幻觉，同时保持强大的任务准确性，在效果和计算开销之间达到良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: HTDC通过检测层间犹豫信号，仅在需要时触发校准，提供了一种高效减少幻觉的解码框架，避免了不必要的计算干预。

title: Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in retrieved knowledge. However, existing RAG methods including graph- and hypergraph-based approaches treat retrieved evidence as an unordered set, implicitly assuming permutation invariance. This assumption is misaligned with many real-world reasoning tasks, where outcomes depend not only on which interactions occur, but also on the order in which they unfold. We propose Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG (OKH-RAG), which treats order as a first-class structural property. OKH-RAG represents knowledge as higher-order interactions within a hypergraph augmented with precedence structure, and reformulates retrieval as sequence inference over hyperedges. Instead of selecting independent facts, it recovers coherent interaction trajectories that reflect underlying reasoning processes. A learned transition model infers precedence directly from data without requiring explicit temporal supervision. We evaluate OKH-RAG on order-sensitive question answering and explanation tasks, including tropical cyclone and port operation scenarios. OKH-RAG consistently outperforms permutation-invariant baselines, and ablations show that these gains arise specifically from modeling interaction order. These results highlight a key limitation of set-based retrieval: effective reasoning requires not only retrieving relevant evidence, but organizing it into structured sequences.

AI.tldr: OKH-RAG提出了一种顺序感知的知识超图检索增强生成方法，通过建模知识交互的顺序结构来改进传统RAG方法，在顺序敏感任务上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法（包括基于图和超图的方法）将检索到的证据视为无序集合，隐含地假设排列不变性。这种假设与许多现实世界推理任务不匹配，因为结果不仅取决于哪些交互发生，还取决于它们展开的顺序。
AI.method: 提出Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG (OKH-RAG)，将顺序作为首要结构属性。该方法将知识表示为具有优先结构的超图中的高阶交互，并将检索重新定义为超边上的序列推断。它恢复反映底层推理过程的连贯交互轨迹，而不是选择独立事实。通过学习转换模型直接从数据推断优先关系，无需显式的时间监督。
AI.result: 在顺序敏感问答和解释任务（包括热带气旋和港口运营场景）上评估OKH-RAG。OKH-RAG始终优于排列不变的基线方法，消融实验表明这些收益特别来自于建模交互顺序。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果突显了基于集合检索的关键局限性：有效的推理不仅需要检索相关证据，还需要将其组织成结构化序列。顺序感知的检索方法对于需要理解事件或交互顺序的任务至关重要。

title: The A-R Behavioral Space: Execution-Level Profiling of Tool-Using Language Model Agents in Organizational Deployment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents capable of executing system-level operations. While existing benchmarks primarily assess textual alignment or task success, less attention has been paid to the structural relationship between linguistic signaling and executable behavior under varying autonomy scaffolds. This study introduces an execution-layer be-havioral measurement approach based on a two-dimensional A-R space defined by Action Rate (A) and Refusal Signal (R), with Divergence (D) capturing coor-dination between the two. Models are evaluated across four normative regimes (Control, Gray, Dilemma, and Malicious) and three autonomy configurations (di-rect execution, planning, and reflection). Rather than assigning aggregate safety scores, the method characterizes how execution and refusal redistribute across contextual framing and scaffold depth. Empirical results show that execution and refusal constitute separable behavioral dimensions whose joint distribution varies systematically across regimes and autonomy levels. Reflection-based scaffolding often shifts configurations toward higher refusal in risk-laden contexts, but redis-tribution patterns differ structurally across models. The A-R representation makes cross-sectional behavioral profiles, scaffold-induced transitions, and coordination variability directly observable. By foregrounding execution-layer characterization over scalar ranking, this work provides a deployment-oriented lens for analyzing and selecting tool-enabled LLM agents in organizational settings where execution privileges and risk tolerance vary.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于执行层行为测量的新方法，通过动作率(A)和拒绝信号(R)两个维度来评估工具增强LLM代理在不同自主性配置下的行为特征，而非传统的聚合安全评分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估文本对齐或任务成功率，较少关注语言信号与可执行行为在变化自主性支架下的结构关系。需要一种部署导向的方法来分析组织环境中工具增强LLM代理的行为特征。
AI.method: 引入基于二维A-R空间（动作率A和拒绝信号R）的执行层行为测量方法，使用发散度D捕捉两者协调性。在四种规范制度（控制、灰色、困境、恶意）和三种自主性配置（直接执行、规划、反思）下评估模型。
AI.result: 执行和拒绝构成可分离的行为维度，其联合分布在制度和自主性水平上系统性变化。基于反思的支架通常将风险情境下的配置转向更高拒绝率，但不同模型的重分布模式存在结构差异。
AI.conclusion: A-R表示使跨截面行为特征、支架诱导转变和协调变异性直接可观察。通过强调执行层特征而非标量排名，为分析和选择工具增强LLM代理提供了部署导向的视角，特别适用于执行权限和风险容忍度变化的组织环境。

title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on familiar semantic priors, but existing evaluations do not cleanly separate perception failures from rule-mapping failures. We study this behavior as semantic fixation: preserving a default interpretation even when the prompt specifies an alternative, equally valid mapping. To isolate this effect, we introduce VLM-Fix, a controlled benchmark over four abstract strategy games that evaluates identical terminal board states under paired standard and inverse rule formulations. Across 14 open and closed VLMs, accuracy consistently favors standard rules, revealing a robust semantic-fixation gap. Prompt interventions support this mechanism: neutral alias prompts substantially narrow the inverse-rule gap, while semantically loaded aliases reopen it. Post-training is strongly rule-aligned: training on one rule improves same-rule transfer but hurts opposite-rule transfer, while joint-rule training improves broader transfer. To test external validity beyond synthetic games, we evaluate analogous defamiliarization interventions on VLMBias and observe the same qualitative pattern. Finally, late-layer activation steering partially recovers degraded performance, indicating that semantic-fixation errors are at least partly editable in late representations. Project page, code, and dataset available at https://maveryn.github.io/vlm-fix/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VLM-Fix基准测试，揭示大型视觉语言模型存在语义固化现象：即使提示指定了替代规则，模型仍倾向于默认语义解释
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法未能清晰区分视觉语言模型的感知失败与规则映射失败，需要研究模型在语义固化方面的行为模式
AI.method: 引入VLM-Fix基准测试，使用四种抽象策略游戏，在标准规则和逆规则两种表述下评估相同棋盘状态；通过中性别名和语义加载别名提示进行干预；进行后期训练对齐和激活导向实验
AI.result: 在14个开源和闭源VLM中，标准规则准确率始终优于逆规则，显示出稳健的语义固化差距；中性别名提示显著缩小逆规则差距，而语义加载别名重新扩大差距；后期训练显示强规则对齐性；后期激活导向可部分恢复性能
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在语义固化现象，这种错误至少部分可通过后期表征编辑来纠正，为理解和改进VLM的规则理解能力提供了新视角

title: Representing expertise accelerates learning from pedagogical interaction data
summary: Work in cognitive science and artificial intelligence has suggested that exposing learning agents to traces of interaction between multiple individuals can improve performance in a variety of settings, yet it remains unknown which features of interactions contribute to this improvement. We examined the factors that support the effectiveness of interaction data, using a controlled paradigm that allowed us to precisely operationalize key distinctions between interaction and an expert acting alone. We generated synthetic datasets of simple interactions between an expert and a novice in a spatial navigation task, and then trained transformer models on those datasets, evaluating performance after exposure to different datasets.
