AI.method: 提出DialRouter：1）使用MCTS探索不同LLM选择引发的对话分支，收集高累积奖励轨迹；2）从搜索数据中学习轻量级路由策略，结合基于检索的未来状态近似，实现无需在线搜索的多轮路由
AI.result: 在开放领域和特定领域对话任务上，DialRouter显著优于单一LLM和现有路由基线，在任务成功率方面表现优异，结合成本感知奖励时达到优越的性能-成本权衡
AI.conclusion: DialRouter通过从单轮短视选择转向长期视野序列路由，有效解决了多轮对话中的交互动态和延迟奖励问题，实现了更好的性能和成本效率

title: GTPBD-MM: A Global Terraced Parcel and Boundary Dataset with Multi-Modality
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ACM Multimedia 2026 Dataset Track
summary: Agricultural parcel extraction plays an important role in remote sensing-based agricultural monitoring, supporting parcel surveying, precision management, and ecological assessment. However, existing public benchmarks mainly focus on regular and relatively flat farmland scenes. In contrast, terraced parcels in mountainous regions exhibit stepped terrain, pronounced elevation variation, irregular boundaries, and strong cross-regional heterogeneity, making parcel extraction a more challenging problem that jointly requires visual recognition, semantic discrimination, and terrain-aware geometric understanding. Although recent studies have advanced visual parcel benchmarks and image-text farmland understanding, a unified benchmark for complex terraced parcel extraction under aligned image-text-DEM settings remains absent. To fill this gap, we present GTPBD-MM, the first multimodal benchmark for global terraced parcel extraction. Built upon GTPBD, GTPBD-MM integrates high-resolution optical imagery, structured text descriptions, and DEM data, and supports systematic evaluation under Image-only, Image+Text, and Image+Text+DEM settings. We further propose Elevation and Text guided Terraced parcel network (ETTerra), a multimodal baseline for terraced parcel delineation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that textual semantics and terrain geometry provide complementary cues beyond visual appearance alone, yielding more accurate, coherent, and structurally consistent delineation results in complex terraced scenes.

AI.tldr: 首个面向全球梯田地块提取的多模态基准GTPBD-MM，整合了高分辨率光学影像、结构化文本描述和DEM数据，支持图像、图像+文本、图像+文本+DEM三种设置的系统评估。
AI.motivation: 现有公共基准主要关注规则平坦农田，而山区梯田地块具有阶梯地形、高程变化大、边界不规则和跨区域异质性强的特点，需要视觉识别、语义判别和地形感知几何理解的联合能力。目前缺乏在图像-文本-DEM对齐设置下的复杂梯田地块提取统一基准。
AI.method: 提出了GTPBD-MM多模态基准，基于GTPBD整合高分辨率光学影像、结构化文本描述和DEM数据。同时提出了ETTerra（高程和文本引导的梯田地块网络），这是一个用于梯田地块划分的多模态基线模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，文本语义和地形几何信息提供了超越视觉外观的互补线索，在复杂梯田场景中产生了更准确、更连贯和结构更一致的划分结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了复杂梯田地块提取统一基准的空白，证明了多模态信息（视觉、文本、地形）在梯田地块提取中的互补价值，为山区农业监测提供了更有效的技术支撑。

title: KoCo: Conditioning Language Model Pre-training on Knowledge Coordinates
summary: Standard Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training typically treats corpora as flattened token sequences, often overlooking the real-world context that humans naturally rely on to contextualize information. To bridge this gap, we introduce Knowledge Coordinate Conditioning (KoCo), a simple method that maps every document into a three-dimensional semantic coordinate. By prepending these coordinates as textual prefixes for pre-training, we aim to equip the model with explicit contextual awareness to learn the documents within the real-world knowledge structure. Experiment results demonstrate that KoCo significantly enhances performance across 10 downstream tasks and accelerates pre-training convergence by approximately 30\%. Furthermore, our analysis indicates that explicitly modeling knowledge coordinates helps the model distinguish stable facts from noise, effectively mitigating hallucination in generated outputs.

AI.tldr: KoCo方法通过将文档映射为三维语义坐标并作为文本前缀进行预训练，使LLM获得显式上下文感知能力，提升下游任务性能并加速预训练收敛。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM预训练将语料库视为扁平化的token序列，忽略了人类自然依赖的现实世界上下文信息，这限制了模型对信息的语境化理解能力。
AI.method: 提出知识坐标条件化(KoCo)方法，将每个文档映射到三维语义坐标，并将这些坐标作为文本前缀添加到预训练中，使模型能够在现实世界知识结构中学习文档。
AI.result: KoCo在10个下游任务中显著提升性能，加速预训练收敛约30%，分析表明显式建模知识坐标有助于模型区分稳定事实与噪声，有效缓解生成输出中的幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将文档映射为语义坐标并作为条件信息，KoCo方法为LLM提供了显式上下文感知能力，不仅提升了模型性能，还加速了训练收敛并减少了幻觉现象。

title: GAM: Hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
summary: To sustain coherent long-term interactions, Large Language Model (LLM) agents must navigate the tension between acquiring new information and retaining prior knowledge. Current unified stream-based memory systems facilitate context updates but remain vulnerable to interference from transient noise. Conversely, discrete structured memory architectures provide robust knowledge retention but often struggle to adapt to evolving narratives. To address this, we propose GAM, a hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory framework that explicitly decouples memory encoding from consolidation to effectively resolve the conflict between rapid context perception and stable knowledge retention. By isolating ongoing dialogue in an event progression graph and integrating it into a topic associative network only upon semantic shifts, our approach minimizes interference while preserving long-term consistency. Additionally, we introduce a graph-guided, multi-factor retrieval strategy to enhance context precision. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongDialQA indicate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both reasoning accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: GAM：基于图的分层智能体记忆框架，通过解耦记忆编码与巩固，解决LLM智能体在长期交互中新信息获取与旧知识保留的冲突
AI.motivation: 当前统一的流式记忆系统容易受到瞬时噪声干扰，而离散结构化记忆架构难以适应不断演变的叙事。需要解决快速上下文感知与稳定知识保留之间的冲突
AI.method: 提出GAM分层图记忆框架：1）将正在进行对话隔离在事件进展图中；2）仅在语义转变时将其整合到主题关联网络中；3）采用图引导的多因素检索策略提升上下文精度
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongDialQA数据集上的实验表明，该方法在推理准确性和效率方面均优于现有最先进的基线方法
AI.conclusion: GAM框架通过解耦记忆编码与巩固，有效解决了LLM智能体在长期交互中的记忆冲突问题，实现了更好的知识保留与适应性平衡

title: Cell Instance Segmentation via Multi-Task Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge
summary: Existing cell instance segmentation pipelines typically combine deterministic predictions with post-processing, which imposes limited explicit constraints on the global structure of instance masks. In this work, we propose a multi-task image-to-image Schrödinger Bridge framework that formulates instance segmentation as a distribution-based image-to-image generation problem. Boundary-aware supervision is integrated through a reverse distance map, and deterministic inference is employed to produce stable predictions. Experimental results on the PanNuke dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance without relying on SAM pre-training or additional post-processing. Additional results on the MoNuSeg dataset show robustness under limited training data. These findings indicate that Schrödinger Bridge-based image-to-image generation provides an effective framework for cell instance segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Schrödinger Bridge的多任务图像到图像生成框架，将细胞实例分割转化为基于分布的图像生成问题，无需SAM预训练或额外后处理即可获得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 现有细胞实例分割方法通常结合确定性预测和后处理，对实例掩码的全局结构施加有限约束，需要更有效的框架来改善这一限制。
AI.method: 提出多任务图像到图像Schrödinger Bridge框架，将实例分割转化为分布式图像生成问题，通过反向距离图集成边界感知监督，采用确定性推理产生稳定预测。
AI.result: 在PanNuke数据集上达到竞争性或更优性能，无需依赖SAM预训练或额外后处理；在MoNuSeg数据集上显示有限训练数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Schrödinger Bridge基的图像到图像生成为细胞实例分割提供了有效框架，能够产生具有良好全局结构的实例掩码。

title: Agentic Insight Generation in VSM Simulations
summary: Extracting actionable insights from complex value stream map simulations can be challenging, time-consuming, and error-prone. Recent advances in large language models offer new avenues to support users with this task. While existing approaches excel at processing raw data to gain information, they are structurally unfit to pick up on subtle situational differences needed to distinguish similar data sources in this domain. To address this issue, we propose a decoupled, two-step agentic architecture. By separating orchestration from data analysis, the system leverages progressive data discovery infused with domain expert knowledge. This architecture allows the orchestration to intelligently select data sources and perform multi-hop reasoning across data structures while maintaining a slim internal context. Results from multiple state-of-the-art large language models demonstrate the framework's viability: with top-tier models achieving accuracies of up to 86% and demonstrating high robustness across evaluation runs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种解耦的两步智能体架构，通过分离编排与数据分析，利用渐进式数据发现和领域专家知识，从复杂价值流图模拟中提取可操作见解
AI.motivation: 从复杂价值流图模拟中提取可操作见解具有挑战性、耗时且容易出错。现有方法在处理原始数据方面表现良好，但在捕捉细微情境差异以区分相似数据源方面存在结构性问题
AI.method: 提出解耦的两步智能体架构：1) 分离编排与数据分析；2) 利用渐进式数据发现并注入领域专家知识；3) 编排层智能选择数据源并在数据结构间进行多跳推理，同时保持精简的内部上下文
AI.result: 多个最先进的大语言模型测试显示该框架的可行性：顶级模型准确率高达86%，并在多次评估运行中表现出高鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: 该解耦的两步智能体架构能够有效解决从复杂价值流图模拟中提取可操作见解的挑战，通过智能编排和渐进式数据发现提高分析的准确性和鲁棒性

title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization
summary: Current LLM agent benchmarks, which predominantly focus on binary pass/fail tasks such as code generation or search-based question answering, often neglect the value of real-world engineering that is often captured through the iterative optimization of feasible designs. To this end, we introduce Frontier-Eng, a human-verified benchmark for generative optimization -- an iterative propose-execute-evaluate loop in which an agent generates candidate artifacts, receives executable verifier feedback, and revises them under a fixed interaction budget -- spanning $47$ tasks across five broad engineering categories. Unlike previous suites, Frontier-Eng tasks are grounded in industrial-grade simulators and verifiers that provide continuous reward signals and enforce hard feasibility constraints under constrained budgets. We evaluate eight frontier language models using representative search frameworks, finding that while Claude 4.6 Opus achieves the most robust performance, the benchmark remains challenging for all models. Our analysis suggests a dual power-law decay in improvement frequency ($\sim$ 1/iteration) and magnitude ($\sim$ 1/improvement count). We further show that although width improves parallelism and diversity, depth remains crucial for hard-won improvements under a fixed budget. Frontier-Eng establishes a new standard for assessing the capacity of AI agents to integrate domain knowledge with executable feedback to solve complex, open-ended engineering problems.

AI.tldr: Frontier-Eng是一个用于评估AI代理在生成优化任务中性能的新基准，包含47个工程任务，使用工业级模拟器和验证器提供连续奖励信号和硬可行性约束。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理基准主要关注代码生成或搜索问答等二元通过/失败任务，忽视了真实世界工程中通过迭代优化可行设计所体现的价值。
AI.method: 引入Frontier-Eng基准，涵盖5个工程类别的47个任务，采用生成优化框架——迭代的提出-执行-评估循环，代理生成候选工件，接收可执行的验证器反馈，并在固定交互预算下进行修订。
AI.result: 评估8个前沿语言模型发现，Claude 4.6 Opus表现最稳健，但基准对所有模型都具有挑战性。分析显示改进频率和幅度呈双重幂律衰减，宽度提高并行性和多样性，但深度对于固定预算下的艰难改进仍然至关重要。
AI.conclusion: Frontier-Eng为评估AI代理整合领域知识和可执行反馈以解决复杂、开放式工程问题的能力设立了新标准。

title: Decoding by Perturbation: Mitigating MLLM Hallucinations via Dynamic Textual Perturbation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models frequently suffer from inference hallucinations, partially stemming from language priors dominating visual evidence. Existing training-free mitigation methods either perturb the visual representation and deviate from the natural image distribution, or enforce intrusive manipulations that compromise the model's inherent generative fluency. We introduce a novel perspective that multimodal hallucination manifests as the hypersensitivity of visual grounding to textual phrasing during the decoding phase. Building on this insight, we propose Decoding by Perturbation (DeP), a training-free framework mitigating prior-induced hallucinations via controlled textual interventions. DeP employs a dynamic probe applying multi-level textual perturbations to elicit latent language priors. Leveraging attention variance, it enhances stable evidence regions while suppressing suspicious noise in the feature space. Furthermore, it constructs an interpretable prior drift direction using logits statistics to counteract probability biases from textual co-occurrences. Extensive experiments confirm DeP effectively reduces hallucinations and achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DeP框架，通过文本扰动缓解多模态大语言模型的推理幻觉问题
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型经常出现推理幻觉，部分原因是语言先验主导了视觉证据。现有免训练缓解方法要么扰动视觉表示偏离自然图像分布，要么采用侵入性操作损害模型生成流畅性
AI.method: 提出解码时扰动（DeP）框架，基于多模态幻觉表现为解码阶段视觉基础对文本措辞的过度敏感这一洞察。通过动态探针应用多级文本扰动来引出潜在语言先验，利用注意力方差增强稳定证据区域并抑制特征空间中的可疑噪声，构建可解释的先验漂移方向来抵消文本共现带来的概率偏差
AI.result: 大量实验证实DeP能有效减少幻觉，在多个基准测试中取得优越性能
AI.conclusion: DeP为缓解多模态大语言模型中的先验诱导幻觉提供了一种有效的免训练框架

title: MultiDocFusion: Hierarchical and Multimodal Chunking Pipeline for Enhanced RAG on Long Industrial Documents
summary: RAG-based QA has emerged as a powerful method for processing long industrial documents. However, conventional text chunking approaches often neglect complex and long industrial document structures, causing information loss and reduced answer quality. To address this, we introduce MultiDocFusion, a multimodal chunking pipeline that integrates: (i) detection of document regions using vision-based document parsing, (ii) text extraction from these regions via OCR, (iii) reconstruction of document structure into a hierarchical tree using large language model (LLM)-based document section hierarchical parsing (DSHP-LLM), and (iv) construction of hierarchical chunks through DFS-based grouping. Extensive experiments across industrial benchmarks demonstrate that MultiDocFusion improves retrieval precision by 8-15% and ANLS QA scores by 2-3% compared to baselines, emphasizing the critical role of explicitly leveraging document hierarchy for multimodal document-based QA. These significant performance gains underscore the necessity of structure-aware chunking in enhancing the fidelity of RAG-based QA systems.

AI.tldr: MultiDocFusion是一个多模态分块管道，通过视觉文档解析、OCR提取、LLM层次解析和DFS分组，显式利用文档层次结构提升工业文档RAG问答性能。
AI.motivation: 传统文本分块方法在处理复杂工业文档时忽视文档结构，导致信息丢失和答案质量下降。工业文档通常具有复杂的层次结构，需要结构感知的分块方法来提升RAG问答系统的性能。
AI.method: 提出MultiDocFusion多模态分块管道，包含四个步骤：1) 基于视觉的文档区域检测；2) OCR区域文本提取；3) 使用LLM进行文档章节层次解析(DSHP-LLM)重建文档层次树；4) 基于DFS的分组构建层次分块。
AI.result: 在工业基准测试中，MultiDocFusion相比基线方法将检索精度提升了8-15%，ANLS问答分数提升了2-3%。这些显著性能提升强调了显式利用文档层次结构对多模态文档问答的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的分块对于提升RAG问答系统的保真度至关重要。MultiDocFusion通过显式建模文档层次结构，有效解决了工业文档处理中的信息丢失问题，为复杂文档的RAG问答提供了有效解决方案。

title: EgoEsportsQA: An Egocentric Video Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in Esports
summary: While video large language models (Video-LLMs) excel in understanding slow-paced, real-world egocentric videos, their capabilities in high-velocity, information-dense virtual environments remain under-explored. Existing benchmarks focus on daily activities, yet lack a rigorous testbed for evaluating fast, rule-bound reasoning in virtual scenarios. To fill this gap, we introduce EgoEsportsQA, a pioneering video question-answering (QA) benchmark for grounding perception and reasoning in expert esports knowledge. We curate 1,745 high-quality QA pairs from professional matches across 3 first-person shooter games via a scalable six-stage pipeline. These questions are structured into a two-dimensional decoupled taxonomy: 11 sub-tasks in the cognitive capability dimension (covering perception and reasoning levels) and 6 sub-tasks in the esports knowledge dimension. Comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art Video-LLMs reveal that current models still fail to achieve satisfactory performance, with the best model only 71.58%. The results expose notable gaps across both axes: models exhibit stronger capabilities in basic visual perception than in deep tactical reasoning, and they grasp overall macro-progression better than fine-grained micro-operations. Extensive ablation experiments demonstrate the intrinsic weaknesses of current Video-LLM architectures. Further analysis suggests that our dataset not only reveals the connections between real-world and virtual egocentric domains, but also offers guidance for optimizing downstream esports applications, thereby fostering the future advancement of Video-LLMs in various egocentric environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoEsportsQA基准测试，用于评估视频大语言模型在高速虚拟电竞环境中的感知和推理能力，发现现有模型在战术推理和微观操作方面存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 当前视频大语言模型主要针对慢节奏的现实世界第一人称视频，但在高速、信息密集的虚拟环境（如电竞场景）中的能力尚未得到充分探索。现有基准测试缺乏对虚拟场景中快速、规则约束推理的严格评估。
AI.method: 通过六阶段可扩展流程，从3款第一人称射击游戏的职业比赛中收集了1,745个高质量问答对。构建了二维解耦分类法：认知能力维度（11个子任务，涵盖感知和推理层次）和电竞知识维度（6个子任务）。
AI.result: 对最先进的视频大语言模型进行全面评估显示，当前模型性能仍不理想，最佳模型仅达到71.58%。模型在基础视觉感知方面强于深度战术推理，在宏观进程理解方面优于微观操作分析。
AI.conclusion: EgoEsportsQA基准不仅揭示了现实世界和虚拟第一人称领域之间的联系，还为优化下游电竞应用提供了指导，促进了视频大语言模型在各种第一人称环境中的未来发展。

title: GLeMM: A large-scale multilingual dataset for morphological research
summary: In derivational morphology, what mechanisms govern the variation in form-meaning relations between words? The answers to this type of questions are typically based on intuition and on observations drawn from limited data, even when a wide range of languages is considered. Many of these studies are difficult to replicate and generalize. To address this issue, we present GLeMM, a new derivational resource designed for experimentation and data-driven description in morphology. GLeMM is characterized by (i) its large size, (ii) its extensive coverage (currently amounting to seven European languages, i.e., German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, (iii) its fully automated design, identical across all languages, (iv) the automatic annotation of morphological features on each entry, as well as (v) the encoding of semantic descriptions for a significant subset of these entries. It enables researchers to address difficult questions, such as the role of form and meaning in word-formation, and to develop and experimentally test computational methods that identify the structures of derivational morphology. The article describes how GLeMM is created using Wiktionary articles and presents various case studies illustrating possible applications of the resource.

AI.tldr: GLeMM是一个用于形态学实验和数据驱动描述的新派生资源，具有大规模、多语言覆盖、全自动设计等特点，基于维基词典构建，支持研究派生形态学中的形式-意义关系。
AI.motivation: 传统派生形态学研究通常基于直觉和有限数据，难以复制和推广。为了解决这个问题，需要创建一个可用于实验和数据驱动描述的大规模形态学资源。
AI.method: 使用维基词典文章创建GLeMM资源，具有以下特点：大规模、覆盖七种欧洲语言、全自动设计、自动标注形态特征、为重要子集编码语义描述。
AI.result: 开发了GLeMM资源，使研究人员能够解决派生形态学中的困难问题，如形式和意义在构词中的作用，并开发和实验测试识别派生形态结构的计算方法。
AI.conclusion: GLeMM为派生形态学研究提供了一个可扩展、可复制的数据驱动框架，通过案例研究展示了该资源在形态学分析中的多种应用可能性。

title: ReflectCAP: Detailed Image Captioning with Reflective Memory
summary: Detailed image captioning demands both factual grounding and fine-grained coverage, yet existing methods have struggled to achieve them simultaneously. We address this tension with Reflective Note-Guided Captioning (ReflectCAP), where a multi-agent pipeline analyzes what the target large vision-language model (LVLM) consistently hallucinates and what it systematically overlooks, distilling these patterns into reusable guidelines called Structured Reflection Notes. At inference time, these notes steer the captioning model along both axes -- what to avoid and what to attend to -- yielding detailed captions that jointly improve factuality and coverage. Applying this method to 8 LVLMs spanning the GPT-4.1 family, Qwen series, and InternVL variants, ReflectCAP reaches the Pareto frontier of the trade-off between factuality and coverage, and delivers substantial gains on CapArena-Auto, where generated captions are judged head-to-head against strong reference models. Moreover, ReflectCAP offers a more favorable trade-off between caption quality and compute cost than model scaling or existing multi-agent pipelines, which incur 21--36\% greater overhead. This makes high-quality detailed captioning viable under real-world cost and latency constraints.

AI.tldr: ReflectCAP通过多智能体分析LVLM的幻觉和遗漏模式，生成结构化反思笔记指导图像描述生成，在事实性和覆盖度之间达到帕累托最优，同时降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有图像描述方法难以同时实现事实准确性和细粒度覆盖度，需要在两者之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 使用多智能体流水线分析目标大视觉语言模型(LVLM)的幻觉模式和系统遗漏，将这些模式提炼为可重用的结构化反思笔记，在推理时用这些笔记指导描述模型。
AI.result: 在8个LVLM模型上测试，ReflectCAP在事实性和覆盖度之间达到帕累托前沿，在CapArena-Auto基准上显著提升，比模型缩放或多智能体流水线减少21-36%的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: ReflectCAP提供了一种在现实世界成本和延迟约束下实现高质量详细图像描述的有效方法，在质量与计算成本之间取得了更有利的权衡。

title: Self-Adversarial One Step Generation via Condition Shifting
summary: The push for efficient text to image synthesis has moved the field toward one step sampling, yet existing methods still face a three way tradeoff among fidelity, inference speed, and training efficiency. Approaches that rely on external discriminators can sharpen one step performance, but they often introduce training instability, high GPU memory overhead, and slow convergence, which complicates scaling and parameter efficient tuning. In contrast, regression based distillation and consistency objectives are easier to optimize, but they typically lose fine details when constrained to a single step. We present APEX, built on a key theoretical insight: adversarial correction signals can be extracted endogenously from a flow model through condition shifting. Using a transformation creates a shifted condition branch whose velocity field serves as an independent estimator of the model's current generation distribution, yielding a gradient that is provably GAN aligned, replacing the sample dependent discriminator terms that cause gradient vanishing. This discriminator free design is architecture preserving, making APEX a plug and play framework compatible with both full parameter and LoRA based tuning. Empirically, our 0.6B model surpasses FLUX-Schnell 12B (20$\times$ more parameters) in one step quality. With LoRA tuning on Qwen-Image 20B, APEX reaches a GenEval score of 0.89 at NFE=1 in 6 hours, surpassing the original 50-step teacher (0.87) and providing a 15.33$\times$ inference speedup. Code is available https://github.com/LINs-lab/APEX.

AI.tldr: APEX提出了一种无需外部判别器的单步文本到图像生成方法，通过条件偏移从流模型中提取对抗性校正信号，在保持架构的同时实现了高质量单步生成。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像合成方法面临保真度、推理速度和训练效率的三方权衡。依赖外部判别器的方法虽然能提升单步性能，但会引入训练不稳定、高GPU内存开销和收敛慢等问题；而基于回归的蒸馏方法在单步约束下通常会丢失细节。
AI.method: APEX基于一个关键理论洞见：对抗性校正信号可以通过条件偏移从流模型中内生提取。通过变换创建条件偏移分支，其速度场作为模型当前生成分布的独立估计器，产生可证明与GAN对齐的梯度，替代了导致梯度消失的样本依赖判别器项。这种无判别器设计保持架构不变，使APEX成为即插即用框架，兼容全参数和LoRA调优。
AI.result: 0.6B参数的APEX模型在单步质量上超越了参数多20倍的FLUX-Schnell 12B模型。在Qwen-Image 20B上进行LoRA调优时，APEX在6小时内达到GenEval分数0.89（NFE=1），超越了原始50步教师模型（0.87），并提供了15.33倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: APEX通过从流模型中内生提取对抗性校正信号，解决了文本到图像合成中的三方权衡问题，实现了高质量、高效率的单步生成，同时保持了架构兼容性和训练稳定性。

title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5$\times$ prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: LCA是一种在潜在空间中直接压缩上下文的新注意力机制，通过语义向量聚合和位置键保留，同时减少计算成本和KV缓存，无需额外参数。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理长上下文时面临KV缓存线性增长和自注意力二次复杂度的挑战。现有方法分别解决这些瓶颈，但稀疏注意力无法在MLA的压缩潜在结构上原生运行，错失了联合优化的机会。
AI.method: 提出Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA)，在MLA的潜在空间中直接压缩上下文，将表示解耦为语义潜在向量和位置键。通过查询感知池化聚合语义向量，通过锚点选择保留位置键。
AI.result: 在128K上下文长度下，LCA实现了高达2.5倍的预填充加速和90%的KV缓存减少，同时保持竞争性性能。理论证明具有长度无关的误差界。
AI.conclusion: LCA能够联合减少计算成本和KV缓存而不增加参数，其设计是架构无关的，可扩展到其他注意力机制如GQA，为长上下文处理提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains highly fragile during fine-tuning, where even benign adaptation can degrade pre-trained refusal behaviors and enable harmful responses. Existing defenses typically constrain either weights or activations in isolation, without considering their coupled effects on safety. In this paper, we first theoretically demonstrate that constraining either weights or activations alone is insufficient for safety preservation. To robustly preserve safety alignment, we propose Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints (CWAC), a novel approach that simultaneously enforces a precomputed safety subspace on weight updates and applies targeted regularization to safety-critical features identified by sparse autoencoders. Extensive experiments across four widely used LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that CWAC consistently achieves the lowest harmful scores with minimal impact on fine-tuning accuracy, substantially outperforming strong baselines even under high harmful data ratios.

AI.tldr: CWAC方法通过同时约束权重更新和激活特征来保护LLM的安全对齐，在微调时显著降低有害输出同时保持模型性能
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在微调过程中安全对齐非常脆弱，即使良性适应也可能破坏预训练的安全拒绝行为，导致有害响应。现有防御方法通常单独约束权重或激活，没有考虑它们对安全的耦合影响。
AI.method: 提出耦合权重和激活约束(CWAC)方法：1) 在权重更新上强制执行预计算的安全子空间约束；2) 对稀疏自编码器识别的安全关键特征应用针对性正则化。同时约束权重和激活两个维度。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的LLM和多样化下游任务上的实验表明，CWAC始终实现最低的有害分数，同时对微调准确率影响最小，即使在高有害数据比例下也显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 单独约束权重或激活不足以保护安全对齐，需要同时约束权重更新和安全关键特征。CWAC方法通过耦合约束有效保护LLM的安全对齐，在微调过程中保持安全性能。

title: Mining Large Language Models for Low-Resource Language Data: Comparing Elicitation Strategies for Hausa and Fongbe
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; to appear in LREC-COLING 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on data contributed by low-resource language communities, yet the linguistic knowledge encoded in these models remains accessible only through commercial APIs. This paper investigates whether strategic prompting can extract usable text data from LLMs for two West African languages: Hausa (Afroasiatic, approximately 80 million speakers) and Fongbe (Niger-Congo, approximately 2 million speakers). We systematically compare six elicitation task types across two commercial LLMs (GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41 times more usable target-language words per API call than Gemini. Optimal strategies differ by language: Hausa benefits from functional text and dialogue, while Fongbe requires constrained generation prompts. We release all generated corpora and code.

AI.tldr: 通过策略性提示从商业大语言模型中提取西非语言（豪萨语和丰语）可用文本数据的研究，发现GPT-4o Mini比Gemini效率高6-41倍，不同语言需要不同的最优提示策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在低资源语言社区贡献的数据上训练，但其语言知识仅通过商业API访问。本研究旨在探索是否可以通过策略性提示从LLMs中提取西非语言（豪萨语和丰语）的可用文本数据，使这些语言社区能够访问模型中的语言知识。
AI.method: 系统比较了六种不同的提示任务类型，在两个商业大语言模型（GPT-4o Mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash）上进行测试。针对豪萨语和丰语两种西非语言，通过不同的提示策略（功能性文本、对话、约束生成等）来提取目标语言的单词数据。
AI.result: GPT-4o Mini每个API调用提取的可用目标语言单词数量比Gemini多6-41倍。不同语言需要不同的最优策略：豪萨语适合功能性文本和对话提示，而丰语需要约束生成提示。研究发布了所有生成的语料库和代码。
AI.conclusion: 策略性提示可以有效从商业大语言模型中提取低资源语言的文本数据，但最优策略因语言而异。GPT-4o Mini在提取西非语言数据方面显著优于Gemini。该研究为低资源语言社区访问LLMs中的语言知识提供了可行方法。

title: Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models
summary: This paper addresses two limitations of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex problems: (1) their reasoning processes exhibit Bayesian-like stochastic generation, where each token is sampled from a context-dependent probability distribution, leading to inherently random decision trajectories rather than deterministic planning; (2) the reasoning and decision-making mechanisms are statically decoupled, meaning dynamically retrieved domain knowledge fails to dynamically adjust the underlying reasoning strategy. These dual deficiencies result in initial decisions lacking strategic anchoring and reasoning chains often failing to converge on correct solutions, as stochastic generation lacks mechanisms for trajectory correction or knowledge-guided optimization during sequential reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose a problem-solving method integrated into the LLM's generation process to guide reasoning. This method, compatible with numerous LLMs and featuring reusable solutions, is grounded in a novel Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts prompting schema (HCoT). HCoT synergizes the LLM's reasoning ability with a structured problem space via a heuristic classification model that controls the reasoning process and provides reusable abstract solutions. Evaluated on two complex inductive reasoning tasks with ill-defined search spaces, HCoT outperforms existing approaches (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts and Chain-of-Thoughts prompting) in performance. On the well-structured 24 Game task, HCoT demonstrates significantly higher token efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search. In terms of both accuracy and token usage, HCoT achieves a Pareto frontier balance, offering a strong trade-off between performance and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCoT方法解决LLM在复杂问题解决中的两个局限：随机生成导致决策轨迹不稳定，以及推理与决策机制静态解耦。HCoT通过启发式思维分类提示模式，将LLM推理能力与结构化问题空间结合，在复杂推理任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在解决复杂问题时存在两个主要限制：1）推理过程呈现贝叶斯式随机生成，导致决策轨迹随机而非确定性规划；2）推理与决策机制静态解耦，动态检索的领域知识无法动态调整底层推理策略。这些缺陷导致初始决策缺乏战略锚定，推理链难以收敛到正确解。
AI.method: 提出HCoT（启发式思维分类提示）方法，将LLM的推理能力与结构化问题空间协同。该方法包含一个控制推理过程并提供可重用抽象解决方案的启发式分类模型，集成到LLM的生成过程中指导推理，兼容多种LLM且具有可重用解决方案特性。
AI.result: 在两个复杂归纳推理任务中，HCoT优于现有方法（如Tree-of-Thoughts和Chain-of-Thoughts）。在结构良好的24点游戏任务中，HCoT相比最先进的Tree-of-Thoughts-BFS具有显著更高的token效率。在准确性和token使用方面，HCoT实现了帕累托前沿平衡，在性能和计算成本之间提供了良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: HCoT方法有效解决了LLM在复杂问题解决中的随机生成和静态解耦问题，通过启发式分类模型控制推理过程，在保持高性能的同时显著提高了计算效率，为LLM的复杂推理能力提供了新的解决方案框架。

title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding
summary: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. This formulation encourages deeper visual grounding and reasoning. We evaluate our approach in three challenging tasks: video object counting, video-based visual question answering, and video object segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that models trained predominantly on synthetic data generalize effectively to real-world datasets, often outperforming traditionally trained counterparts. Our findings highlight the potential of unified synthetic data pipelines as a scalable alternative to expensive real-world annotation for multimodal video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出统一合成数据生成管道，自动产生无限多模态视频数据，支持多种任务格式，通过VQA微调策略增强推理能力，在视频计数、问答、分割任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 训练多模态大语言模型需要大规模标注视频数据，但真实世界数据收集成本高、速度慢、多样性有限，需要更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出统一合成数据生成管道，自动生成无限多模态视频数据；引入基于VQA的微调策略，训练模型回答结构化视觉问题而非简单描述。
AI.result: 在视频对象计数、视频问答、视频对象分割三个任务上，主要使用合成数据训练的模型能有效泛化到真实数据集，性能常优于传统训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一合成数据管道可作为昂贵真实世界标注的可扩展替代方案，为多模态视频理解提供新途径。

title: Meet Dynamic Individual Preferences: Resolving Conflicting Human Value with Paired Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved the alignment of models with general human preferences. However, a major challenge remains in adapting LLMs to individual preferences, which are not only diverse but also dynamic. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework, Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT), designed to align models with contradictory and evolving individual preferences. We present a new dataset, Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD), which includes scenarios that involve conflicting human preferences, facilitating the evaluation of our approach. Our experiments demonstrate that PFT outperforms single-preference training methods, achieving up to 96.6% accuracy in multi-choice classification tasks and the highest open-ended generation score of 8.69. PFT also shows significant improvements over DPO, SFT and some traditional training methods, especially when handling conflicting preferences. Additionally, with limited user history data, models can inferring preference vector rapidly, achieving a 44.76% improvement in user-specific preference alignment in comparison to single-preference models.

AI.tldr: 提出Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT)框架，用于处理矛盾且动态变化的个人偏好，在Value Conflict Dilemma数据集上表现优异，显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型在一般人类偏好对齐方面取得进展，但适应多样且动态的个人偏好仍是挑战，特别是处理矛盾偏好时。
AI.method: 提出Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT)框架，并创建Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD)数据集，包含涉及矛盾人类偏好的场景。
AI.result: PFT在多项选择分类任务中达到96.6%准确率，开放生成得分8.69，显著优于DPO、SFT等传统方法。在有限用户历史数据下，模型能快速推断偏好向量，用户特定偏好对齐提升44.76%。
AI.conclusion: PFT框架能有效处理矛盾且动态的个人偏好，在用户偏好对齐方面表现优异，为个性化LLM对齐提供了有效解决方案。

title: Operationalising the Right to be Forgotten in LLMs: A Lightweight Sequential Unlearning Framework for Privacy-Aligned Deployment in Politically Sensitive Environments
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in politically sensitive environments, where memorisation of personal data or confidential content raises regulatory concerns under frameworks such as the GDPR and its Right to be Forgotten. Translating such legal principles into large-scale generative systems presents significant technical challenges.
  We introduce a lightweight sequential unlearning framework that explicitly separates retention and suppression objectives. The method first stabilises benign capabilities through positive fine-tuning, then applies layer-restricted negative fine-tuning to suppress designated sensitive patterns while preserving general language competence.
  Experiments on the SemEval-2025 LLM Unlearning benchmark demonstrate effective behavioural suppression with minimal impact on factual accuracy and fluency. GPT-2 exhibits greater robustness than DistilGPT-2, highlighting the role of model capacity in privacy-aligned adaptation. We position sequential unlearning as a practical and reproducible mechanism for operationalising data erasure requirements in politically deployed LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级顺序遗忘框架，通过分离保留和抑制目标，在保持语言能力的同时消除LLM中的敏感信息，满足GDPR等法规的"被遗忘权"要求。
AI.motivation: LLM在政治敏感环境中部署时，对个人数据或机密内容的记忆会引发GDPR等法规的合规问题，特别是"被遗忘权"要求。将法律原则转化为大规模生成系统的技术实现面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 引入轻量级顺序遗忘框架，明确分离保留和抑制目标：首先通过正向微调稳定良性能力，然后应用层限制的负向微调来抑制指定的敏感模式，同时保持一般语言能力。
AI.result: 在SemEval-2025 LLM遗忘基准测试中，该方法表现出有效的行为抑制，对事实准确性和流畅性的影响最小。GPT-2比DistilGPT-2表现出更强的鲁棒性，突显了模型容量在隐私对齐适应中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 顺序遗忘作为一种实用且可复现的机制，可用于在政治部署的LLM中实现数据擦除要求，平衡隐私保护与模型性能。

title: Bridging the Micro--Macro Gap: Frequency-Aware Semantic Alignment for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: As generative image editing advances, image manipulation localization (IML) must handle both traditional manipulations with conspicuous forensic artifacts and diffusion-generated edits that appear locally realistic. Existing methods typically rely on either low-level forensic cues or high-level semantics alone, leading to a fundamental micro--macro gap. To bridge this gap, we propose FASA, a unified framework for localizing both traditional and diffusion-generated manipulations. Specifically, we extract manipulation-sensitive frequency cues through an adaptive dual-band DCT module and learn manipulation-aware semantic priors via patch-level contrastive alignment on frozen CLIP representations. We then inject these priors into a hierarchical frequency pathway through a semantic-frequency side adapter for multi-scale feature interaction, and employ a prototype-guided, frequency-gated mask decoder to integrate semantic consistency with boundary-aware localization for tampered region prediction. Extensive experiments on OpenSDI and multiple traditional manipulation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art localization performance, strong cross-generator and cross-dataset generalization, and robust performance under common image degradations.

AI.tldr: FASA是一个统一的图像篡改定位框架，能够同时处理传统篡改和扩散生成编辑，通过结合频率线索和语义先验来弥合微观-宏观差距。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式图像编辑技术的发展，图像篡改定位需要同时处理具有明显取证痕迹的传统篡改和局部逼真的扩散生成编辑。现有方法通常只依赖低级取证线索或高级语义，导致微观-宏观差距。
AI.method: 提出FASA框架：1) 通过自适应双频带DCT模块提取篡改敏感的频率线索；2) 在冻结的CLIP表示上通过补丁级对比对齐学习篡改感知的语义先验；3) 通过语义-频率侧适配器将这些先验注入分层频率路径进行多尺度特征交互；4) 使用原型引导、频率门控的掩码解码器整合语义一致性和边界感知定位来预测篡改区域。
AI.result: 在OpenSDI和多个传统篡改基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了最先进的定位性能，具有较强的跨生成器和跨数据集泛化能力，并在常见图像退化条件下表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: FASA通过统一频率线索和语义先验的方法，有效弥合了图像篡改定位中的微观-宏观差距，能够同时处理传统和扩散生成的篡改，具有优异的性能和泛化能力。

title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong abilities in natural language understanding and generation, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive reasoning. Structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide an effective form of external knowledge representation and have been widely used to enhance performance in classical Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) tasks. However, performing precise multi-hop reasoning over KGs for complex queries remains highly challenging. Most existing approaches decompose the reasoning process into a sequence of isolated steps executed through a fixed pipeline. While effective to some extent, such designs constrain reasoning flexibility and fragment the overall decision process, often leading to incoherence and the loss of critical intermediate information from earlier steps. In this paper, we introduce KG-Reasoner, an end-to-end framework that integrates multi-step reasoning into a unified "thinking" phase of a Reasoning LLM. Through Reinforcement Learning (RL), the LLM is trained to internalize the KG traversal process, enabling it to dynamically explore reasoning paths, and perform backtracking when necessary. Experiments on eight multi-hop and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that KG-Reasoner achieves competitive or superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/KG-Reasoner.

AI.tldr: KG-Reasoner：一个端到端框架，通过强化学习训练LLM内化知识图谱遍历过程，实现动态多跳推理，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在知识密集型推理任务上表现不佳，而传统知识图谱问答方法通常将推理过程分解为固定流水线的孤立步骤，限制了推理灵活性，导致中间信息丢失和推理不连贯。
AI.method: 提出KG-Reasoner框架，将多步推理整合到推理LLM的统一"思考"阶段，通过强化学习训练LLM内化知识图谱遍历过程，使其能够动态探索推理路径并在必要时进行回溯。
AI.result: 在8个多跳和知识密集型推理基准测试中，KG-Reasoner取得了竞争性或优于现有最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: KG-Reasoner通过端到端框架将知识图谱推理整合到LLM的思考过程中，克服了传统方法的局限性，实现了更灵活、连贯的多跳推理，为知识密集型任务提供了有效解决方案。

title: Enhancing Clustering: An Explainable Approach via Filtered Patterns
summary: Machine learning has become a central research area, with increasing attention devoted to explainable clustering, also known as conceptual clustering, which is a knowledge-driven unsupervised learning paradigm that partitions data into $θ$ disjoint clusters, where each cluster is described by an explicit symbolic representation, typically expressed as a closed pattern or itemset. By providing human-interpretable cluster descriptions, explainable clustering plays an important role in explainable artificial intelligence and knowledge discovery. Recent work improved clustering quality by introducing k-relaxed frequent patterns (k-RFPs), a pattern model that relaxes strict coverage constraints through a generalized kcover definition. This framework integrates constraint-based reasoning, using SAT solvers for pattern generation, with combinatorial optimization, using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) for cluster selection. Despite its effectiveness, this approach suffers from a critical limitation: multiple distinct k-RFPs may induce identical k-covers, leading to redundant symbolic representations that unnecessarily enlarge the search space and increase computational complexity during cluster construction. In this paper, we address this redundancy through a pattern reduction framework. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formally characterize the conditions under which distinct k-RFPs induce identical kcovers, providing theoretical foundations for redundancy detection. Second, we propose an optimization strategy that removes redundant patterns by retaining a single representative pattern for each distinct k-cover. Third, we investigate the interpretability and representativeness of the patterns selected by the ILP model by analyzing their robustness with respect to their induced clusters. Extensive experiments conducted on several real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly reduces the pattern search space, improves computational efficiency, preserves and enhances in some cases the quality of the resulting clusters.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模式约简框架，通过消除k-松弛频繁模式中的冗余表示来提升可解释聚类的计算效率和聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于k-松弛频繁模式的可解释聚类方法存在冗余问题：多个不同的k-RFP可能产生相同的k-覆盖，导致搜索空间不必要扩大，增加计算复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 形式化描述不同k-RFP产生相同k-覆盖的条件；2) 提出优化策略，为每个不同的k-cover保留单一代表性模式；3) 分析ILP模型选择模式的鲁棒性、可解释性和代表性。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了模式搜索空间，提高了计算效率，同时保持并有时提升了聚类质量。
AI.conclusion: 提出的模式约简框架有效解决了可解释聚类中的冗余问题，为基于约束推理和组合优化的聚类方法提供了更高效的实现方案。

title: Detecting Precise Hand Touch Moments in Egocentric Video
summary:
We address the challenging task of detecting the precise moment when hands make contact with objects in egocentric videos. This frame-level detection is crucial for augmented reality, human-computer interaction, assistive technologies, and robot learning applications, where contact onset signals action initiation or completion. Temporally precise detection is particularly challenging due to subtle hand motion variations near contact, frequent occlusions, fine-grained manipulation patterns, and the inherent motion dynamics of first-person perspectives.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose a Hand-informed Context Enhanced module (HiCE; pronounced `high-see') that leverages spatiotemporal features from hand regions and their surrounding context through cross-attention mechanisms, learning to identify potential contact patterns. Our approach is further refined with a grasp-aware loss and soft label that emphasizes hand pose patterns and movement dynamics characteristic of touch events, enabling the model to distinguish between near-contact and actual contact frames. We also introduce TouchMoment, an egocentric dataset containing 4,021 videos and 8,456 annotated contact moments spanning over one million frames. Experiments on TouchMoment show that, under a strict evaluation criterion that counts a prediction as correct only if it falls within a two-frame tolerance of the ground-truth moment, our method achieves substantial gains and outperforms state-of-the-art event-spotting baselines by 16.91% average precision.

AI.tldr: 提出HiCE模块用于精确检测第一人称视角视频中手与物体接触的时刻，通过结合手部区域时空特征和上下文信息，在TouchMoment数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在增强现实、人机交互、辅助技术和机器人学习等应用中，精确检测手与物体接触的瞬间至关重要。但由于手部运动变化细微、频繁遮挡、精细操作模式以及第一人称视角固有的运动动态，实现时间精确的检测具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出Hand-informed Context Enhanced模块（HiCE），通过交叉注意力机制利用手部区域及其周围上下文的时空特征，学习识别潜在的接触模式。采用抓握感知损失和软标签强调接触事件特有的手部姿态模式和运动动态，使模型能够区分接近接触和实际接触帧。
AI.result: 在TouchMoment数据集（包含4,021个视频和8,456个标注接触时刻）上，在严格的评估标准下（预测必须在真实时刻的两帧容差内才算正确），该方法实现了显著提升，比最先进的事件检测基线平均精度高出16.91%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的HiCE模块通过有效结合手部信息和上下文特征，能够精确检测第一人称视频中的接触时刻，为需要精确时间定位的应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Calibrated Confidence Estimation for Tabular Question Answering
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (8-page main body + appendix)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for tabular question
  answering, yet calibration on structured data is largely unstudied. This
  paper presents the first systematic comparison of five confidence estimation
  methods across five frontier LLMs and two tabular QA benchmarks. All models
  are severely overconfident (smooth ECE 0.35-0.64 versus 0.10-0.15 reported
  for textual QA). A consistent self-evaluation versus perturbation dichotomy
  replicates across both benchmarks and all four fully-covered models:
  self-evaluation methods (verbalized, P(True)) achieve AUROC 0.42-0.76, while
  perturbation methods (semantic entropy, self-consistency, and our
  Multi-Format Agreement) achieve AUROC 0.78-0.86. Per-model paired bootstrap
  tests reject the null at p<0.001 after Holm-Bonferroni correction, and a
  3-seed check on GPT-4o-mini gives a per-seed standard deviation of only
  0.006. The paper proposes Multi-Format Agreement (MFA), which exploits the
  lossless and deterministic serialization variation unique to structured data
  (Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV) to estimate confidence at 20% lower API cost
  than sampling baselines. MFA reduces ECE by 44-63%, generalizes across all
  four models on TableBench (mean AUROC 0.80), and combines complementarily
  with sampling: an MFA + self-consistency ensemble lifts AUROC from 0.74 to
  0.82. A secondary contribution, structure-aware recalibration, improves
  AUROC by +10 percentage points over standard post-hoc methods.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统比较了五种置信度估计方法在表格问答任务中的表现，发现LLMs在结构化数据上严重过度自信，并提出了一种新的多格式一致性方法（MFA）来降低API成本并提高校准效果。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于表格问答任务，但在结构化数据上的校准研究严重不足。现有研究主要关注文本问答的校准，而表格数据的独特特性（如无损序列化格式）尚未被充分利用。
AI.method:
1. 系统比较五种置信度估计方法：自我评估方法（言语化、P(True)）和扰动方法（语义熵、自一致性、多格式一致性）
2. 提出多格式一致性方法（MFA），利用结构化数据的无损确定性序列化变体（Markdown、HTML、JSON、CSV）来估计置信度
3. 提出结构感知的重新校准方法
4. 在五个前沿LLM和两个表格QA基准上进行评估
AI.result:
1. 所有模型在表格数据上都严重过度自信（平滑ECE 0.35-0.64 vs 文本QA的0.10-0.15）
2. 自我评估方法表现较差（AUROC 0.42-0.76），而扰动方法表现更好（AUROC 0.78-0.86）
3. MFA比采样基线降低20%的API成本，将ECE降低44-63%，在TableBench上平均AUROC达到0.80
4. MFA与自一致性集成将AUROC从0.74提升到0.82
5. 结构感知重新校准比标准后处理方法提高AUROC 10个百分点
AI.conclusion: LLMs在表格问答中存在严重的校准问题，但通过利用结构化数据的独特特性（如多格式序列化），可以显著提高置信度估计的准确性和成本效益。MFA方法为表格QA的可靠部署提供了有效的解决方案。

title: CIA: Inferring the Communication Topology from LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks. Central to MAS is the communication topology which governs how agents exchange information internally. Consequently, the security of communication topologies has attracted increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate a critical privacy risk: MAS communication topologies can be inferred under a restrictive black-box setting, exposing system vulnerabilities and posing significant intellectual property threats. To explore this risk, we propose Communication Inference Attack (CIA), a novel attack that constructs new adversarial queries to induce intermediate agents' reasoning outputs and models their semantic correlations through the proposed global bias disentanglement and LLM-guided weak supervision. Extensive experiments on MAS with optimized communication topologies demonstrate the effectiveness of CIA, achieving an average AUC of 0.87 and a peak AUC of up to 0.99, thereby revealing the substantial privacy risk in MAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通信推断攻击(CIA)，在限制性黑盒设置下通过构造对抗性查询诱导中间代理推理输出，利用全局偏置解缠和LLM引导的弱监督建模语义相关性，成功推断多智能体系统的通信拓扑结构，揭示了MAS的重大隐私风险。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统(MAS)在解决复杂任务方面表现出卓越能力，通信拓扑结构是MAS的核心，决定了智能体之间如何交换信息。随着MAS应用的普及，通信拓扑的安全性日益受到关注。本文旨在研究一个关键的隐私风险：在限制性黑盒设置下，MAS的通信拓扑结构可以被推断出来，这会暴露系统漏洞并构成重大的知识产权威胁。
AI.method: 提出通信推断攻击(CIA)方法：1) 构造新的对抗性查询来诱导中间智能体的推理输出；2) 通过全局偏置解缠技术处理数据；3) 利用LLM引导的弱监督建模智能体输出之间的语义相关性；4) 在具有优化通信拓扑的MAS上进行广泛实验验证。
AI.result: 在具有优化通信拓扑的MAS上进行的大量实验表明，CIA方法非常有效，平均AUC达到0.87，峰值AUC高达0.99，成功揭示了MAS中存在的重大隐私风险。
AI.conclusion: 通信推断攻击(CIA)能够成功推断多智能体系统的通信拓扑结构，即使在限制性黑盒设置下也能实现高精度攻击，这暴露了MAS通信拓扑的重大隐私风险，对系统安全性和知识产权保护构成严重威胁。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Grounding DINO in Videos: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Limited-Data Spatial-Temporal Localization
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize queried objects within dynamic video segments. Prevailing fully-trained approaches are notoriously data-hungry. However, gathering large-scale STVG data is exceptionally challenging: dense frame-level bounding boxes and complex temporal language alignments are prohibitively expensive to annotate, especially for specialized video domains. Consequently, conventional models suffer from severe overfitting on these inherently limited datasets, while zero-shot foundational models lack the task-specific temporal awareness needed for precise localization. To resolve this small-data challenge, we introduce ST-GD, a data-efficient framework that adapts pre-trained 2D visual-language models (e.g., Grounding DINO) to video tasks. To avoid destroying pre-trained priors on small datasets, ST-GD keeps the base model frozen and strategically injects lightweight adapters (~10M trainable parameters) to instill spatio-temporal awareness, alongside a novel temporal decoder for boundary prediction. This design naturally counters data scarcity. Consequently, ST-GD excels in data-scarce scenarios, achieving highly competitive performance on the limited-scale HC-STVG v1/v2 benchmarks, while maintaining robust generalization on the VidSTG dataset. This validates ST-GD as a powerful paradigm for complex video understanding under strict small-data constraints.

AI.tldr: ST-GD是一个数据高效的时空视频定位框架，通过冻结预训练基础模型并注入轻量适配器来解决小数据挑战，在有限数据集上取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 时空视频定位(STVG)需要大量标注数据，但获取大规模STVG数据异常困难，因为密集的帧级边界框和复杂的时间语言对齐标注成本极高。传统模型在有限数据集上严重过拟合，而零样本基础模型缺乏任务特定的时间感知能力。
AI.method: ST-GD采用数据高效框架，保持预训练的2D视觉语言模型(如Grounding DINO)冻结，仅注入轻量适配器(~1000万可训练参数)来注入时空感知能力，并设计新颖的时间解码器进行边界预测。
AI.result: ST-GD在数据稀缺场景中表现出色，在有限规模的HC-STVG v1/v2基准测试中取得高度竞争性性能，同时在VidSTG数据集上保持稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ST-GD验证了在严格小数据约束下进行复杂视频理解的有效范式，通过适配预训练模型而非完全训练来解决数据稀缺问题。

title: Latent Planning Emerges with Scale
summary: LLMs can perform seemingly planning-intensive tasks, like writing coherent stories or functioning code, without explicitly verbalizing a plan; however, the extent to which they implicitly plan is unknown. In this paper, we define latent planning as occurring when LLMs possess internal planning representations that (1) cause the generation of a specific future token or concept, and (2) shape preceding context to license said future token or concept. We study the Qwen-3 family (0.6B-14B) on simple planning tasks, finding that latent planning ability increases with scale. Models that plan possess features that represent a planned-for word like "accountant", and cause them to output "an" rather than "a"; moreover, even the less-successful Qwen-3 4B-8B have nascent planning mechanisms. On the more complex task of completing rhyming couplets, we find that models often identify a rhyme ahead of time, but even large models seldom plan far ahead. However, we can elicit some planning that increases with scale when steering models towards planned words in prose. In sum, we offer a framework for measuring planning and mechanistic evidence of how models' planning abilities grow with scale.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"潜在规划"概念，发现LLMs在简单任务中表现出随模型规模增长的规划能力，但在复杂任务中规划能力有限
AI.motivation: 研究LLMs是否具备内部规划能力，即使它们没有明确表达计划。虽然LLMs能完成看似需要规划的任务，但它们是否真正进行内部规划尚不清楚
AI.method: 提出"潜在规划"定义，研究Qwen-3系列模型(0.6B-14B)在简单规划任务中的表现，分析模型特征表示，并在押韵对句和散文生成任务中测试规划能力
AI.result: 1. 潜在规划能力随模型规模增加而增强；2. 成功规划的模型具有代表计划词汇的特征；3. 在押韵任务中，模型能提前识别押韵词但很少提前规划；4. 在散文任务中，通过引导可激发规划能力且随规模增加
AI.conclusion: 提供了测量规划能力的框架和机制证据，表明LLMs的规划能力随规模增长，但即使在大型模型中，规划能力也有限且主要针对近期目标

title: Intelligent ROI-Based Vehicle Counting Framework for Automated Traffic Monitoring
summary: Accurate vehicle counting through video surveillance is crucial for efficient traffic management. However, achieving high counting accuracy while ensuring computational efficiency remains a challenge. To address this, we propose a fully automated, video-based vehicle counting framework designed to optimize both computational efficiency and counting accuracy. Our framework operates in two distinct phases: \textit{estimation} and \textit{prediction}. In the estimation phase, the optimal region of interest (ROI) is automatically determined using a novel combination of three models based on detection scores, tracking scores, and vehicle density. This adaptive approach ensures compatibility with any detection and tracking method, enhancing the framework's versatility. In the prediction phase, vehicle counting is efficiently performed within the estimated ROI. We evaluated our framework on benchmark datasets like UA-DETRAC, GRAM, CDnet 2014, and ATON. Results demonstrate exceptional accuracy, with most videos achieving 100\% accuracy, while also enhancing computational efficiency, making processing up to four times faster than full-frame processing. The framework outperforms existing techniques, especially in complex multi-road scenarios, demonstrating robustness and superior accuracy. These advancements make it a promising solution for real-time traffic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段视频车辆计数框架，通过自动确定最优感兴趣区域来平衡计算效率和计数精度，在多个基准数据集上实现高精度和4倍加速。
AI.motivation: 视频监控中的车辆计数对交通管理至关重要，但如何在保证高计数精度的同时确保计算效率仍然是一个挑战。现有方法往往需要在精度和效率之间做出权衡。
AI.method: 提出一个完全自动化的两阶段框架：1) 估计阶段：基于检测分数、跟踪分数和车辆密度三个模型的组合自动确定最优感兴趣区域(ROI)；2) 预测阶段：在估计的ROI内高效进行车辆计数。该框架兼容任何检测和跟踪方法。
AI.result: 在UA-DETRAC、GRAM、CDnet 2014和ATON等基准数据集上评估，大多数视频达到100%的计数精度，同时计算效率提升4倍（相比全帧处理）。在复杂的多道路场景中表现优于现有技术。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过自适应ROI选择实现了计算效率和计数精度的优化平衡，在复杂场景中表现出鲁棒性和优越精度，是实时交通监控的有前景解决方案。

title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks but remain prone to hallucinations in knowledge-intensive scenarios. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) mitigates this by grounding generation in Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, most multi-hop KBQA methods rely on explicit edge traversal, making them fragile to KG incompleteness. In this paper, we proposed a novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning. Specifically, we employ a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode extracted structural subgraphs into soft prompts, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage paradigm that reduces computational cost while preserving good performance: a lightweight LLM first leverages the soft prompts to identify question-relevant entities and relations, followed by a more powerful LLM for evidence-aware answer generation. Experiments on four multi-hop KBQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three of them, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图的软提示框架，将多跳知识库问答从节点级路径遍历转向子图级推理，通过GNN编码结构子图为软提示，减少对缺失边的敏感性，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识密集型场景中容易产生幻觉，知识库问答通过知识图谱进行基础生成可以缓解此问题。但现有多跳KBQA方法依赖显式边遍历，对知识图谱不完整性敏感，需要更鲁棒的推理方法。
AI.method: 提出图基软提示框架：1) 使用GNN将提取的结构子图编码为软提示，使LLM能在更丰富的结构上下文中推理；2) 引入两阶段范式：轻量级LLM利用软提示识别相关实体和关系，然后更强大的LLM进行证据感知的答案生成。
AI.result: 在四个多跳KBQA基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在三个基准上达到了最先进的性能，证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的图基软提示框架通过将推理从节点级路径遍历转向子图级推理，减少了对缺失边的敏感性，在保持良好性能的同时降低了计算成本，为多跳KBQA提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Technical Report -- A Context-Sensitive Multi-Level Similarity Framework for First-Order Logic Arguments: An Axiomatic Study
summary: Similarity in formal argumentation has recently gained attention due to its significance in problems such as argument aggregation in semantics and enthymeme decoding. While existing approaches focus on propositional logic, we address the richer setting of First-Order Logic (FOL), where similarity must account for structured content. We introduce a comprehensive framework for FOL argument similarity, built upon: (1) an extended axiomatic foundation; (2) a four-level parametric model covering predicates, literals, clauses, and formulae similarity; (3) two model families, one syntax-sensitive via language models, both integrating contextual weights for nuanced and explainable similarity; and (4) formal constraints enforcing desirable properties.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于一阶逻辑（FOL）形式论证相似性的综合框架，包含扩展的公理基础、四层参数模型、两种模型家族以及形式约束。
AI.motivation: 形式论证中的相似性在语义中的论证聚合和省略推理解码等问题中具有重要意义。现有方法主要关注命题逻辑，而一阶逻辑具有更丰富的结构化内容，需要更全面的相似性度量框架。
AI.method: 1. 扩展的公理基础；2. 四层参数模型（谓词、文字、子句、公式相似性）；3. 两种模型家族（一种基于语言模型的语法敏感方法，都整合了上下文权重）；4. 强制执行理想属性的形式约束。
AI.result: 提出了一个全面的FOL论证相似性框架，能够处理结构化内容，提供细致且可解释的相似性度量，满足形式论证中的实际需求。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为一阶逻辑形式论证相似性提供了系统化的解决方案，弥补了现有方法主要关注命题逻辑的不足，为论证聚合和省略推理解码等应用提供了理论基础。

title: Combating Pattern and Content Bias: Adversarial Feature Learning for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: In recent years, the rapid development of generative artificial intelligence technology has significantly lowered the barrier to creating high-quality fake images, posing a serious challenge to information authenticity and credibility. Existing generated image detection methods typically enhance generalization through model architecture or network design. However, their generalization performance remains susceptible to data bias, as the training data may drive models to fit specific generative patterns and content rather than the common features shared by images from different generative models (asymmetric bias learning). To address this issue, we propose a Multi-dimensional Adversarial Feature Learning (MAFL) framework. The framework adopts a pretrained multimodal image encoder as the feature extraction backbone, constructs a real-fake feature learning network, and designs an adversarial bias-learning branch equipped with a multi-dimensional adversarial loss, forming an adversarial training mechanism between authenticity-discriminative feature learning and bias feature learning. By suppressing generation-pattern and content biases, MAFL guides the model to focus on the generative features shared across different generative models, thereby effectively capturing the fundamental differences between real and generated images, enhancing cross-model generalization, and substantially reducing the reliance on large-scale training data. Through extensive experimental validation, our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches by 10.89% in accuracy and 8.57% in Average Precision (AP). Notably, even when trained with only 320 images, it can still achieve over 80% detection accuracy on public datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出MAFL框架解决生成图像检测中的泛化问题，通过对抗性学习抑制生成模式和内容偏差，提升跨模型检测性能
AI.motivation: 生成AI技术降低了高质量假图像的创建门槛，现有检测方法容易受到数据偏差影响，模型倾向于学习特定生成模式和内容特征而非跨模型的通用生成特征
AI.method: 提出多维对抗特征学习（MAFL）框架：使用预训练多模态图像编码器作为特征提取主干，构建真假特征学习网络，设计带有多维对抗损失的对抗偏差学习分支，形成真实性判别特征学习与偏差特征学习之间的对抗训练机制
AI.result: 在准确率上超越现有最佳方法10.89%，平均精度（AP）提升8.57%；仅用320张图像训练仍能在公开数据集上达到80%以上的检测准确率
AI.conclusion: MAFL框架通过对抗性学习有效抑制生成模式和内容偏差，使模型专注于不同生成模型共享的生成特征，显著提升跨模型泛化能力并减少对大规模训练数据的依赖

title: Beyond Transcription: Unified Audio Schema for Perception-Aware AudioLLMs
summary: Recent Audio Large Language Models (AudioLLMs) exhibit a striking performance inversion: while excelling at complex reasoning tasks, they consistently underperform on fine-grained acoustic perception. We attribute this gap to a fundamental limitation of ASR-centric training, which provides precise linguistic targets but implicitly teaches models to suppress paralinguistic cues and acoustic events as noise. To address this, we propose Unified Audio Schema (UAS), a holistic and structured supervision framework that organizes audio information into three explicit components -- Transcription, Paralinguistics, and Non-linguistic Events -- within a unified JSON format. This design achieves comprehensive acoustic coverage without sacrificing the tight audio-text alignment that enables reasoning. We validate the effectiveness of this supervision strategy by applying it to both discrete and continuous AudioLLM architectures. Extensive experiments on MMSU, MMAR, and MMAU demonstrate that UAS-Audio yields consistent improvements, boosting fine-grained perception by 10.9% on MMSU over the same-size state-of-the-art models while preserving robust reasoning capabilities. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/Tencent/Unified_Audio_Schema.

AI.tldr: 提出统一音频模式(UAS)解决音频大语言模型在复杂推理任务表现优秀但细粒度声学感知能力不足的问题，通过结构化监督框架将音频信息组织为转录、副语言和非语言事件三个组件。
AI.motivation: 当前音频大语言模型存在性能倒置现象：在复杂推理任务上表现出色，但在细粒度声学感知方面表现不佳。这源于ASR中心化训练的根本局限性，该训练提供精确的语言目标，但隐式地教导模型将副语言线索和声学事件视为噪声而抑制。
AI.method: 提出统一音频模式(UAS)，一个整体且结构化的监督框架，将音频信息组织为三个明确组件——转录、副语言和非语言事件，采用统一的JSON格式。这种设计实现了全面的声学覆盖，同时不牺牲支持推理的紧密音频-文本对齐。
AI.result: 在MMSU、MMAR和MMAU上的广泛实验表明，UAS-Audio产生了一致的改进，在MMSU上比同规模的最先进模型提升了10.9%的细粒度感知能力，同时保持了稳健的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: UAS框架有效解决了音频大语言模型的性能倒置问题，通过结构化监督显著提升了细粒度声学感知能力，同时保持了模型的推理能力，为音频理解提供了更全面的解决方案。

title: A Two-Stage LLM Framework for Accessible and Verified XAI Explanations
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate the technical outputs of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods into accessible natural-language explanations. However, existing approaches often lack guarantees of accuracy, faithfulness, and completeness. At the same time, current efforts to evaluate such narratives remain largely subjective or confined to post-hoc scoring, offering no safeguards to prevent flawed explanations from reaching end-users. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Two-Stage LLM Meta-Verification Framework that consists of (i) an Explainer LLM that converts raw XAI outputs into natural-language narratives, (ii) a Verifier LLM that assesses them in terms of faithfulness, coherence, completeness, and hallucination risk, and (iii) an iterative refeed mechanism that uses the Verifier's feedback to refine and improve them. Experiments across five XAI techniques and datasets, using three families of open-weight LLMs, show that verification is crucial for filtering unreliable explanations while improving linguistic accessibility compared with raw XAI outputs. In addition, the analysis of the Entropy Production Rate (EPR) during the refinement process indicates that the Verifier's feedback progressively guides the Explainer toward more stable and coherent reasoning. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient pathway toward more trustworthy and democratized XAI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段LLM元验证框架，通过解释器LLM将XAI输出转化为自然语言，验证器LLM评估其忠实性、连贯性、完整性和幻觉风险，并通过迭代反馈机制改进解释，提高XAI解释的可信度和可访问性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM用于解释XAI输出的方法缺乏准确性、忠实性和完整性的保证，现有评估方法主观且局限于事后评分，无法防止有缺陷的解释到达最终用户。
AI.method: 提出两阶段LLM元验证框架：1) 解释器LLM将原始XAI输出转化为自然语言叙述；2) 验证器LLM从忠实性、连贯性、完整性和幻觉风险四个维度评估解释；3) 迭代反馈机制利用验证器的反馈来改进解释。
AI.result: 在五种XAI技术和数据集、三个开源LLM家族的实验中，验证对于过滤不可靠解释至关重要，同时相比原始XAI输出提高了语言可访问性。熵产生率分析表明验证器的反馈逐步引导解释器走向更稳定和连贯的推理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为实现更可信和民主化的XAI系统提供了有效途径，通过元验证机制确保解释的质量和可靠性。

title: Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) integrates heterogeneous text, audio, and visual signals to infer human emotions. While recent approaches leverage cross-modal complementarity, they often struggle to fully utilize weaker modalities. In practice, dominant modalities tend to overshadow non-verbal ones, inducing modality competition and limiting overall contributions. This imbalance degrades fusion performance and robustness under noisy or missing modalities. To address this, we propose a novel model, Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration framework (EBMC). EBMC improves representation quality via semantic disentanglement and cross-modal enhancement, strengthening weaker modalities. To prevent dominant modalities from overwhelming others, an Energy-guided Modality Coordination mechanism achieves implicit gradient rebalancing via a differentiable equilibrium objective. Furthermore, Instance-aware Modality Trust Distillation estimates sample-level reliability to adaptively modulate fusion weights, ensuring robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EBMC achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results and maintains strong performance under missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 提出EBMC框架解决多模态情感分析中模态不平衡问题，通过增强弱模态、协调梯度平衡和自适应融合权重，提升整体性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中，主导模态往往压制非语言模态，导致模态竞争和不平衡，降低融合性能和鲁棒性，特别是在噪声或缺失模态情况下。
AI.method: 提出EBMC框架：1）通过语义解耦和跨模态增强提升弱模态表示质量；2）能量引导的模态协调机制实现隐式梯度再平衡；3）实例感知的模态信任蒸馏自适应调整融合权重。
AI.result: EBMC在多模态情感分析任务中达到最先进或竞争性结果，在缺失模态设置下仍保持强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: EBMC框架通过增强弱模态、平衡模态贡献和自适应融合，有效解决了多模态情感分析中的模态不平衡问题，提升了模型的鲁棒性和性能。

title: Cross-Cultural Simulation of Citizen Emotional Responses to Bureaucratic Red Tape Using LLM Agents
comment: To appear in the CHI 2026 Workshop on PoliSim
summary: Improving policymaking is a central concern in public administration. Prior human subject studies reveal substantial cross-cultural differences in citizens' emotional responses to red tape during policy implementation. While LLM agents offer opportunities to simulate human-like responses and reduce experimental costs, their ability to generate culturally appropriate emotional responses to red tape remains unverified. To address this gap, we propose an evaluation framework for assessing LLMs' emotional responses to red tape across diverse cultural contexts. As a pilot study, we apply this framework to a single red-tape scenario. Our results show that all models exhibit limited alignment with human emotional responses, with notably weaker performance in Eastern cultures. Cultural prompting strategies prove largely ineffective in improving alignment. We further introduce \textbf{RAMO}, an interactive interface for simulating citizens' emotional responses to red tape and for collecting human data to improve models. The interface is publicly available at https://ramo-chi.ivia.ch.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个评估框架来测试LLM在不同文化背景下对官僚作风的情感反应，发现所有模型与人类情感反应的对齐度有限，尤其是在东方文化中表现更差，文化提示策略效果不佳，并开发了RAMO交互界面用于模拟和收集数据。
AI.motivation: 改进政策制定是公共管理的核心关切。先前的人类研究表明，公民在政策实施中对官僚作风的情感反应存在显著的跨文化差异。虽然LLM代理提供了模拟人类反应和降低实验成本的机会，但其生成符合文化背景的官僚作风情感反应的能力尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 提出了一个评估框架来评估LLM在不同文化背景下对官僚作风的情感反应。作为试点研究，将该框架应用于单个官僚作风场景。测试了文化提示策略的有效性，并开发了RAMO交互界面用于模拟公民情感反应和收集人类数据。
AI.result: 所有模型都表现出与人类情感反应的有限对齐，在东方文化中的表现明显更弱。文化提示策略在改善对齐方面基本无效。
AI.conclusion: LLM在生成符合文化背景的官僚作风情感反应方面存在局限性，需要进一步改进。RAMO界面为模拟和收集数据提供了工具，有助于未来模型的改进。

title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding
summary: Recently, visual token pruning has been studied to handle the vast number of visual tokens in Multimodal Large Language Models. However, we observe that while existing pruning methods perform reliably on simple visual understanding, they struggle to effectively generalize to complex visual reasoning tasks, a critical gap underexplored in previous studies. Through a systematic analysis, we identify Relevant Visual Information Shift (RVIS) during decoding as the primary failure driver. To address this, we propose Decoding-stage Shift-aware Token Pruning (DSTP), a training-free add-on framework that enables existing pruning methods to align visual tokens with shifting reasoning requirements during the decoding stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSTP significantly mitigates performance degradation of pruning methods in complex reasoning tasks, while consistently yielding performance gains even across visual understanding benchmarks. Furthermore, DSTP demonstrates effectiveness across diverse state-of-the-art architectures, highlighting its generalizability and efficiency with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出DSTP框架解决视觉token剪枝在复杂视觉推理任务中的泛化问题，通过解码阶段感知信息偏移来对齐视觉token与推理需求
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法在简单视觉理解任务中表现可靠，但在复杂视觉推理任务中泛化能力不足，存在关键的研究空白。研究发现解码过程中的相关视觉信息偏移是主要失败原因。
AI.method: 提出解码阶段偏移感知token剪枝（DSTP），这是一个无需训练的附加框架，使现有剪枝方法能够在解码阶段对齐视觉token与变化的推理需求。
AI.result: DSTP显著减轻了剪枝方法在复杂推理任务中的性能下降，同时在视觉理解基准测试中也带来一致性能提升。该框架在各种最先进架构中都有效，展示了其泛化能力和高效性，计算开销最小。
AI.conclusion: DSTP框架成功解决了视觉token剪枝在复杂视觉推理任务中的泛化问题，通过解码阶段感知信息偏移机制，为多模态大语言模型的视觉token处理提供了有效的解决方案。

title: IDEA: An Interpretable and Editable Decision-Making Framework for LLMs via Verbal-to-Numeric Calibration
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed for decision-making, yet their adoption in high-stakes domains remains limited by miscalibrated probabilities, unfaithful explanations, and inability to incorporate expert knowledge precisely. We propose IDEA, a framework that extracts LLM decision knowledge into an interpretable parametric model over semantically meaningful factors. Through joint learning of verbal-to-numerical mappings and decision parameters via EM, correlated sampling that preserves factor dependencies, and direct parameter editing with mathematical guarantees, IDEA produces calibrated probabilities while enabling quantitative human-AI collaboration. Experiments across five datasets show IDEA with Qwen-3-32B (78.6%) outperforms DeepSeek R1 (68.1%) and GPT-5.2 (77.9%), achieving perfect factor exclusion and exact calibration -- precision unattainable through prompting alone. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/leonbig/IDEA.

AI.tldr: IDEA框架将LLM决策知识提取到可解释的语义因子参数模型中，通过联合学习、相关采样和参数编辑实现校准概率和定量人机协作
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在高风险领域应用受限，主要问题包括概率校准不准确、解释不忠实、无法精确融入专家知识
AI.method: 提出IDEA框架：1）通过EM算法联合学习语言到数值映射和决策参数；2）保持因子依赖关系的相关采样；3）具有数学保证的直接参数编辑
AI.result: 在五个数据集上，IDEA配合Qwen-3-32B达到78.6%准确率，优于DeepSeek R1（68.1%）和GPT-5.2（77.9%），实现完美因子排除和精确校准
AI.conclusion: IDEA框架能够产生校准概率，支持定量人机协作，解决了仅通过提示无法达到的精确度问题，代码已开源

title: Reading Between the Pixels: Linking Text-Image Embedding Alignment to Typographic Attack Success on Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
summary: We study typographic prompt injection attacks on vision-language models (VLMs), where adversarial text is rendered as images to bypass safety mechanisms, posing a growing threat as VLMs serve as the perceptual backbone of autonomous agents, from browser automation and computer-use systems to camera-equipped embodied agents. In practice, the attack surface is heterogeneous: adversarial text appears at varying font sizes and under diverse visual conditions, while the growing ecosystem of VLMs exhibits substantial variation in vulnerability, complicating defensive approaches. Evaluating 1,000 prompts from SALAD-Bench across four VLMs, namely, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct under varying font sizes (6--28px) and visual transformations (rotation, blur, noise, contrast changes), we find: (1) font size significantly affects attack success rate (ASR), with very small fonts (6px) yielding near-zero ASR while mid-range fonts achieve peak effectiveness; (2) text attacks are more effective than image attacks for GPT-4o (36% vs 8%) and Claude (47% vs 22%), while Qwen3-VL and Mistral show comparable ASR across modalities; (3) text-image embedding distance from two multimodal embedding models (JinaCLIP and Qwen3-VL-Embedding) shows strong negative correlation with ASR across all four models (r = -0.71 to -0.93, p < 0.01); (4) heavy degradations increase embedding distance by 10--12% and reduce ASR by 34--96%, while rotation asymmetrically affects models (Mistral drops 50%, GPT-4o unchanged). These findings highlight that model-specific robustness patterns preclude one-size-fits-all defenses and offer empirical guidance for practitioners selecting VLM backbones for agentic systems operating in adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）中的排版提示注入攻击，发现字体大小、视觉变换对攻击成功率有显著影响，不同模型对攻击的脆弱性存在差异，文本-图像嵌入距离与攻击成功率呈强负相关。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型成为自主代理的感知骨干，从浏览器自动化到具身代理，排版提示注入攻击（对抗性文本以图像形式呈现以绕过安全机制）构成日益增长的威胁。攻击面具有异质性：对抗性文本以不同字体大小和视觉条件出现，而VLM生态系统在脆弱性上存在显著差异，这使防御方法复杂化。
AI.method: 使用SALAD-Bench的1000个提示，在四个VLM（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Mistral-Large-3、Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct）上评估不同字体大小（6-28px）和视觉变换（旋转、模糊、噪声、对比度变化）下的攻击效果。分析文本-图像嵌入距离与攻击成功率的关系。
AI.result: 1) 字体大小显著影响攻击成功率，极小字体（6px）攻击成功率接近零，中号字体效果最佳；2) 文本攻击对GPT-4o（36% vs 8%）和Claude（47% vs 22%）更有效，Qwen3-VL和Mistral在两种模态上表现相当；3) 文本-图像嵌入距离与攻击成功率在所有四个模型中呈强负相关（r = -0.71到-0.93）；4) 重度退化使嵌入距离增加10-12%，攻击成功率降低34-96%，旋转对模型影响不对称。
AI.conclusion: 模型特定的鲁棒性模式排除了"一刀切"的防御方法，为在对抗环境中为代理系统选择VLM骨干的实践者提供了经验指导。不同模型对排版攻击的脆弱性差异显著，需要针对性的防御策略。

title: FABLE: Fine-grained Fact Anchoring for Unstructured Model Editing
summary: Unstructured model editing aims to update models with real-world text, yet existing methods often memorize text holistically without reliable fine-grained fact access. To address this, we propose FABLE, a hierarchical framework that decouples fine-grained fact injection from holistic text generation. FABLE follows a two-stage, fact-first strategy: discrete facts are anchored in shallow layers, followed by minimal updates to deeper layers to produce coherent text. This decoupling resolves the mismatch between holistic recall and fine-grained fact access, reflecting the unidirectional Transformer flow in which surface-form generation amplifies rather than corrects underlying fact representations. We also introduce UnFine, a diagnostic benchmark with fine-grained question-answer pairs and fact-level metrics for systematic evaluation. Experiments show that FABLE substantially improves fine-grained question answering while maintaining state-of-the-art holistic editing performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/caskcsg/FABLE.

AI.tldr: FABLE是一个分层框架，通过将细粒度事实注入与整体文本生成解耦，解决现有非结构化模型编辑方法在细粒度事实访问上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有非结构化模型编辑方法通常整体记忆文本，缺乏可靠的细粒度事实访问能力，这导致模型在需要精确事实检索时表现不佳。
AI.method: FABLE采用两阶段、事实优先的策略：首先将离散事实锚定在浅层网络，然后对深层网络进行最小化更新以生成连贯文本，这种解耦反映了Transformer的单向流动特性。
AI.result: 实验表明，FABLE在细粒度问答任务上显著提升性能，同时保持最先进的整体编辑性能。作者还提出了UnFine诊断基准用于系统评估。
AI.conclusion: FABLE通过分层解耦方法有效解决了整体回忆与细粒度事实访问之间的不匹配问题，为非结构化模型编辑提供了更可靠的事实访问能力。

title: DeepTest Tool Competition 2026: Benchmarking an LLM-Based Automotive Assistant
comment: Published in the proceedings of the DeepTest workshop at the 48th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE) 2026
summary: This report summarizes the results of the first edition of the Large Language Model (LLM) Testing competition, held as part of the DeepTest workshop at ICSE 2026. Four tools competed in benchmarking an LLM-based car manual information retrieval application, with the objective of identifying user inputs for which the system fails to appropriately mention warnings contained in the manual. The testing solutions were evaluated based on their effectiveness in exposing failures and the diversity of the discovered failure-revealing tests. We report on the experimental methodology, the competitors, and the results.

AI.tldr: 首届LLM测试竞赛总结报告，评估了4个工具在测试基于LLM的汽车手册信息检索应用时的表现，重点关注系统未能适当提及手册警告的故障检测能力。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型在关键应用中的部署增加，需要系统化的测试方法来评估其可靠性和安全性。本次竞赛旨在推动LLM测试工具的发展，特别是在安全关键领域如汽车信息检索中。
AI.method: 竞赛设置了基于LLM的汽车手册信息检索应用作为测试对象，要求参赛工具识别系统未能适当提及手册警告的用户输入。评估基于故障暴露效果和发现的故障揭示测试的多样性。
AI.result: 四个测试工具参与了竞赛，在ICSE 2026的DeepTest研讨会上进行了展示。报告总结了实验方法、参赛工具和竞赛结果，但没有提供具体的排名或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 首届LLM测试竞赛成功举办，为评估LLM测试工具提供了基准平台，推动了该领域的研究发展，特别是在安全关键应用中的测试方法创新。

title: Transforming External Knowledge into Triplets for Enhanced Retrieval in RAG of LLMs
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucination in large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge during generation. However, the effectiveness of RAG depends not only on the design of the retriever and the capacity of the underlying model, but also on how retrieved evidence is structured and aligned with the query. Existing RAG approaches typically retrieve and concatenate unstructured text fragments as context, which often introduces redundant or weakly relevant information. This practice leads to excessive context accumulation, reduced semantic alignment, and fragmented reasoning chains, thereby degrading generation quality while increasing token consumption. To address these challenges, we propose Tri-RAG, a structured triplet-based retrieval framework that improves retrieval efficiency through reasoning-aligned context construction. Tri-RAG automatically transforms external knowledge from natural language into standardized structured triplets consisting of Condition, Proof, and Conclusion, explicitly capturing logical relations among knowledge fragments using lightweight prompt-based adaptation with frozen model parameters. Building on this representation, the triplet head Condition is treated as an explicit semantic anchor for retrieval and matching, enabling precise identification of query-relevant knowledge units without directly concatenating lengthy raw texts. As a result, Tri-RAG achieves a favorable balance between retrieval accuracy and context token efficiency. Experimental results across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that Tri-RAG significantly improves retrieval quality and reasoning efficiency, while producing more stable generation behavior and more efficient resource utilization in complex reasoning scenarios.

AI.tldr: Tri-RAG：基于结构化三元组的检索增强生成框架，通过将知识转换为条件-证明-结论三元组，提高检索效率和推理质量
AI.motivation: 传统RAG方法检索并拼接非结构化文本片段作为上下文，这会引入冗余或弱相关信息，导致上下文过度积累、语义对齐降低和推理链碎片化，从而降低生成质量并增加token消耗
AI.method: 提出Tri-RAG框架，将外部知识从自然语言自动转换为标准化的结构化三元组（条件、证明、结论），使用轻量级提示适配捕获知识片段间的逻辑关系。三元组的条件头作为显式语义锚点进行检索和匹配，无需直接拼接冗长原始文本
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，Tri-RAG显著提高了检索质量和推理效率，在复杂推理场景中产生更稳定的生成行为和更高效的资源利用
AI.conclusion: Tri-RAG通过结构化三元组表示实现了检索准确性和上下文token效率之间的良好平衡，为检索增强生成提供了更有效的知识表示和检索机制

title: Every Picture Tells a Dangerous Story: Memory-Augmented Multi-Agent Jailbreak Attacks on VLMs
summary: The rapid evolution of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has catalyzed unprecedented capabilities in artificial intelligence; however, this continuous modal expansion has inadvertently exposed a vastly broadened and unconstrained adversarial attack surface. Current multimodal jailbreak strategies primarily focus on surface-level pixel perturbations and typographic attacks or harmful images; however, they fail to engage with the complex semantic structures intrinsic to visual data. This leaves the vast semantic attack surface of original, natural images largely unscrutinized. Driven by the need to expose these deep-seated semantic vulnerabilities, we introduce \textbf{MemJack}, a \textbf{MEM}ory-augmented multi-agent \textbf{JA}ilbreak atta\textbf{CK} framework that explicitly leverages visual semantics to orchestrate automated jailbreak attacks. MemJack employs coordinated multi-agent cooperation to dynamically map visual entities to malicious intents, generate adversarial prompts via multi-angle visual-semantic camouflage, and utilize an Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) geometric filter to bypass premature latent space refusals. By accumulating and transferring successful strategies through a persistent Multimodal Experience Memory, MemJack maintains highly coherent extended multi-turn jailbreak attack interactions across different images, thereby improving the attack success rate (ASR) on new images. Extensive empirical evaluations across full, unmodified COCO val2017 images demonstrate that MemJack achieves a 71.48\% ASR against Qwen3-VL-Plus, scaling to 90\% under extended budgets. Furthermore, to catalyze future defensive alignment research, we will release \textbf{MemJack-Bench}, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 113,000 interactive multimodal jailbreak attack trajectories, establishing a vital foundation for developing inherently robust VLMs.

AI.tldr: MemJack是一个基于记忆增强的多智能体越狱攻击框架，利用视觉语义进行自动化越狱攻击，通过多智能体协作、视觉语义伪装和几何过滤绕过防御，在COCO数据集上对Qwen3-VL-Plus达到71.48%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型的快速发展，多模态攻击面大幅扩大且不受约束。现有的多模态越狱策略主要关注表面像素扰动和排版攻击，未能深入利用视觉数据的复杂语义结构，导致原始自然图像中的深层语义攻击面未被充分探索。
AI.method: MemJack采用记忆增强的多智能体框架：1）多智能体协作将视觉实体映射到恶意意图；2）通过多角度视觉语义伪装生成对抗性提示；3）使用迭代零空间投影几何过滤器绕过潜在空间拒绝；4）通过持久的多模态经验记忆积累和传递成功策略。
