AI.result: 在完整未修改的COCO val2017图像上，MemJack对Qwen3-VL-Plus实现了71.48%的攻击成功率，在扩展预算下可提升至90%。同时发布了包含超过113,000条交互式多模态越狱攻击轨迹的MemJack-Bench数据集。
AI.conclusion: MemJack揭示了视觉语言模型在深层语义层面的安全漏洞，提出的框架能够有效利用视觉语义进行越狱攻击。MemJack-Bench数据集为未来防御对齐研究提供了重要基础，有助于开发本质上更鲁棒的视觉语言模型。

title: Chain-of-Models Pre-Training: Rethinking Training Acceleration of Vision Foundation Models
comment: This work is accepted to CVPR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/deep-optimization/CoM-PT
summary: In this paper, we present Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT), a novel performance-lossless training acceleration method for vision foundation models (VFMs). This approach fundamentally differs from existing acceleration methods in its core motivation: rather than optimizing each model individually, CoM-PT is designed to accelerate the training pipeline at the model family level, scaling efficiently as the model family expands. Specifically, CoM-PT establishes a pre-training sequence for the model family, arranged in ascending order of model size, called model chain. In this chain, only the smallest model undergoes standard individual pre-training, while the other models are efficiently trained through sequential inverse knowledge transfer from their smaller predecessors by jointly reusing the knowledge in the parameter space and the feature space. As a result, CoM-PT enables all models to achieve performance that is mostly superior to standard individual training while significantly reducing training cost, and this is extensively validated across 45 datasets spanning zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks. Notably, its efficient scaling property yields a remarkable phenomenon: training more models even results in higher efficiency. For instance, when pre-training on CC3M: i) given ViT-L as the largest model, progressively prepending smaller models to the model chain reduces computational complexity by up to 72%; ii) within a fixed model size range, as the VFM family scales across 3, 4, and 7 models, the acceleration ratio of CoM-PT exhibits a striking leap: from 4.13X to 5.68X and 7.09X. Since CoM-PT is naturally agnostic to specific pre-training paradigms, we open-source the code to spur further extensions in more computationally intensive scenarios, such as large language model pre-training.

AI.tldr: CoM-PT是一种新颖的视觉基础模型训练加速方法，通过模型链预训练实现性能无损的加速，特别适合模型家族级别的训练加速。
AI.motivation: 现有加速方法主要针对单个模型优化，而CoM-PT旨在从模型家族层面加速训练流程，随着模型家族扩展而高效扩展。
AI.method: 建立按模型大小升序排列的模型链，仅最小模型进行标准预训练，其他模型通过从较小前驱模型的参数空间和特征空间进行顺序逆向知识转移来高效训练。
AI.result: 在45个数据集上验证，所有模型性能大多优于标准单独训练，同时显著降低训练成本。例如在CC3M上预训练ViT-L时，计算复杂度降低达72%；随着模型家族扩展到3、4、7个模型，加速比从4.13X跃升至5.68X和7.09X。
AI.conclusion: CoM-PT实现了性能无损的训练加速，具有高效扩展特性，且不依赖特定预训练范式，可扩展到计算密集型场景如大语言模型预训练。

title: KnowRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Minimal-Sufficient Knowledge Guidance
summary: RLVR improves reasoning in large language models, but its effectiveness is often limited by severe reward sparsity on hard problems. Recent hint-based RL methods mitigate sparsity by injecting partial solutions or abstract templates, yet they typically scale guidance by adding more tokens, which introduce redundancy, inconsistency, and extra training overhead. We propose \textbf{KnowRL} (Knowledge-Guided Reinforcement Learning), an RL training framework that treats hint design as a minimal-sufficient guidance problem. During RL training, KnowRL decomposes guidance into atomic knowledge points (KPs) and uses Constrained Subset Search (CSS) to construct compact, interaction-aware subsets for training. We further identify a pruning interaction paradox -- removing one KP may help while removing multiple such KPs can hurt -- and explicitly optimize for robust subset curation under this dependency structure. We train KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B from OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B. Across eight reasoning benchmarks at the 1.5B scale, KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B consistently outperforms strong RL and hinting baselines. Without KP hints at inference, KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B reaches 70.08 average accuracy, already surpassing Nemotron-1.5B by +9.63 points; with selected KPs, performance improves to 74.16, establishing a new state of the art at this scale. The model, curated training data, and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Hasuer/KnowRL.

AI.tldr: KnowRL提出了一种知识引导的强化学习框架，通过原子知识点的约束子集搜索来缓解奖励稀疏性问题，在1.5B规模模型上实现了推理性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的RL方法通过添加更多token来扩展指导，但这会引入冗余、不一致性和额外训练开销。需要一种最小充分指导的方法来解决奖励稀疏性问题。
AI.method: 将指导分解为原子知识点，使用约束子集搜索构建紧凑的交互感知子集进行训练，并针对依赖结构优化鲁棒子集选择。
AI.result: 在八个推理基准测试中，KnowRL-Nemotron-1.5B在1.5B规模上始终优于强RL和提示基线。无KP提示时达到70.08平均准确率，比原模型提升9.63点；有KP提示时达到74.16，创下该规模的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: KnowRL通过知识引导的强化学习有效解决了奖励稀疏性问题，在保持推理效率的同时显著提升了模型性能，为小规模模型的推理能力提升提供了有效方案。

title: Dual-Modality Anchor-Guided Filtering for Test-time Prompt Tuning
summary: Test-Time Prompt Tuning (TPT) adapts vision-language models using augmented views, but its effectiveness is hindered by the challenge of determining which views are beneficial. Standard entropy-based filtering relies on the internal confidence scores of the model, which are often miscalibrated under distribution shift, assigning high confidence to irrelevant crops or background regions while ignoring semantic content. To address this, we propose a dual-modality anchor-guided framework that grounds view selection in semantic evidence. We introduce a text anchor from attribute-rich descriptions, to provide fine-grained class semantics, and an adaptive image anchor that captures evolving test-time statistics. Using these anchors, we filter views based on alignment and confidence, ensuring that only informative views guide adaptation. Moreover, we treat the anchors as auxiliary predictive heads and combine their predictions with the original output in a confidence-weighted ensemble, yielding a stable supervision signal for prompt updates. Extensive experiments on 15 benchmark datasets demonstrate new state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the contribution of anchor-guided supervision as a foundation for robust prompt updates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种双模态锚点引导框架，通过文本锚点和自适应图像锚点来改进测试时提示调优的视图选择，解决了传统熵过滤方法在分布偏移下置信度校准不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: 测试时提示调优(TPT)通过增强视图来适应视觉语言模型，但其效果受到确定哪些视图有益的挑战的限制。标准的基于熵的过滤依赖于模型的内部置信度分数，这些分数在分布偏移下经常校准不准确，会将高置信度分配给不相关的裁剪或背景区域，而忽略语义内容。
AI.method: 提出双模态锚点引导框架，将视图选择基于语义证据。引入来自属性丰富描述的文本锚点，提供细粒度类别语义；以及自适应图像锚点，捕捉演化的测试时统计信息。使用这些锚点，基于对齐度和置信度过滤视图，确保只有信息丰富的视图指导适应。此外，将锚点视为辅助预测头，并将其预测与原始输出在置信度加权集成中结合，为提示更新产生稳定的监督信号。
AI.result: 在15个基准数据集上的广泛实验展示了新的最先进性能，突显了锚点引导监督作为稳健提示更新基础的重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双模态锚点引导框架通过语义证据基础改进了测试时提示调优的视图选择，解决了置信度校准问题，为视觉语言模型的稳健适应提供了有效方法。

title: Learning Chain Of Thoughts Prompts for Predicting Entities, Relations, and even Literals on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models perform well on link prediction but struggle with unseen entities, relations, and especially literals, limiting their use in dynamic, heterogeneous graphs. In contrast, pretrained large language models (LLMs) generalize effectively through prompting. We reformulate link prediction as a prompt learning problem and introduce RALP, which learns string-based chain-of-thought (CoT) prompts as scoring functions for triples. Using Bayesian Optimization through MIPRO algorithm, RALP identifies effective prompts from fewer than 30 training examples without gradient access. At inference, RALP predicts missing entities, relations or whole triples and assigns confidence scores based on the learned prompt. We evaluate on transductive, numerical, and OWL instance retrieval benchmarks. RALP improves state-of-the-art KGE models by over 5% MRR across datasets and enhances generalization via high-quality inferred triples. On OWL reasoning tasks with complex class expressions (e.g., $\exists hasChild.Female$, $\geq 5 \; hasChild.Female$), it achieves over 88% Jaccard similarity. These results highlight prompt-based LLM reasoning as a flexible alternative to embedding-based methods. We release our implementation, training, and evaluation pipeline as open source: https://github.com/dice-group/RALP .

AI.tldr: RALP将链接预测重新定义为提示学习问题，通过贝叶斯优化学习基于字符串的思维链提示作为三元组评分函数，在少量训练样本下显著提升知识图谱嵌入模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统知识图谱嵌入模型在链接预测上表现良好，但难以处理未见实体、关系和字面值，限制了在动态异构图谱中的应用。而预训练大语言模型通过提示能有效泛化。
AI.method: RALP将链接预测重新定义为提示学习问题，学习基于字符串的思维链提示作为三元组评分函数。使用MIPRO算法进行贝叶斯优化，仅需少于30个训练样本即可找到有效提示，无需梯度访问。
AI.result: 在转导、数值和OWL实例检索基准测试中，RALP将最先进的知识图谱嵌入模型的MRR提升了超过5%。在涉及复杂类表达式的OWL推理任务中，实现了超过88%的Jaccard相似度。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的LLM推理是嵌入方法的灵活替代方案，RALP通过高质量推断的三元组增强了泛化能力，为动态异构知识图谱处理提供了新思路。

title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference
comment: 10 pages in main text + 6 pages of references + 36 pages of appendices, 12 figures in main text + 37 figures in appendices, 2 tables in main text + 3 table in appendices, 13 prompts in appendices
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between computational efficiency (e.g., number of parameters) and output quality, especially when deployed on computationally limited devices such as phones or laptops. One way to address this challenge is by following the example of humans and have models ask for help when they believe they are incapable of solving a problem on their own; we can overcome this trade-off by allowing smaller models to respond to queries when they believe they can provide good responses, and deferring to larger models when they do not believe they can. To this end, in this paper, we investigate the viability of Predict-Answer/Act (PA) and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA) paradigms where models predict -- prior to responding -- how an LLM judge would score their output. We evaluate three approaches: zero-shot prediction, prediction using an in-context report card, and supervised fine-tuning. Our results show that larger models (particularly reasoning models) perform well when predicting generic LLM judges zero-shot, while smaller models can reliably predict such judges well after being fine-tuned or provided with an in-context report card. Altogether, both approaches can substantially improve the prediction accuracy of smaller models, with report cards and fine-tuning achieving mean improvements of up to 55% and 52% across datasets, respectively. These findings suggest that models can learn to predict their own performance limitations, paving the way for more efficient and self-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 小型语言模型可以通过预测自身输出质量来决定何时向大型模型求助，从而在计算效率和输出质量之间取得平衡
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型面临计算效率与输出质量之间的权衡，特别是在计算资源有限的设备上。受人类在遇到困难时寻求帮助的启发，研究者希望让小型模型能够预测自身能力限制，在无法提供高质量回答时向大型模型求助。
AI.method: 研究采用Predict-Answer/Act (PA)和Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA)范式，让模型在回答前预测LLM评审对其输出的评分。评估了三种方法：零样本预测、使用上下文报告卡的预测和监督微调。
AI.result: 大型模型（特别是推理模型）在零样本预测通用LLM评审评分方面表现良好，而小型模型经过微调或提供上下文报告卡后也能可靠预测。报告卡和微调方法分别实现了平均55%和52%的预测准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 模型可以学习预测自身的性能限制，这为开发更高效、更自知的AI系统铺平了道路，使小型模型能够智能地决定何时需要大型模型的帮助。

title: Broadening the Applicability of Conditional Syntax Splitting for Reasoning from Conditional Belief Bases
summary: In nonmonotonic reasoning from conditional belief bases, an inference operator satisfying syntax splitting postulates allows for taking only the relevant parts of a belief base into account, provided that the belief base splits into subbases based on disjoint signatures. Because such disjointness is rare in practice, safe conditional syntax splitting has been proposed as a generalization of syntax splitting, allowing the conditionals in the subbases to share some atoms. Recently this overlap of conditionals has been shown to be limited to trivial, self-fulfilling conditionals. In this article, we propose a generalization of safe conditional syntax splittings that broadens the applicability of splitting postulates. In contrast to safe conditional syntax splitting, our generalized notion supports syntax splittings of a belief base Δ where the subbases of Δ may share atoms and nontrivial conditionals. We illustrate how this new notion overcomes limitations of previous splitting concepts, and we identify genuine splittings, separating them from simple splittings that do not provide benefits for inductive inference from Δ. We introduce adjusted inference postulates based on our generalization of conditional syntax splitting, and we evaluate several popular inductive inference operators with respect to these postulates. Furthermore, we show that, while every inductive inference operator satisfying generalized conditional syntax splitting also satisfies conditional syntax splitting, the reverse does not hold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义的条件语法分割概念，克服了先前分割概念的限制，允许子基共享原子和非平凡条件句，从而扩展了分割公理的适用性。
AI.motivation: 在非单调推理中，传统的语法分割要求子基具有不相交的签名，这在实践中很少见。虽然安全条件语法分割允许共享原子，但仅限于平凡的自满足条件句。因此需要一种更通用的分割概念来克服这些限制。
AI.method: 提出了广义条件语法分割的概念，允许子基共享原子和非平凡条件句。区分了真正的分割和简单的分割，并基于此提出了调整后的推理公理。评估了多个流行的归纳推理算子对这些公理的满足情况。
AI.result: 广义条件语法分割扩展了分割公理的适用性，能够处理更广泛的信念基分割情况。证明了满足广义条件语法分割的推理算子也满足条件语法分割，但反之不成立。
AI.conclusion: 广义条件语法分割为信念基推理提供了更灵活和实用的分割框架，克服了先前分割概念的局限性，为实际应用中的非单调推理提供了更好的支持。

title: A Hybrid Architecture for Benign-Malignant Classification of Mammography ROIs
summary: Accurate characterization of suspicious breast lesions in mammography is important for early diagnosis and treatment planning. While Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are effective at extracting local visual patterns, they are less suited to modeling long-range dependencies. Vision Transformers (ViTs) address this limitation through self-attention, but their quadratic computational cost can be prohibitive. This paper presents a hybrid architecture that combines EfficientNetV2-M for local feature extraction with Vision Mamba, a State Space Model (SSM), for efficient global context modeling. The proposed model performs binary classification of abnormality-centered mammography regions of interest (ROIs) from the CBIS-DDSM dataset into benign and malignant classes. By combining a strong CNN backbone with a linear-complexity sequence model, the approach achieves strong lesion-level classification performance in an ROI-based setting.

AI.tldr: 提出结合EfficientNetV2-M和Vision Mamba的混合架构，用于乳腺X光片中可疑病变的良恶性分类，在CBIS-DDSM数据集上实现高效全局上下文建模。
AI.motivation: 乳腺X光片中可疑病变的准确表征对早期诊断和治疗规划至关重要。CNN擅长提取局部视觉模式但不擅长建模长距离依赖，而ViT虽能解决此问题但计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出混合架构：使用EfficientNetV2-M进行局部特征提取，结合Vision Mamba（状态空间模型）进行高效的全局上下文建模，对CBIS-DDSM数据集中的异常中心ROI进行良恶性二分类。
AI.result: 通过结合强大的CNN骨干网络和线性复杂度序列模型，在基于ROI的设置中实现了强大的病变级别分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 该混合架构有效解决了CNN在长距离依赖建模上的局限性，同时避免了ViT的二次计算成本，为乳腺病变分类提供了高效解决方案。

title: Token-Level Policy Optimization: Linking Group-Level Rewards to Token-Level Aggregation via Sequence-Level Likelihood
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), particularly in their mathemat ical reasoning performance. However, GRPO and related entropy regularization methods still struggle with token-level sparse-rewards, which is an inherent chal lenge in chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. These approaches often rely on undifferen tiated token-level entropy regularization, which easily leads to entropy collapse or model degradation under sparse token rewards. In this work, we propose TEPO, a novel token-level framework that (1) leverages sequence-level likelihood to link group-level rewards with individual tokens via token-level aggregation, and (2) introduces a token-level KL-Divergence mask constraint that targets tokens with positive advantages and decreasing entropy to mitigate abrupt policy updates. Experiments demonstrate that TEPO not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks but also markedly enhances training stability, reducing convergence time by 50% compared with GRPO/DAPO.

AI.tldr: TEPO是一种新的token级强化学习框架，解决了GRPO等熵正则化方法在处理稀疏奖励时的局限性，通过序列级似然和token级KL散度掩码约束，显著提升了数学推理性能和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: GRPO和相关熵正则化方法在处理链式思维推理中的token级稀疏奖励时存在困难，容易导致熵崩溃或模型退化，需要更有效的token级优化方法。
AI.method: 提出TEPO框架：1) 利用序列级似然通过token级聚合将组级奖励与单个token关联；2) 引入token级KL散度掩码约束，针对具有正优势且熵减少的token，以缓解策略更新突变。
AI.result: TEPO在数学推理基准测试中达到最先进性能，显著提升训练稳定性，与GRPO/DAPO相比收敛时间减少50%。
AI.conclusion: TEPO通过创新的token级优化框架有效解决了稀疏奖励环境下的训练挑战，为大语言模型的推理能力提升提供了更稳定高效的强化学习方法。

title: Human-Centric Topic Modeling with Goal-Prompted Contrastive Learning and Optimal Transport
summary: Existing topic modeling methods, from LDA to recent neural and LLM-based approaches, which focus mainly on statistical coherence, often produce redundant or off-target topics that miss the user's underlying intent. We introduce Human-centric Topic Modeling, \emph{Human-TM}), a novel task formulation that integrates a human-provided goal directly into the topic modeling process to produce interpretable, diverse and goal-oriented topics. To tackle this challenge, we propose the \textbf{G}oal-prompted \textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{T}opic \textbf{M}odel with \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport (GCTM-OT), which first uses LLM-based prompting to extract goal candidates from documents, then incorporates these into semantic-aware contrastive learning via optimal transport for topic discovery. Experimental results on three public subreddit datasets show that GCTM-OT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in topic coherence and diversity while significantly improving alignment with human-provided goals, paving the way for more human-centric topic discovery systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Human-TM，一种以人为中心的主题建模方法，通过整合用户提供的目标来生成可解释、多样且目标导向的主题，解决了传统方法主题冗余或偏离用户意图的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主题建模方法（从LDA到最近的神经和LLM方法）主要关注统计一致性，往往产生冗余或偏离目标的主题，无法捕捉用户的潜在意图。需要一种能够直接整合人类目标来生成更相关主题的方法。
AI.method: 提出GCTM-OT方法：1）使用LLM提示从文档中提取目标候选；2）通过最优传输将这些目标整合到语义感知的对比学习中，进行主题发现。
AI.result: 在三个公共subreddit数据集上的实验表明，GCTM-OT在主题一致性和多样性方面优于最先进的基线方法，同时显著提高了与人类提供目标的匹配度。
AI.conclusion: GCTM-OT为更以人为中心的主题发现系统铺平了道路，通过整合人类目标来生成更相关、可解释和多样化的主题。

title: IAD-Unify: A Region-Grounded Unified Model for Industrial Anomaly Segmentation, Understanding, and Generation
summary: Real-world industrial inspection requires not only localizing defects, but also explaining them in natural language and generating controlled defect edits. However, existing approaches fail to jointly support all three capabilities within a unified framework and evaluation protocol. We propose IAD-Unify, a dual-encoder unified framework in which a frozen DINOv2-based region expert supplies precise anomaly evidence to a shared Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone via lightweight token injection, jointly enabling anomaly segmentation, region-grounded understanding, and mask-guided generation. To enable unified evaluation, we further construct Anomaly-56K, a comprehensive unified multi-task IAD evaluation platform, spanning 59,916 images across 24 categories and 104 defect variants. Controlled ablations yield four findings: (i) region grounding is the decisive mechanism for understanding, removing it degrades location accuracy by >76 pp; (ii) predicted-region performance closely matches oracle, confirming deployment viability; (iii) region-grounded generation achieves the best full-image fidelity and masked-region perceptual quality; and (iv) pre-initialized joint training improves understanding at negligible generation cost (-0.16 dB). IAD-Unify further achieves strong performance on the MMAD benchmark, including categories unseen during training, demonstrating robust cross-category generalization.

AI.tldr: IAD-Unify是一个统一框架，通过冻结的DINOv2区域专家向视觉语言骨干注入轻量级token，实现异常分割、区域基础理解和掩码引导生成三项功能，并在Anomaly-56K平台上进行统一评估。
AI.motivation: 现实工业检测需要同时定位缺陷、用自然语言解释缺陷并进行可控缺陷编辑，但现有方法无法在一个统一框架中同时支持这三项能力。
AI.method: 提出IAD-Unify双编码器统一框架：冻结的DINOv2区域专家提供精确异常证据，通过轻量级token注入到共享的Qwen3.5-4B视觉语言骨干中，联合实现异常分割、区域基础理解和掩码引导生成。
AI.result: 在Anomaly-56K平台（59,916张图像，24个类别，104种缺陷变体）上评估，发现：1）区域基础是理解的决定性机制；2）预测区域性能接近oracle；3）区域基础生成获得最佳全图像保真度和掩码区域感知质量；4）预初始化联合训练以可忽略的生成成本提升理解。在MMAD基准测试中表现强劲，包括未见类别。
AI.conclusion: IAD-Unify首次在一个统一框架中实现了异常分割、理解和生成三项能力，通过区域基础机制实现了强大的跨类别泛化能力，为工业异常检测提供了全面的解决方案。

title: Universal NER v2: Towards a Massively Multilingual Named Entity Recognition Benchmark
summary: While multilingual language models promise to bring the benefits of LLMs to speakers of many languages, gold-standard evaluation benchmarks in most languages to interrogate these assumptions remain scarce. The Universal NER project, now entering its fourth year, is dedicated to building gold-standard multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark datasets. Inspired by existing massively multilingual efforts for other core NLP tasks (e.g., Universal Dependencies), the project uses a general tagset and thorough annotation guidelines to collect standardized, cross-lingual annotations of named entity spans. The first installment (UNER v1) was released in 2024, and the project has continued and expanded since then, with various organizers, annotators, and collaborators in an active community.

AI.tldr: Universal NER项目旨在为多语言命名实体识别构建黄金标准基准数据集，解决当前大多数语言缺乏高质量评估基准的问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然多语言语言模型承诺为多种语言的使用者带来LLM的好处，但大多数语言中用于验证这些假设的黄金标准评估基准仍然稀缺。需要为命名实体识别任务建立标准化的多语言评估资源。
AI.method: 项目采用通用标签集和详细的标注指南，收集标准化的跨语言命名实体标注。受其他核心NLP任务的大规模多语言努力（如Universal Dependencies）启发，通过活跃社区中的组织者、标注者和合作者进行持续扩展。
AI.result: 第一版UNER v1于2024年发布，项目已进入第四年并持续扩展，建立了活跃的社区参与机制。
AI.conclusion: Universal NER项目致力于构建标准化的多语言NER基准数据集，为多语言语言模型的评估提供重要资源，促进跨语言NLP研究的发展。

title: Safe reinforcement learning with online filtering for fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in production
comment: This is the accepted manuscript of an article accepted for publication in \textit{Journal of Manufacturing Systems (Elsevier)
summary: Human-robot collaborative manufacturing, a core aspect of Industry 5.0, emphasizes ergonomics to enhance worker well-being. This paper addresses the dynamic human-robot task planning and allocation (HRTPA) problem, which involves determining when to perform tasks and who should execute them to maximize efficiency while ensuring workers' physical fatigue remains within safe limits. The inclusion of fatigue constraints, combined with production dynamics, significantly increases the complexity of the HRTPA problem. Traditional fatigue-recovery models in HRTPA often rely on static, predefined hyperparameters. However, in practice, human fatigue sensitivity varies daily due to factors such as changed work conditions and insufficient sleep. To better capture this uncertainty, we treat fatigue-related parameters as inaccurate and estimate them online based on observed fatigue progression during production. To address these challenges, we propose PF-CD3Q, a safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) approach that integrates the particle filter with constrained dueling double deep Q-learning for real-time fatigue-predictive HRTPA. Specifically, we first develop PF-based estimators to track human fatigue and update fatigue model parameters in real-time. These estimators are then integrated into CD3Q by making task-level fatigue predictions during decision-making and excluding tasks that exceed fatigue limits, thereby constraining the action space and formulating the problem as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP).

AI.tldr: 提出PF-CD3Q安全强化学习方法，结合粒子滤波与约束双深度Q学习，解决工业5.0中人机协作制造中的动态任务规划与分配问题，实时跟踪工人疲劳并确保安全限制
AI.motivation: 工业5.0中人机协作制造强调工效学以提升工人福祉。传统疲劳恢复模型依赖静态超参数，但实际中人类疲劳敏感性因工作条件变化、睡眠不足等因素而每日变化，需要在线估计疲劳参数以更好地处理不确定性
AI.method: 提出PF-CD3Q安全强化学习方法：1) 开发基于粒子滤波的估计器实时跟踪人类疲劳并更新疲劳模型参数；2) 将估计器集成到约束双深度Q学习中，在决策时进行任务级疲劳预测，排除超出疲劳限制的任务，将问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程
AI.result: 该方法能够实时跟踪人类疲劳状态并更新模型参数，通过约束动作空间确保工人疲劳保持在安全限制内，解决了动态人机任务规划与分配问题中的疲劳约束复杂性
AI.conclusion: PF-CD3Q方法能够有效处理人机协作制造中的动态任务规划与分配问题，通过在线估计疲劳参数和约束强化学习，在保证生产效率的同时确保工人疲劳在安全范围内，为工业5.0的工效学要求提供了解决方案

title: DiffusionPrint: Learning Generative Fingerprints for Diffusion-Based Inpainting Localization
summary: Modern diffusion-based inpainting models pose significant challenges for image forgery localization (IFL), as their full regeneration pipelines reconstruct the entire image via a latent decoder, disrupting the camera-level noise patterns that existing forensic methods rely on. We propose DiffusionPrint, a patch-level contrastive learning framework that learns a forensic signal robust to the spectral distortions introduced by latent decoding. It exploits the fact that inpainted regions generated by the same model share a consistent generative fingerprint, using this as a self-supervisory signal. DiffusionPrint trains a convolutional backbone via a MoCo-style objective with cross-category hard negative mining and a generator-aware classification head, producing a forensic feature map that serves as a highly discriminative secondary modality in fusion-based IFL frameworks. Integrated into TruFor, MMFusion, and a lightweight fusion baseline, DiffusionPrint consistently improves localization across multiple generative models, with gains of up to +28% on mask types unseen during fine-tuning and confirmed generalization to unseen generative architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/mever-team/diffusionprint

AI.tldr: DiffusionPrint是一个用于检测扩散模型图像修复伪造的补丁级对比学习框架，通过学习对潜在解码器引入的光谱失真具有鲁棒性的法医信号，显著提升图像伪造定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现代基于扩散的图像修复模型对图像伪造定位提出了重大挑战，因为它们的完整再生流程通过潜在解码器重建整个图像，破坏了现有法医方法依赖的相机级噪声模式。
AI.method: 提出DiffusionPrint框架，采用补丁级对比学习方法，利用同一模型生成的修复区域共享一致的生成指纹这一事实作为自监督信号。使用MoCo风格的目标函数，结合跨类别难负样本挖掘和生成器感知分类头，训练卷积骨干网络生成法医特征图。
AI.result: 将DiffusionPrint集成到TruFor、MMFusion和轻量级融合基线中，在多个生成模型上持续改善定位性能，在微调期间未见过的掩码类型上提升高达+28%，并确认了对未见生成架构的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DiffusionPrint通过学习对潜在解码器引入的光谱失真具有鲁棒性的生成指纹，为融合式图像伪造定位框架提供了高度可区分的辅助模态，显著提升了扩散模型修复伪造的检测能力。

title: Generating Effective CoT Traces for Mitigating Causal Hallucination
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) excel in complex reasoning tasks, they suffer from severe causal hallucination in event causality identification (ECI), particularly in smaller models ($\leq$1.5B parameters). A promising approach to address this issue is to fine-tune them with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. However, there is currently a lack of CoT trace dataset available for ECI. In this paper, we first investigate the essential criteria that effective CoT traces should possess to mitigate causal hallucination in smaller models. We then design a pipeline to generate CoT traces that meet these criteria. Moreover, since there is currently no metric for quantifying causal hallucination, we also introduce a new metric, the Causal Hallucination Rate (CHR), to quantify causal hallucination, guide the formulation of effective CoT trace criteria, and validate the effectiveness of our pipeline. Our experiments show that fine-tuning with the CoT traces generated by our pipeline not only substantially reduces causal hallucination in smaller LLMs but also improves mean accuracy. Moreover, the fine-tuned models exhibit strong cross-dataset and cross-difficulty generalization, as well as robustness under misleading intervention prompts.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对小规模语言模型在事件因果关系识别中的因果幻觉问题，通过生成符合特定标准的思维链轨迹数据集进行微调，显著减少了因果幻觉并提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但在事件因果关系识别（ECI）中存在严重的因果幻觉问题，特别是在参数规模≤1.5B的小模型中。目前缺乏专门用于ECI的思维链轨迹数据集来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 首先研究有效思维链轨迹应具备的标准以减轻小模型的因果幻觉，然后设计满足这些标准的思维链轨迹生成流程。同时引入新的量化指标——因果幻觉率（CHR）来指导标准制定并验证流程有效性。
AI.result: 使用该流程生成的思维链轨迹进行微调，不仅显著减少了小规模LLM的因果幻觉，还提高了平均准确率。微调后的模型表现出强大的跨数据集、跨难度泛化能力，以及对误导性干预提示的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的思维链轨迹生成流程对小规模语言模型进行微调，可以有效解决事件因果关系识别中的因果幻觉问题，并提升模型在多种场景下的性能表现。

title: Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator for Efficient Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to synthesize high-resolution multispectral (HR-MS) images by fusing the spatial textures of panchromatic (PAN) images with the spectral information of low-resolution multispectral (LR-MS) images. While recent deep learning paradigms, especially diffusion-based operators, have pushed the performance boundaries, they often encounter spectral-spatial blurring and prohibitive computational costs due to their stochastic nature and iterative sampling. In this paper, we propose the Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator (EDNO), a physics-inspired framework that redefines pansharpening as a continuous functional mapping in the frequency domain. Departing from conventional Cartesian feature processing, our EDNO leverages Euler's formula to transform features into a polar coordinate system, enabling a novel explicit-implicit interaction mechanism. Specifically, we develop the Euler Feature Interaction Layer (EFIL), which decouples the fusion task into two specialized modules: 1) Explicit Feature Interaction Module, utilizing a linear weighting scheme to simulate phase rotation for adaptive geometric alignment; and 2) Implicit Feature Interaction Module, employing a feed-forward network to model spectral distributions for superior color consistency. By operating in the frequency domain, EDNO inherently captures global receptive fields while maintaining discretization-invariance. Experimental results on the three datasets demonstrate that EDNO offers a superior efficiency-performance balance compared to heavyweight architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出EDNO框架，将全色锐化重新定义为频域中的连续函数映射，利用欧拉公式将特征转换到极坐标系，通过显式-隐式交互机制实现高效的全色锐化。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法（特别是基于扩散的方法）在全色锐化中存在光谱-空间模糊问题，且计算成本高昂，主要由于其随机性和迭代采样特性。需要一种更高效且能保持光谱一致性的方法。
AI.method: 提出欧拉启发的解耦神经算子（EDNO），在频域中处理全色锐化问题。使用欧拉公式将特征转换到极坐标系，开发欧拉特征交互层（EFIL），包含两个模块：1）显式特征交互模块，使用线性加权方案模拟相位旋转进行几何对齐；2）隐式特征交互模块，使用前馈网络建模光谱分布以保持颜色一致性。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验结果表明，EDNO相比重型架构提供了更优的效率-性能平衡，能够有效解决光谱-空间模糊问题，同时保持较低的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: EDNO通过频域处理和欧拉公式转换，实现了高效的全色锐化，解决了传统方法中的光谱-空间模糊和高计算成本问题，为全色锐化任务提供了新的物理启发式框架。

title: NaviRAG: Towards Active Knowledge Navigation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on a flat retrieval paradigm that maps queries directly to static, isolated text segments. This approach struggles with more complex tasks that require the conditional retrieval and dynamic synthesis of information across different levels of granularity (e.g., from broad concepts to specific evidence). To bridge this gap, we introduce NaviRAG, a novel framework that shifts from passive segment retrieval to active knowledge navigation. NaviRAG first structures the knowledge documents into a hierarchical form, preserving semantic relationships from coarse-grained topics to fine-grained details. Leveraging this reorganized knowledge records, a large language model (LLM) agent actively navigates the records, iteratively identifying information gaps and retrieving relevant content from the most appropriate granularity level. Extensive experiments on long-document QA benchmarks show that NaviRAG consistently improves both retrieval recall and end-to-end answer performance over conventional RAG baselines. Ablation studies confirm performance gains stem from our method's capacity for multi-granular evidence localization and dynamic retrieval planning. We further discuss efficiency, applicable scenario, and future directions of our method, hoping to make RAG systems more intelligent and autonomous.

AI.tldr: NaviRAG是一个新型检索增强生成框架，通过将知识文档组织成层次结构，使LLM代理能够主动导航知识库，根据信息需求动态选择不同粒度的内容，从而提升复杂任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG采用扁平检索范式，直接将查询映射到静态、孤立的文本片段，难以处理需要跨不同粒度级别（如从广泛概念到具体证据）进行条件检索和动态信息合成的复杂任务。
AI.method: 首先将知识文档结构化为层次形式，保留从粗粒度主题到细粒度细节的语义关系。然后利用LLM代理主动导航知识记录，迭代识别信息缺口并从最合适的粒度级别检索相关内容。
AI.result: 在长文档QA基准测试中，NaviRAG相比传统RAG基线在检索召回率和端到端答案性能方面均取得一致提升。消融研究证实性能提升源于该方法的多粒度证据定位和动态检索规划能力。
AI.conclusion: NaviRAG通过从被动片段检索转向主动知识导航，使RAG系统更加智能和自主。论文还讨论了方法的效率、适用场景和未来发展方向。

title: MISID: A Multimodal Multi-turn Dataset for Complex Intent Recognition in Strategic Deception Games
summary: Understanding human intent in complex multi-turn interactions remains a fundamental challenge in human-computer interaction and behavioral analysis. While existing intent recognition datasets focus mainly on single utterances or simple dialogues, real-world scenarios often involve sophisticated strategic interactions where participants must maintain complex deceptive narratives over extended periods. To address this gap, we introduce MISID, a comprehensive multimodal, multi-turn, and multi-participant benchmark for intent recognition. Sourced from high-stakes social strategy games, MISID features a fine-grained, two-tier multi-dimensional annotation scheme tailored for long-context discourse analysis and evidence-based causal tracking. Our systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on MISID reveals critical deficiencies in complex scenarios, including text-prior visual hallucination, impaired cross-modal synergy, and limited capacity in chaining causal cues. Consequently, we propose FRACTAM as a baseline framework. Using a ``Decouple-Anchor-Reason'' paradigm, FRACTAM reduces text bias by extracting pure unimodal factual representations, employs two-stage retrieval for long-range factual anchoring, and constructs explicit cross-modal evidence chains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRACTAM enhances mainstream models' performance in complex strategic tasks, improving hidden intent detection and inference while maintaining robust perceptual accuracy. Our dataset is available at https://naislab.cn/datasets/MISID.

AI.tldr: MISID是一个用于意图识别的多模态、多轮、多参与者基准数据集，基于高风险社交策略游戏构建，包含精细的两层多维标注方案。研究揭示了当前MLLMs在复杂场景中的缺陷，并提出了FRACTAM基准框架来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有意图识别数据集主要关注单轮话语或简单对话，而现实场景往往涉及复杂的策略性交互，参与者需要在长时间内维持复杂的欺骗性叙述。需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 引入MISID数据集，基于高风险社交策略游戏，包含多模态、多轮、多参与者交互，采用精细的两层多维标注方案；2) 系统评估现有MLLMs在MISID上的表现；3) 提出FRACTAM基准框架，采用"解耦-锚定-推理"范式，包括提取纯单模态事实表示、两阶段检索进行长距离事实锚定、构建显式跨模态证据链。
AI.result: 对现有MLLMs的系统评估揭示了在复杂场景中的关键缺陷：文本优先的视觉幻觉、受损的跨模态协同、有限的因果线索链能力。FRACTAM框架显著提升了主流模型在复杂策略任务中的性能，改善了隐藏意图检测和推理能力，同时保持了稳健的感知准确性。
AI.conclusion: MISID数据集填补了复杂多轮交互意图识别研究的空白，揭示了当前MLLMs在复杂策略场景中的局限性。提出的FRACTAM框架通过减少文本偏见、增强事实锚定和构建证据链，为复杂意图识别任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: T2I-BiasBench: A Multi-Metric Framework for Auditing Demographic and Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Models
summary:
Text-to-image (T2I) generative models achieve impressive visual fidelity but inherit and amplify demographic imbalances and cultural biases embedded in training data. We introduce T2I-BiasBench, a unified evaluation framework of thirteen complementary metrics that jointly captures demographic bias, element omission, and cultural collapse in diffusion models - the first framework to address all three dimensions simultaneously.
  We evaluate three open-source models - Stable Diffusion v1.5, BK-SDM Base, and Koala Lightning - against Gemini 2.5 Flash (RLHF-aligned) as a reference baseline. The benchmark comprises 1,574 generated images across five structured prompt categories. T2I-BiasBench integrates six established metrics with seven additional measures: four newly proposed (Composite Bias Score, Grounded Missing Rate, Implicit Element Missing Rate, Cultural Accuracy Ratio) and three adapted (Hallucination Score, Vendi Score, CLIP Proxy Score).
  Three key findings emerge: (1) Stable Diffusion v1.5 and BK-SDM exhibit bias amplification (>1.0) in beauty-related prompts; (2) contextual constraints such as surgical PPE substantially attenuate professional-role gender bias (Doctor CBS = 0.06 for SD v1.5); and (3) all models, including RLHF-aligned Gemini, collapse to a narrow set of cultural representations (CAS: 0.54-1.00), confirming that alignment techniques do not resolve cultural coverage gaps.
  T2I-BiasBench is publicly released to support standardized, fine-grained bias evaluation of generative models. The project page is available at: https://gyanendrachaubey.github.io/T2I-BiasBench/

AI.tldr: T2I-BiasBench是一个统一的评估框架，包含13个互补指标，用于全面评估文本到图像生成模型在人口统计偏见、元素遗漏和文化崩溃三个维度的表现。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成模型虽然视觉保真度高，但会继承并放大训练数据中的人口统计不平衡和文化偏见。现有评估方法未能同时解决人口统计偏见、元素遗漏和文化崩溃这三个关键维度。
AI.method: 提出T2I-BiasBench评估框架，包含13个指标（6个现有指标+7个新增/调整指标），评估了三个开源模型（Stable Diffusion v1.5、BK-SDM Base、Koala Lightning）和Gemini 2.5 Flash作为参考基线，使用1,574张生成图像和五个结构化提示类别。
AI.result: 1) Stable Diffusion v1.5和BK-SDM在美相关提示中表现出偏见放大（>1.0）；2) 上下文约束（如手术PPE）显著减弱职业角色性别偏见；3) 所有模型（包括RLHF对齐的Gemini）都崩溃到狭窄的文化表征集合，表明对齐技术未能解决文化覆盖差距。
AI.conclusion: T2I-BiasBench为生成模型提供了标准化、细粒度的偏见评估框架，公开发布以支持社区研究。研究发现对齐技术未能解决文化覆盖问题，需要更全面的偏见缓解方法。

title: Teaching LLMs Human-Like Editing of Inappropriate Argumentation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Editing human-written text has become a standard use case of large language models (LLMs), for example, to make one's arguments more appropriate for a discussion. Comparing human to LLM-generated edits, however, we observe a mismatch in editing strategies: While LLMs often perform multiple scattered edits and tend to change meaning notably, humans rather encapsulate dependent changes in self-contained, meaning-preserving edits. In this paper, we present a reinforcement learning approach that teaches LLMs human-like editing to improve the appropriateness of arguments. Our approach produces self-contained sentence-level edit suggestions that can be accepted or rejected independently. We train the approach using group relative policy optimization with a multi-component reward function that jointly optimizes edit-level semantic similarity, fluency, and pattern conformity as well as argument-level appropriateness. In automatic and human evaluation, it outperforms competitive baselines and the state of the art in human-like editing, with multi-round editing achieving appropriateness close to full rewriting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种强化学习方法，教导大语言模型进行类似人类的编辑，通过自包含的句子级编辑建议来改进论证的适当性。
AI.motivation: 研究发现人类与大语言模型在编辑策略上存在不匹配：LLMs通常进行多个分散的编辑并显著改变原意，而人类更倾向于将相关更改封装在自包含、保持原意的编辑中。这种差异影响了编辑质量。
AI.method: 采用强化学习方法，使用群体相对策略优化和多组件奖励函数，联合优化编辑级语义相似度、流畅度、模式一致性以及论证级适当性，生成自包含的句子级编辑建议。
AI.result: 在自动和人工评估中，该方法优于竞争基线和现有技术水平，在多轮编辑中实现的适当性接近完全重写的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功教导LLMs进行类似人类的编辑，通过自包含的句子级编辑建议提高论证适当性，在多轮编辑中达到接近完全重写的质量。

title: Transferable Expertise for Autonomous Agents via Real-World Case-Based Learning
summary: LLM-based autonomous agents perform well on general reasoning tasks but still struggle to reliably use task structure, key constraints, and prior experience in complex real-world settings. We propose a case-based learning framework that converts experience from past tasks into reusable knowledge assets, allowing agents to transfer prior case experience to new tasks and perform more structured analysis. Unlike methods based mainly on pretrained knowledge or static prompts, our framework emphasizes extracting and reusing task-relevant knowledge, analytical prompts, and operational skills from real cases. We evaluate the method on a unified benchmark of six complex task categories and compare it with Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Checklist Prompt, and Rule Memory baselines. Results show that our method achieves consistently strong performance across all tasks and matches or outperforms the best baseline in every case, with especially clear gains on more complex tasks. Further analysis shows that the advantage of case-based learning increases with task complexity, and that practical knowledge acquired by one agent can be reused by others. These findings suggest that case-based learning offers a promising path for building professional agents for real-world work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于案例的学习框架，将过往任务经验转化为可重用知识资产，使LLM智能体能在复杂任务中更好地利用任务结构、关键约束和先验经验。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的自主智能体在一般推理任务上表现良好，但在复杂现实场景中难以可靠地利用任务结构、关键约束和先验经验。需要一种方法让智能体能够从过往经验中学习并应用到新任务中。
AI.method: 提出基于案例的学习框架，将过往任务经验转化为可重用的知识资产，包括任务相关知识、分析提示和操作技能。该方法强调从真实案例中提取和重用知识，而不是主要依赖预训练知识或静态提示。
AI.result: 在六个复杂任务类别的统一基准测试中，该方法在所有任务上都表现出一致的强大性能，在每种情况下都匹配或优于最佳基线方法（零样本、少样本、检查表提示和规则记忆）。在更复杂的任务上优势尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于案例的学习为构建面向现实工作的专业智能体提供了有前景的路径。该方法优势随任务复杂性增加而增强，且一个智能体获得的实用知识可被其他智能体重用。

title: SEATrack: Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive Multimodal Tracker
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) in multimodal tracking reveals a concerning trend where recent performance gains are often achieved at the cost of inflated parameter budgets, which fundamentally erodes PEFT's efficiency promise. In this work, we introduce SEATrack, a Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive two-stream multimodal tracker that tackles this performance-efficiency dilemma from two complementary perspectives. We first prioritize cross-modal alignment of matching responses, an underexplored yet pivotal factor that we argue is essential for breaking the trade-off. Specifically, we observe that modality-specific biases in existing two-stream methods generate conflicting matching attention maps, thereby hindering effective joint representation learning. To mitigate this, we propose AMG-LoRA, which seamlessly integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for domain adaptation with Adaptive Mutual Guidance (AMG) to dynamically refine and align attention maps across modalities. We then depart from conventional local fusion approaches by introducing a Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HMoE) that enables efficient global relation modeling, effectively balancing expressiveness and computational efficiency in cross-modal fusion. Equipped with these innovations, SEATrack advances notable progress over state-of-the-art methods in balancing performance with efficiency across RGB-T, RGB-D, and RGB-E tracking tasks. \href{https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/SEATrack}{\textcolor{cyan}{Code is available}}.

AI.tldr: SEATrack是一个简单、高效、自适应的双流多模态跟踪器，通过跨模态对齐匹配响应和分层专家混合机制，在保持参数效率的同时提升多模态跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态跟踪中的参数高效微调存在一个矛盾趋势：性能提升往往以参数预算膨胀为代价，这侵蚀了PEFT的效率承诺。现有双流方法存在模态特定偏差，导致冲突的匹配注意力图，阻碍有效的联合表示学习。
AI.method: 提出SEATrack双流多模态跟踪器：1) AMG-LoRA：集成低秩自适应进行域适应，结合自适应互引导动态细化和对齐跨模态注意力图；2) 分层专家混合：替代传统局部融合方法，实现高效的全局关系建模，平衡表达能力和计算效率。
AI.result: SEATrack在RGB-T、RGB-D和RGB-E跟踪任务中，在平衡性能与效率方面相比最先进方法取得了显著进展。
AI.conclusion: 通过关注跨模态对齐匹配响应和引入全局关系建模机制，SEATrack有效解决了多模态跟踪中的性能-效率困境，为参数高效微调提供了新思路。

title: EvoSpark: Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies for Unified Long-Horizon Narrative Evolution
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026
summary: Realizing endogenous narrative evolution in LLM-based multi-agent systems is hindered by the inherent stochasticity of generative emergence. In particular, long-horizon simulations suffer from social memory stacking, where conflicting relational states accumulate without resolution, and narrative-spatial dissonance, where spatial logic detaches from the evolving plot. To bridge this gap, we propose EvoSpark, a framework specifically designed to sustain logically coherent long-horizon narratives within Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies. To ensure consistency, the Stratified Narrative Memory employs a Role Socio-Evolutionary Base as living cognition, dynamically metabolizing experiences to resolve historical conflicts. Complementarily, Generative Mise-en-Scène mechanism enforces Role-Location-Plot alignment, synchronizing character presence with the narrative flow. Underpinning these is the Unified Narrative Operation Engine, which integrates an Emergent Character Grounding Protocol to transform stochastic sparking into persistent characters. This engine establishes a substrate that expands a minimal premise into an open-ended, evolving story world. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSpark significantly outperforms baselines across diverse paradigms, enabling the sustained generation of expressive and coherent narrative experiences.

AI.tldr: EvoSpark框架解决LLM多智能体系统中内生叙事演化的挑战，通过分层叙事记忆和生成场景机制确保长时程叙事的逻辑一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的多智能体系统在内生叙事演化方面面临挑战，特别是生成涌现的固有随机性导致长时程模拟中出现社会记忆堆叠（冲突关系状态累积）和叙事空间失调（空间逻辑与情节脱节）问题。
AI.method: 提出EvoSpark框架，包含：1）分层叙事记忆，使用角色社会进化基础作为活体认知，动态代谢经验以解决历史冲突；2）生成场景机制，强制角色-位置-情节对齐，同步角色存在与叙事流；3）统一叙事操作引擎，集成涌现角色锚定协议，将随机触发转化为持久角色。
AI.result: 实验表明EvoSpark在不同范式上显著优于基线方法，能够持续生成表达性强且连贯的叙事体验。
AI.conclusion: EvoSpark为内生交互智能体社会提供了维持逻辑连贯长时程叙事的有效框架，能够将最小前提扩展为开放、进化的故事世界。

title: Can AI Tools Transform Low-Demand Math Tasks? An Evaluation of Task Modification Capabilities
summary: While recent research has explored AI tools' ability to classify the quality of mathematical tasks (arXiv:2603.03512), little is known about their capacity to increase the quality of existing tasks. This study investigated whether AI tools could successfully upgrade low-cognitive-demand mathematics tasks. Eleven tools were tested, including six broadly available, general-purpose AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT and Claude) and five tools specialized for mathematics teachers (e.g., Khanmigo, coteach.ai). Using the Task Analysis Guide framework (Stein & Smith, 1998), we prompted AI tools to modify two different types of low-demand mathematical tasks. The prompting strategy aimed to represent likely approaches taken by knowledgeable teachers, rather than extensive optimization to find a more effective prompt (i.e., an optimistic typical outcome). On average, AI tools were only moderately successful: tasks were accurately upgraded only 64% of the time, with different AI tool performance ranging from quite weak (33%) to broadly successful (88%). Specialized tools were only moderately more successful than general-purpose tools. Failure modes included both "undershooting" (maintaining low cognitive demand) and "overshooting" (elevating tasks to an overly ambitious target category that likely would be rejected by teachers). Interestingly, there was a small negative correlation (r = -.35) between whether a given AI tool was able to correctly classify the cognitive demand of tasks and whether the AI was able to upgrade tasks, showing that the ability to modify tasks (i.e., a generative task) represents a distinct capability from the ability to classify them (i.e., judgement using a rubric). These findings have important implications for understanding AI's potential role in curriculum adaptation and highlight the need for specialized approaches to support teachers in modifying instructional materials.

AI.tldr: AI工具在提升低认知需求数学任务质量方面表现中等，成功率64%，专业工具仅略优于通用工具
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究探索AI工具对数学任务质量的分类能力，但对其提升现有任务质量的能力知之甚少，本研究旨在填补这一空白
AI.method: 使用任务分析指南框架，测试11种AI工具（6种通用工具如ChatGPT、Claude，5种数学教师专用工具），以教师可能采用的方式提示AI修改两类低需求数学任务
AI.result: AI工具平均成功率64%，表现范围从33%到88%；专业工具仅略优于通用工具；存在"未达标"和"过度提升"两种失败模式；任务分类能力与任务升级能力呈负相关(r=-.35)
AI.conclusion: AI在课程适应中的潜力有限，需要专门方法来支持教师修改教学材料，任务生成能力与分类能力是不同的能力维度

title: From Attenuation to Attention: Variational Information Flow Manipulation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in general visual understanding, they frequently falter in fine-grained perception tasks that require identifying tiny objects or discerning subtle visual relationships. We attribute this limitation to Visual Attenuation: a phenomenon where sparse fine-grained visual signals are prematurely suppressed or diluted by dominant textual tokens during network propagation, resulting in a "loss of focus" during the deep-level decision-making process. Existing input-centric solutions fail to fundamentally reverse this intrinsic mechanism of information loss. To address this challenge, we propose the Variational Information Flow (VIF) framework. Adopting a probabilistic perspective, VIF leverages a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) to model the visual saliency relevant to the question-answer pair as a latent distribution. As a plug-and-play module, VIF can be integrated into existing architectures. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks, covering General VQA, fine-grained perception, and visual grounding, demonstrate that VIF yields competitive improvements over previous methods, validating its effectiveness in enhancing the fine-grained perception of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: VIF框架通过条件变分自编码器建模视觉显著性分布，解决MLLMs在细粒度感知任务中的视觉衰减问题
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在一般视觉理解方面表现出色，但在需要识别微小物体或辨别细微视觉关系的细粒度感知任务中经常失败。作者将这一问题归因于"视觉衰减"现象，即稀疏的细粒度视觉信号在网络传播过程中被主导的文本标记过早抑制或稀释，导致深层决策过程中"注意力丢失"。
AI.method: 提出变分信息流（VIF）框架，采用概率视角，利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）将与问答对相关的视觉显著性建模为潜在分布。VIF作为即插即用模块，可以集成到现有架构中。
AI.result: 在涵盖通用VQA、细粒度感知和视觉定位的多样化基准测试中进行了广泛评估，结果表明VIF相比先前方法带来了有竞争力的改进，验证了其在增强MLLMs细粒度感知方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VIF框架通过建模视觉显著性分布，有效解决了MLLMs中的视觉衰减问题，提升了模型在细粒度感知任务上的性能，为多模态理解提供了新的解决方案。

title: The role of System 1 and System 2 semantic memory structure in human and LLM biases
summary: Implicit biases in both humans and large language models (LLMs) pose significant societal risks. Dual process theories propose that biases arise primarily from associative System 1 thinking, while deliberative System 2 thinking mitigates bias, but the cognitive mechanisms that give rise to this phenomenon remain poorly understood. To better understand what underlies this duality in humans, and possibly in LLMs, we model System 1 and System 2 thinking as semantic memory networks with distinct structures, built from comparable datasets generated by both humans and LLMs. We then investigate how these distinct semantic memory structures relate to implicit gender bias using network-based evaluation metrics. We find that semantic memory structures are irreducible only in humans, suggesting that LLMs lack certain types of human-like conceptual knowledge. Moreover, semantic memory structure relates consistently to implicit bias only in humans, with lower levels of bias in System~2 structures. These findings suggest that certain types of conceptual knowledge contribute to bias regulation in humans, but not in LLMs, highlighting fundamental differences between human and machine cognition.

AI.tldr: 研究发现人类和LLMs的语义记忆结构差异：人类具有不可约的语义记忆结构，而LLMs缺乏类似人类的概念知识；人类System 2结构能降低隐性偏见，但LLMs中这种关系不成立。
AI.motivation: 人类和大型语言模型中的隐性偏见带来重大社会风险。双重过程理论认为偏见主要来自联想性System 1思维，而深思熟虑的System 2思维能减轻偏见，但产生这种现象的认知机制仍不清楚。研究旨在理解人类（可能也包括LLMs）中这种双重性的基础。
AI.method: 将System 1和System 2思维建模为具有不同结构的语义记忆网络，使用人类和LLMs生成的类似数据集构建这些网络。然后使用基于网络的评估指标研究这些不同的语义记忆结构如何与隐性性别偏见相关。
AI.result: 1. 语义记忆结构仅在人类中不可约，表明LLMs缺乏某些类型的人类概念知识；2. 语义记忆结构与隐性偏见的关系仅在人类中一致，System 2结构中的偏见水平较低。
AI.conclusion: 某些类型的概念知识有助于人类调节偏见，但在LLMs中不成立，这突显了人类与机器认知之间的根本差异。

title: DocSeeker: Structured Visual Reasoning with Evidence Grounding for Long Document Understanding
summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from significant performance degradation on the long document understanding task as document length increases. This stems from two fundamental challenges: 1) a low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), with crucial evidence buried in irrelevant pages; and 2) supervision scarcity, as datasets offering only final short answers provide a weak learning signal. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing a paradigm that requires the model to execute a structured ``\textbf{Analysis}, \textbf{Localization} and \textbf{Reasoning}'' workflow. To instill this capability, we design a two-stage training framework: we first perform Supervised Fine-Tuning on high-quality data generated via an efficient knowledge distillation strategy. Subsequently, we employ an Evidence-aware Group Relative Policy Optimization which jointly optimizes for both evidence localization and answer accuracy. Additionally, we introduce a Evidence-Guided Resolution Allocation strategy to mitigate memory constraints of training on multi-pages documents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocSeeker achieves superior performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks. We show it robustly generalizes from short-page training to ultra-long documents and is naturally synergistic with visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, serving as a solid foundation for their implementation.

AI.tldr: DocSeeker通过"分析-定位-推理"工作流解决MLLMs长文档理解性能下降问题，采用两阶段训练框架提升证据定位和答案准确性
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在长文档理解任务中随着文档长度增加性能显著下降，主要面临两个挑战：1) 信噪比低，关键证据被无关页面淹没；2) 监督稀缺，仅提供最终简短答案的数据集学习信号弱
AI.method: 提出结构化"分析-定位-推理"工作流范式。设计两阶段训练框架：首先在通过高效知识蒸馏生成的高质量数据上进行监督微调；然后采用证据感知的组相对策略优化，联合优化证据定位和答案准确性。还引入证据引导的分辨率分配策略缓解多页文档训练的内存约束
AI.result: 大量实验表明DocSeeker在领域内和领域外任务上都实现了优越性能。模型能够从短页训练稳健地泛化到超长文档，并且与视觉检索增强生成系统自然协同，为其实现提供坚实基础
AI.conclusion: DocSeeker通过结构化工作流和两阶段训练框架有效解决了MLLMs长文档理解中的信噪比低和监督稀缺问题，在长文档理解任务中表现出色并具有良好的泛化能力

title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Professional Image Quality Assessment (Track 1)
comment: NTIRE Challenge Report. Accepted by CVPRW 2026
summary: In this paper, we present an overview of the NTIRE 2026 challenge on the 3rd Restore Any Image Model in the Wild, specifically focusing on Track 1: Professional Image Quality Assessment. Conventional Image Quality Assessment (IQA) typically relies on scalar scores. By compressing complex visual characteristics into a single number, these methods fundamentally struggle to distinguish subtle differences among uniformly high-quality images. Furthermore, they fail to articulate why one image is superior, lacking the reasoning capabilities required to provide guidance for vision tasks. To bridge this gap, recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a promising paradigm. Inspired by this potential, our challenge establishes a novel benchmark exploring the ability of MLLMs to mimic human expert cognition in evaluating high-quality image pairs. Participants were tasked with overcoming critical bottlenecks in professional scenarios, centering on two primary objectives: (1) Comparative Quality Selection: reliably identifying the visually superior image within a high-quality pair; and (2) Interpretative Reasoning: generating grounded, expert-level explanations that detail the rationale behind the selection. In total, the challenge attracted nearly 200 registrations and over 2,500 submissions. The top-performing methods significantly advanced the state of the art in professional IQA. The challenge dataset is available at https://github.com/narthchin/RAIM-PIQA, and the official homepage is accessible at https://www.codabench.org/competitions/12789/.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026挑战赛专注于专业图像质量评估，利用多模态大语言模型模仿人类专家认知，通过比较高质量图像对并生成解释性推理来提升评估能力。
AI.motivation: 传统图像质量评估方法使用单一分数，无法区分高质量图像间的细微差异，也缺乏解释能力。多模态大语言模型为解决这一问题提供了新思路，能够模仿人类专家认知进行更精细的评估。
AI.method: 建立新基准，探索MLLMs在专业场景中评估高质量图像对的能力。参与者需要完成两个主要任务：1) 比较质量选择：可靠识别高质量图像对中视觉更优的图像；2) 解释性推理：生成基于专家水平的解释，详细说明选择理由。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了近200个注册和超过2500个提交。表现最佳的方法显著推进了专业图像质量评估的技术水平。数据集和官方主页已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛成功建立了专业图像质量评估的新基准，展示了MLLMs在模仿人类专家认知方面的潜力，为未来视觉任务提供了更精细的评估和指导能力。

title: Growing Pains: Extensible and Efficient LLM Benchmarking Via Fixed Parameter Calibration
summary: The rapid release of both language models and benchmarks makes it increasingly costly to evaluate every model on every dataset. In practice, models are often evaluated on different samples, making scores difficult to compare across studies. To address this, we propose a framework based on multidimensional Item Response Theory (IRT) that uses anchor items to calibrate new benchmarks to the evaluation suite while holding previously calibrated item parameters fixed. Our approach supports a realistic evaluation setting in which datasets are introduced over time and models are evaluated only on the datasets available at the time of evaluation, while a fixed anchor set for each dataset is used so that results from different evaluation periods can be compared directly. In large-scale experiments on more than $400$ models, our framework predicts full-evaluation performance within 2-3 percentage points using only $100$ anchor questions per dataset, with Spearman $ρ\geq 0.9$ for ranking preservation, showing that it is possible to extend benchmark suites over time while preserving score comparability, at a constant evaluation cost per new dataset. Code available at https://github.com/eliyahabba/growing-pains

AI.tldr: 提出基于多维项目反应理论的框架，使用锚定题目将新基准校准到评估套件中，解决模型评估中数据集随时间变化导致的分数不可比问题。
AI.motivation: 语言模型和基准测试的快速发布使得评估每个模型在每个数据集上的成本越来越高。实践中，模型经常在不同样本上评估，导致跨研究比较困难。数据集随时间引入，模型只在评估时可用的数据集上测试，需要保持分数可比性。
AI.method: 基于多维项目反应理论(IRT)的框架，使用锚定题目将新基准校准到现有评估套件中。保持先前校准的项目参数固定，每个数据集使用固定的锚定集合，使不同评估时期的结果可以直接比较。
AI.result: 在超过400个模型的大规模实验中，该框架仅使用每个数据集100个锚定问题就能在2-3个百分点内预测完整评估性能，Spearman ρ≥0.9保持排序一致性。证明可以在保持分数可比性的同时随时间扩展基准套件，每个新数据集的评估成本恒定。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于IRT的框架有效解决了基准测试随时间扩展时的分数可比性问题，通过锚定题目实现高效校准，在保持评估成本恒定的同时确保跨时间评估结果的可比性。

title: RePAIR: Interactive Machine Unlearning through Prompt-Aware Model Repair
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inherently absorb harmful knowledge, misinformation, and personal data during pretraining on large-scale web corpora, with no native mechanism for selective removal. While machine unlearning offers a principled solution, existing approaches are provider-centric, requiring retraining pipelines, curated retain datasets, and direct intervention by model service providers (MSPs), thereby excluding end users from controlling their own data. We introduce Interactive Machine Unlearning (IMU), a new paradigm in which users can instruct LLMs to forget targeted knowledge through natural language at inference time. To realize IMU, we propose RePAIR, a prompt-aware model repair framework comprising (i) a watchdog model for unlearning intent detection, (ii) a surgeon model for generating repair procedures, and (iii) a patient model whose parameters are updated autonomously. At the core of RePAIR, we develop Steering Through Activation Manipulation with PseudoInverse (STAMP), a training-free, single-sample unlearning method that redirects MLP activations toward a refusal subspace via closed-form pseudoinverse updates. Its low-rank variant reduces computational complexity from O(d^3) to O(r^3 + r^2 * d), enabling efficient on-device unlearning with up to ~3x speedup over training-based baselines. Extensive experiments across harmful knowledge suppression, misinformation correction, and personal data erasure demonstrate that RePAIR achieves near-zero forget scores (Acc_f = 0.00, F-RL = 0.00) while preserving model utility (Acc_r up to 84.47, R-RL up to 0.88), outperforming six state-of-the-art baselines. These results establish RePAIR as an effective and practical framework for user-driven model editing, advancing transparent and on-device control over learned knowledge, with potential extensions to multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式机器遗忘(IMU)新范式，让用户通过自然语言指令让LLMs遗忘特定知识，并开发了RePAIR框架和STAMP方法实现高效、训练自由的单样本遗忘。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在预训练时不可避免地吸收有害知识、错误信息和个人数据，但现有机器遗忘方法都是提供商中心的，需要重新训练流程、精心设计的保留数据集和模型服务提供商的直接干预，排除了终端用户对自己数据的控制权。
AI.method: 提出交互式机器遗忘(IMU)范式，开发RePAIR框架：包含(i)用于遗忘意图检测的看守模型，(ii)生成修复程序的外科医生模型，(iii)参数自主更新的患者模型。核心是STAMP方法，通过伪逆更新将MLP激活重定向到拒绝子空间，其低秩变体将计算复杂度从O(d^3)降低到O(r^3 + r^2 * d)。
AI.result: 在有害知识抑制、错误信息纠正和个人数据擦除实验中，RePAIR实现了接近零的遗忘分数(Acc_f = 0.00, F-RL = 0.00)，同时保持了模型效用(Acc_r高达84.47, R-RL高达0.88)，优于六种最先进的基线方法，实现了高达3倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: RePAIR是用户驱动模型编辑的有效实用框架，推进了对学习知识的透明和设备端控制，并有可能扩展到多模态基础模型。

title: CoD-Lite: Real-Time Diffusion-Based Generative Image Compression
summary: Recent advanced diffusion methods typically derive strong generative priors by scaling diffusion transformers. However, scaling fails to generalize when adapted for real-time compression scenarios that demand lightweight models. In this paper, we explore the design of real-time and lightweight diffusion codecs by addressing two pivotal questions. First, does diffusion pre-training benefit lightweight diffusion codecs? Through systematic analysis, we find that generation-oriented pre-training is less effective at small model scales whereas compression-oriented pre-training yields consistently better performance. Second, are transformers essential? We find that while global attention is crucial for standard generation, lightweight convolutions suffice for compression-oriented diffusion when paired with distillation. Guided by these findings, we establish a one-step lightweight convolution diffusion codec that achieves real-time $60$~FPS encoding and $42$~FPS decoding at 1080p. Further enhanced by distillation and adversarial learning, the proposed codec reduces bitrate by 85\% at a comparable FID to MS-ILLM, bridging the gap between generative compression and practical real-time deployment. Codes are released at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/CoD_Lite

AI.tldr: 本文探索轻量级实时扩散编解码器设计，发现压缩导向预训练优于生成导向预训练，轻量卷积配合蒸馏可替代Transformer，最终实现1080p下60FPS编码和42FPS解码，比特率降低85%
AI.motivation: 现有扩散方法通过扩展Transformer获得强大生成先验，但在需要轻量级模型的实时压缩场景中扩展方法失效。本文旨在探索实时轻量级扩散编解码器的设计
AI.method: 通过系统分析回答两个关键问题：1)扩散预训练对轻量级编解码器是否有益；2)Transformer是否必需。基于发现建立一步轻量卷积扩散编解码器，结合蒸馏和对抗学习增强性能
AI.result: 压缩导向预训练在小模型规模下表现更优；轻量卷积配合蒸馏可替代全局注意力。最终编解码器在1080p下实现60FPS编码和42FPS解码，在可比FID下比特率比MS-ILLM降低85%
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了实时轻量级扩散编解码器，通过压缩导向预训练、轻量卷积架构和蒸馏技术，弥合了生成压缩与实际实时部署之间的差距

title: Round-Trip Translation Reveals What Frontier Multilingual Benchmarks Miss
summary: Multilingual benchmarks guide the development of frontier models. Yet multilingual evaluations reported by frontier models are structured similar to popular reasoning and knowledge benchmarks, but across many languages. We show such benchmarks, and consequently multilingual evaluations, measure mathematical reasoning and factual recall, not multilingual proficiency. For example, thinking variants dramatically outperform instruct variants on these benchmarks, yet often perform worse on real-world multilingual tasks, such as LMArena. We propose a simple alternative: evaluate multilingual capability via round-trip translation. Given text in a source language, translate it to a target language and back; semantic gaps between the original and result expose failures in multilingual generation capabilities. Round-trip translation correlates almost perfectly (\r{ho} = 0.94) with user ratings on LMArena with our benchmark, requires no human reference translations, and does not require a more capable multilingual judge than tested models. Lastly, we introduce Lost in Translation (LiT), a challenging round-trip translation benchmark spanning widely spoken languages worldwide, for realistic evaluation of multilingual frontier models.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前多语言基准测试主要衡量数学推理和事实回忆能力，而非真正的多语言熟练度，并提出使用往返翻译作为替代评估方法
AI.motivation: 当前前沿模型的多语言评估主要基于类似推理和知识基准的结构，但这些基准实际上测量的是数学推理和事实回忆能力，而不是真正的多语言熟练度，导致评估结果与现实世界多语言任务表现不一致
AI.method: 提出使用往返翻译作为评估方法：将源语言文本翻译到目标语言再翻译回来，通过原始文本与结果之间的语义差距来暴露多语言生成能力的缺陷
AI.result: 往返翻译方法与LMArena上的用户评分几乎完美相关（ρ=0.94），不需要人工参考翻译，也不需要比被测试模型更强的多语言评判者
AI.conclusion: 往返翻译是评估多语言能力的有效方法，并提出了"Lost in Translation"（LiT）基准，这是一个涵盖全球广泛使用语言的具有挑战性的往返翻译基准，用于现实评估多语言前沿模型

title: MODIX: A Training-Free Multimodal Information-Driven Positional Index Scaling for Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026 (Highlight). 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their positional encoding mechanisms remain suboptimal. Existing approaches uniformly assign positional indices to all tokens, overlooking variations in information density within and across modalities, which leads to inefficient attention allocation where redundant visual regions dominate while informative content is underrepresented. We identify positional granularity as an implicit resource and propose MODIX (Multimodal Information-Driven Positional IndeX Scaling), a training-free framework that dynamically adapts positional strides based on modality-specific contributions. MODIX jointly models intra-modal density via covariance-based entropy and inter-modal interaction via cross-modal alignment to derive unified scores, which rescale positional indices to allocate finer granularity to informative modalities while compressing redundant ones, without requiring any modification to model parameters or architecture. Experiments across diverse architectures and benchmarks demonstrate that MODIX consistently improves multimodal reasoning and adaptively reallocates attention according to task-dependent information distributions, suggesting that positional encoding should be treated as an adaptive resource in Transformers for multimodal sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: MODIX提出了一种无需训练的位置索引缩放框架，通过动态调整位置步长来优化多模态Transformer中的注意力分配，根据模态信息密度分配更精细的位置粒度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型的位置编码机制存在不足，对所有token统一分配位置索引，忽略了模态内和模态间信息密度的变化，导致冗余视觉区域占据过多注意力而信息丰富内容被低估。
AI.method: 提出MODIX框架，通过协方差熵建模模态内密度，通过跨模态对齐建模模态间交互，计算统一分数来重新缩放位置索引，为信息丰富的模态分配更精细的粒度，压缩冗余模态，无需修改模型参数或架构。
AI.result: 在不同架构和基准测试上的实验表明，MODIX能持续改进多模态推理能力，并能根据任务依赖的信息分布自适应地重新分配注意力。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码应被视为多模态序列建模中Transformer的自适应资源，MODIX展示了通过动态调整位置粒度来优化注意力分配的有效性。

title: MetFuse: Figurative Fusion between Metonymy and Metaphor
summary: Metonymy and metaphor often co-occur in natural language, yet computational work has studied them largely in isolation. We introduce a framework that transforms a literal sentence into three figurative variants: metonymic, metaphoric, and hybrid. Using this framework, we construct MetFuse, the first dedicated dataset of figurative fusion between metonymy and metaphor, containing 1,000 human-verified meaning-aligned quadruplets totaling 4,000 sentences. Extrinsic experiments on eight existing benchmarks show that augmenting training data with MetFuse consistently improves both metonymy and metaphor classification, with hybrid examples yielding the largest gains on metonymy tasks. Using this dataset, we also analyze how the presence of one figurative type impacts another. Our findings show that both human annotators and large language models better identify metonymy in hybrid sentences than in metonymy-only sentences, demonstrating that the presence of a metaphor makes a metonymic noun more explicit. Our dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/MetFuse.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个专门研究转喻和隐喻融合的数据集MetFuse，包含1000个人工验证的四元组句子，通过实验证明在训练数据中加入该数据集能提升两种修辞手法的分类效果，特别是混合类型对转喻任务提升最大。
AI.motivation: 转喻和隐喻在自然语言中经常同时出现，但现有的计算研究大多将它们分开研究。为了填补这一空白，需要建立一个专门研究这两种修辞手法融合的数据集，以更好地理解它们如何相互作用并提升相关任务的性能。
AI.method: 研究者建立了一个框架，将字面句子转换为三种比喻变体：转喻、隐喻和混合类型。基于此框架构建了MetFuse数据集，包含1000个人工验证的四元组（字面句+三种比喻变体），总计4000个句子。在八个现有基准上进行外部实验，评估数据增强效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，在训练数据中加入MetFuse能持续提升转喻和隐喻的分类性能，其中混合类型示例对转喻任务的提升最大。分析发现，人类标注者和大型语言模型在混合句子中比在纯转喻句子中更能识别转喻，表明隐喻的存在使转喻名词更加明确。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了转喻和隐喻融合研究的空白，提供了首个专门数据集MetFuse。实验证明混合修辞示例对转喻识别有显著帮助，揭示了两种修辞手法之间的相互作用关系，为未来的自然语言处理研究提供了有价值的资源。

title: From edges to meaning: Semantic line sketches as a cognitive scaffold for ancient pictograph invention
summary: Humans readily recognize objects from sparse line drawings, a capacity that appears early in development and persists across cultures, suggesting neural rather than purely learned origins. Yet the computational mechanism by which the brain transforms high-level semantic knowledge into low-level visual symbols remains poorly understood. Here we propose that ancient pictographic writing emerged from the brain's intrinsic tendency to compress visual input into stable, boundary-based abstractions. We construct a biologically inspired digital twin of the visual hierarchy that encodes an image into low-level features, generates a contour sketch, and iteratively refines it through top-down feedback guided by semantic representations, mirroring the feedforward and recurrent architecture of the human visual cortex. The resulting symbols bear striking structural resemblance to early pictographs across culturally distant writing systems, including Egyptian hieroglyphs, Chinese oracle bone characters, and proto-cuneiform, and offer candidate interpretations for undeciphered scripts. Our findings support a neuro-computational origin of pictographic writing and establish a framework in which AI can recapitulate the cognitive processes by which humans first externalized perception into symbols.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种神经计算模型，解释人类如何将高级语义知识转化为低级视觉符号，并认为古代象形文字起源于大脑压缩视觉输入为稳定边界抽象的内在倾向。
AI.motivation: 人类能够从稀疏线条画中识别物体，这种能力在发育早期出现且跨文化存在，表明其神经起源而非纯粹学习获得。然而，大脑如何将高级语义知识转化为低级视觉符号的计算机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建了一个受生物学启发的视觉层次数字孪生模型，该模型将图像编码为低级特征，生成轮廓草图，并通过基于语义表征的top-down反馈迭代优化，模拟人类视觉皮层的前馈和循环架构。
AI.result: 生成的符号在结构上与跨文化早期象形文字（包括埃及象形文字、中国甲骨文和原始楔形文字）惊人相似，并为未解读的文字提供了候选解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持象形文字的神经计算起源，并建立了一个框架，使AI能够重现人类首次将感知外部化为符号的认知过程。

title: Evolution-Inspired Sample Competition for Deep Neural Network Optimization
summary: Conventional deep network training generally optimizes all samples under a largely uniform learning paradigm, without explicitly modeling the heterogeneous competition among them. Such an oversimplified treatment can lead to several well-known issues, including bias under class imbalance, insufficient learning of hard samples, and the erroneous reinforcement of noisy samples. In this work, we present \textit{Natural Selection} (NS), a novel evolution-inspired optimization method that explicitly incorporates competitive interactions into deep network training. Unlike conventional sample reweighting strategies that rely mainly on predefined heuristics or static criteria, NS estimates the competitive status of each sample in a group-wise context and uses it to adaptively regulate its training contribution. Specifically, NS first assembles multiple samples into a composite image and rescales it to the original input size for model inference. Based on the resulting predictions, a natural selection score is computed for each sample to characterize its relative competitive variation within the constructed group. These scores are then used to dynamically reweight the sample-wise loss, thereby introducing an explicit competition-driven mechanism into the optimization process. In this way, NS provides a simple yet effective means of moving beyond uniform sample treatment and enables more adaptive and balanced model optimization. Extensive experiments on 12 public datasets across four image classification tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Moreover, NS is compatible with diverse network architectures and does not depend on task-specific assumptions, indicating its strong generality and practical potential. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"自然选择"的新型优化方法，通过样本间竞争机制动态调整训练权重，解决传统均匀学习范式下的类别不平衡、难样本学习不足和噪声样本强化等问题。
AI.motivation: 传统深度网络训练采用统一的样本处理方式，忽视了样本间的异质竞争关系，导致类别不平衡下的偏差、难样本学习不足以及噪声样本错误强化等问题。
AI.method: NS方法将多个样本组合成复合图像并缩放到原始输入大小进行模型推理，基于预测结果计算每个样本的"自然选择分数"来表征其在组内的相对竞争变化，然后使用这些分数动态重新加权样本损失。
AI.result: 在12个公共数据集上的四个图像分类任务实验证明了该方法的有效性。NS兼容多种网络架构，不依赖任务特定假设，显示出强大的通用性和实用潜力。
AI.conclusion: NS提供了一种简单而有效的方法，超越了均匀样本处理，实现了更自适应和平衡的模型优化，为深度网络训练引入了明确的竞争驱动机制。

title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) has advanced rapidly with the rise of vision-language models, yet evaluation has remained concentrated on a small cluster of high- and mid-resource scripts. We introduce GlotOCR Bench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating OCR generalization across 100+ Unicode scripts. Our benchmark comprises clean and degraded image variants rendered from real multilingual texts. Images are rendered using fonts from the Google Fonts repository, shaped with HarfBuzz and rasterized with FreeType, supporting both LTR and RTL scripts. Samples of rendered images were manually reviewed to verify correct rendering across all scripts. We evaluate a broad suite of open-weight and proprietary vision-language models and find that most perform well on fewer than ten scripts, and even the strongest frontier models fail to generalize beyond thirty scripts. Performance broadly tracks script-level pretraining coverage, suggesting that current OCR systems rely on language model pretraining as much as on visual recognition. Models confronted with unfamiliar scripts either produce random noise or hallucinate characters from similar scripts they already know. We release the benchmark and pipeline for reproducibility. Pipeline Code: https://github.com/cisnlp/glotocr-bench, Benchmark: https://hf.co/datasets/cis-lmu/glotocr-bench.

AI.tldr: GlotOCR Bench是一个包含100多种Unicode文字的OCR基准测试，评估视觉语言模型在多文字识别上的泛化能力，发现现有模型仅能处理少量文字，前沿模型也无法超过30种文字。
AI.motivation: 当前OCR评估主要集中在少数高资源和中资源文字上，缺乏对多文字泛化能力的全面评估，需要建立一个全面的基准来评估OCR系统在不同文字上的表现。
AI.method: 使用Google Fonts字体库，通过HarfBuzz进行文字整形，FreeType进行光栅化，生成干净和降质版本的多语言文本图像。支持左右书写方向，所有渲染图像都经过人工审核确保正确性。
AI.result: 大多数模型只能在不到10种文字上表现良好，即使最强的前沿模型也无法泛化到30种以上文字。性能与文字级别的预训练覆盖度密切相关，模型面对不熟悉的文字时会产生随机噪声或从相似文字中产生幻觉字符。
AI.conclusion: 当前OCR系统严重依赖语言模型预训练而非视觉识别能力，需要更多样化的预训练数据来改善多文字识别性能。作者发布了基准测试和管道代码以促进可重复性研究。

title: LIFE -- an energy efficient advanced continual learning agentic AI framework for frontier systems
summary: The rapid advancement of AI has changed the character of HPC usage such as dimensioning, provisioning, and execution. Not only has energy demand been amplified, but existing rudimentary continual learning capabilities limit ability of AI to effectively manage HPCs. This paper reviews emerging directions beyond monolithic transformers, emphasizing agentic AI and brain inspired architectures as complementary paths toward sustainable, adaptive systems. We propose LIFE, a reasoning and Learning framework that is Incremental, Flexible, and Energy efficient that is implemented as an agent centric system rather than a single monolithic model. LIFE uniquely combines four components to realize self evolving network management and operations in HPCs. The components are an orchestrator, Agentic Context Engineering, a novel memory system, and information lattice learning. LIFE can also generalize to enable a variety of orthogonal use cases. We ground LIFE in a specific closed loop HPC operations example for detecting and mitigating latency spikes experienced by critical micro services running on a Kubernetes like cluster.

AI.tldr: LIFE框架：面向HPC的增量、灵活、节能的推理与学习系统，采用代理中心架构而非单一模型，实现自演化的网络管理与运维。
AI.motivation: AI快速发展改变了HPC的使用模式，不仅放大了能源需求，现有持续学习能力有限，限制了AI有效管理HPC的能力。需要超越单一Transformer模型的新方向。
AI.method: 提出LIFE框架，结合四个组件：编排器、代理上下文工程、新型内存系统和信息格学习。采用代理中心架构而非单一模型，实现增量、灵活、节能的推理与学习。
AI.result: LIFE能够实现HPC中自演化的网络管理与运维，并可推广到多种正交用例。在具体示例中，成功检测和缓解Kubernetes类集群中关键微服务遇到的延迟峰值。
AI.conclusion: LIFE框架代表了超越单一Transformer模型的新方向，结合代理AI和脑启发架构，为可持续、自适应系统提供了互补路径，能够有效管理HPC的复杂运维需求。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: DDTree是一种基于块扩散草稿器的草稿树构建方法，通过最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续路径，在单次前向传播中验证整个草稿树，显著提升了推测解码性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然DFlash通过块扩散草稿器在单次前向传播中生成整个草稿块并取得了先进的推测解码性能，但传统方法每轮只验证单个草稿轨迹，限制了接受长度。需要一种方法能够利用草稿器的分布信息构建多个可能的延续路径，从而提高验证效率。
AI.method: DDTree方法从块扩散草稿器的每个位置分布中直接构建草稿树。在固定节点预算下，使用简单的最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续路径（基于草稿模型输出的代理函数）。生成的树通过祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证。
AI.result: DDTree基于领先的推测解码草稿模型DFlash构建，其性能提升使DDTree成为推测解码领域的领先方法之一。该方法能够有效提高接受长度和整体解码效率。
AI.conclusion: DDTree通过构建草稿树并利用块扩散草稿器的分布信息，在单次前向传播中验证多个可能路径，显著提升了推测解码的性能和效率，代表了该领域的重要进展。

title: AISafetyBenchExplorer: A Metric-Aware Catalogue of AI Safety Benchmarks Reveals Fragmented Measurement and Weak Benchmark Governance
summary: The rapid expansion of large language model (LLM) safety evaluation has produced a substantial benchmark ecosystem, but not a correspondingly coherent measurement ecosystem. We present AISafetyBenchExplorer, a structured catalogue of 195 AI safety benchmarks released between 2018 and 2026, organized through a multi-sheet schema that records benchmark-level metadata, metric-level definitions, benchmark-paper metadata, and repository activity. This design enables meta-analysis not only of what benchmarks exist, but also of how safety is operationalized, aggregated, and judged across the literature. Using the updated catalogue, we identify a central structural problem: benchmark proliferation has outpaced measurement standardization. The current landscape is dominated by medium-complexity benchmarks (94/195), while only 7 benchmarks occupy the Popular tier. The workbook further reports strong concentration around English-only evaluation (165/195), evaluation-only resources (170/195), stale GitHub repositories (137/195), stale Hugging Face datasets (96/195), and heavy reliance on arXiv preprints among benchmarks with known venue metadata. At the metric level, the catalogue shows that familiar labels such as accuracy, F1 score, safety score, and aggregate benchmark scores often conceal materially different judges, aggregation rules, and threat models. We argue that the field's main failure mode is fragmentation rather than scarcity. Researchers now have many benchmark artifacts, but they often lack a shared measurement language, a principled basis for benchmark selection, and durable stewardship norms for post publication maintenance. AISafetyBenchExplorer addresses this gap by providing a traceable benchmark catalogue, a controlled metadata schema, and a complexity taxonomy that together support more rigorous benchmark discovery, comparison, and meta-evaluation.

AI.tldr: AISafetyBenchExplorer是一个包含195个AI安全基准测试的结构化目录，揭示了基准测试激增但测量标准不统一的问题，导致领域碎片化而非稀缺性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型安全评估的快速扩展产生了大量基准测试，但缺乏相应的统一测量体系。当前基准测试激增但测量标准化滞后，导致研究人员缺乏共享的测量语言、基准选择原则和持续维护规范。
AI.method: 开发AISafetyBenchExplorer，这是一个包含195个AI安全基准测试的结构化目录，采用多工作表架构记录基准级元数据、度量级定义、基准论文元数据和存储库活动。通过复杂性分类法和受控元数据模式支持基准发现、比较和元评估。
AI.result: 发现基准测试激增但测量标准化不足：94/195为中等复杂度基准，仅7个属于流行层级；165/195仅支持英语评估；170/195仅为评估资源；137/195的GitHub仓库和96/195的Hugging Face数据集已过时；常用度量标签（如准确率、F1分数）掩盖了不同的评判标准、聚合规则和威胁模型。
AI.conclusion: AI安全评估领域的主要问题是碎片化而非稀缺性。AISafetyBenchExplorer通过提供可追溯的基准目录、受控元数据模式和复杂性分类法，支持更严格的基准发现、比较和元评估，为解决测量标准化滞后问题提供工具。

title: StructDiff: A Structure-Preserving and Spatially Controllable Diffusion Model for Single-Image Generation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (Regular Paper)
summary: This paper introduces StructDiff, a generative framework based on a single-scale diffusion model for single-image generation. Single-image generation aims to synthesize diverse samples with similar visual content to the source image by capturing its internal statistics, without relying on external data. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve the structural layout, especially for images with large rigid objects or strict spatial constraints. Moreover, most approaches lack spatial controllability, making it difficult to guide the structure or placement of generated content. To address these challenges, StructDiff introduces an \textit{adaptive receptive field} module to maintain both global and local distributions. Building on this foundation, StructDiff incorporates 3D positional encoding (PE) as a spatial prior, allowing flexible control over positions, scale, and local details of generated objects. To our knowledge, this spatial control capability represents the first exploration of PE-based manipulation in single-image generation. Furthermore, we propose a novel evaluation criterion for single-image generation based on large language models (LLMs). This criterion specifically addresses the limitations of existing objective metrics and the high labor costs associated with user studies. StructDiff also demonstrates broad applicability across downstream tasks, such as text-guided image generation, image editing, outpainting, and paint-to-image synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StructDiff outperforms existing methods in structural consistency, visual quality, and spatial controllability. The project page is available at https://butter-crab.github.io/StructDiff/.

AI.tldr: StructDiff是一个基于单尺度扩散模型的单图像生成框架，通过自适应感受野模块保持全局和局部分布，利用3D位置编码实现空间控制，并引入基于大语言模型的新评估标准。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像生成方法在保持结构布局（特别是包含大型刚性物体或严格空间约束的图像）方面存在困难，且缺乏空间可控性，难以指导生成内容的结构或位置安排。
AI.method: 提出自适应感受野模块来维持全局和局部分布；引入3D位置编码作为空间先验，实现对生成对象位置、尺度和局部细节的灵活控制；提出基于大语言模型的评估标准。
AI.result: StructDiff在结构一致性、视觉质量和空间可控性方面优于现有方法，并展示了在文本引导图像生成、图像编辑、外延绘制和绘制到图像合成等下游任务中的广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: StructDiff通过创新的自适应感受野模块和3D位置编码技术，有效解决了单图像生成中的结构保持和空间控制问题，同时提出了基于LLM的新评估标准，为单图像生成领域提供了更强大的工具。
